name: De 4 daagse van Girona
description: The 4-day Girona is an intimate walking event in Spain, organised for a maximum of 300 participants. From 4 to 7 November 2026, you’ll walk through the beautiful and varied landscapes of the province of Girona, on routes that start and finish in Girona’s historic centre. Around 70% of the trails are unpaved, taking you through fragrant forests and rolling hills, with a few climbs that require good fitness. The event is offered as a complete package including accommodation and breakfast at Hotel Ibis Girona, with a convivial get-together after the final day of walking.
course_highlights: Around 70% unpaved trails through forests and along rivers
Start and finish in Girona’s medieval centre
Varied routes with flat sections and short climbs
additional: Participants stay at Hotel Ibis Girona, which is also the start and finish location. Transport to and from Barcelona Airport is arranged to coincide with recommended flights. There is a celebratory get-together after the final day of walking. The daily routes range from approximately 18 km to 26 km, with a choice of a shorter route or a longer route with an extra loop. 5 hotel nights, walking route, medal, briefing, breakfast, lunch, transport, insurance, dinner optional, extra nights available

name: 7e Pepernotenrun
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.1 km, 1.4 km, 0.7 km

name: NightRun Rijssen
description: NightRun Rijssen takes place on Thursday, 5 November 2026, offering a unique evening experience as participants run through the centre of Rijssen, past beautiful buildings and businesses. This is not a race; it’s all about fun and the experience, with a magical atmosphere created by the lighting and evening setting. There are several distances: a 1 km kids’ run, a 5 km walking or running route, and a 10 km route for the more ambitious. The start and finish are in the centre of Rijssen, with a rolling start to keep participants moving smoothly.
course_highlights: Run through the centre of Rijssen during late-night shopping
The route goes right through buildings and businesses
Magical, festive atmosphere with lighting and evening decorations
additional: Start and finish in the centre of Rijssen at 'T Schild (next to Pearle). Rolling start in small groups to keep participants moving smoothly. The finish is at Lucky, Morsweg 8. No timing, and it is not a race. There is an opportunity to warm up at NightRun Borne on 9 October. The event takes place during late-night shopping in Rijssen city centre; it is not a race and is focused on fun and the experience. Participants light up the streets and enjoy a festive atmosphere.

name: Devil's Trail Schiermonnikoog
description: The Devil’s Trail Schiermonnikoog is a unique running experience taking place on 6 and 7 November 2026. Participants can enjoy e

name: Batavia Night Run
description: The Batavia Night Run is an atmospheric running race taking place on Friday evening, 6 November 2026, in the illuminated Batavia Quarter in Lelystad. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and kids’ runs of 800 and 1,500 metres. The course runs through the historic, atmospherically lit area around Museum Batavialand, creating a unique nighttime running experience. The organisers also support the charity Stichting ALS Nederland.
course_highlights: Course through the atmospherically illuminated Batavia Quarter
Distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km
Kids’ runs of 800 and 1,500 metres
additional: Registration includes entry to the atmospheric night run. A Batavia Night Run shirt and cancellation insurance can be ordered as extras. The organisers work with photographers and videographers to produce promotional images. Participants must comply with the applicable traffic regulations and RIVM guidelines. Night run with registration available; charities involved; the event combines sport and entertainment in an atmospheric setting.

name: 28e Nacht van OLAT / Kennedy Trail
description: The 28th Nacht van OLAT/Kennedy-Trail takes place from Friday evening, 6 November, to Saturday, 7 November 2026, in Oirschot, the Netherlands. Participants can choose from three distances: 110 km, 80 km and 55 km, with start times in the evening and at night. The route combines paved and unpaved paths, with extensive aid stations and a pasta meal for the 110 km and 80 km runners after the night stage. All participants must finish by 19:00 on Saturday. They receive a certificate, and a medal is available for an additional fee.
course_highlights: A partly paved, partly unpaved route, with longer unpaved sections during the day
Extensive aid stations with food and drinks
Pasta meal for 110 km and 80 km participants after the night loop
additional: Start times: 110 km at 20:00; 80 km and 55 km at 23:00. Registration is approximately one hour before the start. Dogs are not allowed. All participants must finish before 19:00 on Saturday. A medal is optional for an additional fee. Night trail race with multiple distances and support; registration approximately one hour before the start; finish before 19:00 on 7 November 2026; medal available for a fee.

name: Plantsoenloop Groningen
description: The 67th edition of the Plantsoenloop Groningen takes place on Saturday, November 1, 2025. This running classic, which has attracted thousands of

name: Run Forest Run Holtingerveld

name: Vestingstad Run

name: RUNFORESTRUN Holtingerveld

name: LoveLife Run Terneuzen
location: ZorgSaam Ziekenhuis De Honte, Terneuzen, Zeeland, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voor een kleine bijdrage ontvang je een LoveLife Run sportshirt en een medaille.

description: On November 7, 2026, the very first LoveLife Run will take place in Terneuzen. This special running event brings together (former) cancer patients, their loved ones and healthcare professionals to run 5 kilometers. The event aims to turn feelings of helplessness into strength and raise money for groundbreaking cancer research. Everyone is welcome to take part or support participants with a donation. Proceeds will go to cancer research and local care initiatives. The event is organized by Zeeland Business and volunteers.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer running route
Run together with (former) cancer patients, their loved ones and healthcare professionals
Location at ZorgSaam Ziekenhuis De Honte in Terneuzen
additional: Participants receive a sports shirt and a medal. Food, drinks and entertainment will be available. (Former) cancer patients can participate for free and will be supported with running training sessions in the lead-up to the event. Sign up for training by September 1; registration without training is open until one week before the event. Sustainable travel by bicycle or public transport is recommended. The event starts at ZorgSaam Ziekenhuis De Honte and is supported by Atletiekvereniging Scheldesport. Participants can collect donations and show their support for people affected by cancer.

name: De Najaarsloop van Cialfo
description: The AV Cialfo Autumn Run is a running event held in Epe and organized by AV Cialfo. The run takes place on Wachtelenbergweg and offers participants a great opportunity to be active in the autumn in a sporty and welcoming atmosphere. Pre-registration is available until the end of October, with on-the-day registration open until 30 minutes before the start. The event attracts runners from the region and is part of the local sporting calendar.
course_highlights: Location on Wachtelenbergweg in Epe
Autumn running event
On-the-day registration available until 30 minutes before the start
additional: Pre-registration is open through 27 October via inschrijven.nl. On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before the start of the run. Run at Wachtelenbergweg, Epe; date has already passed; registration via online platform.

name: Dorpsrun Renswoude

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: € 60,- per team voor de halve marathon

description: The Dorps Run Renswoude takes place on Saturday, 7 November 2026, and offers a suitable distance for every runner, from beginners to experienced athletes and young runners. Participants can run individually or register as a team for the corporate competition. The event is known for its friendly, sporty atmosphere in the village of Renswoude, with routes through the surrounding area. Previous editions sold out quickly, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: 21 km half marathon, consisting of two laps of the 10.5 km route
10.5 km route through the village and surrounding area
1 km Kids Run for young runners
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day from 11:30 until half an hour before the start. A timing chip is attached to the back of each race number. All participants receive a medal after the event. Showers and changing rooms are available at De Hokhorst sports hall. Event photos will be posted on the website a few days afterwards, without names and with respect for privacy. Parking is available near De Hokhorst, a short walk away. The nearest train station is Veenendaal/De Klomp, with bus connections to Renswoude. Online advance registration is open until 5 November 2026; Kids Run registration is also possible on the day. Start times: half marathon at 13:45, 10 km at 14:00, Kids Run at 12:30.

name: Duifpoldertrainingsloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijfkosten zijn laag: 2 euro voor alle afstanden.

description: The Duifpolder training run is a small-scale running race through the beautiful Duifpolder between Schipluiden and Maasland. Organised in spring and autumn by De Hardloper Schipluiden, the event offers three distances: 3.5 km, 7 km and 11.7 km. The race starts at 14:00 at the Trambrug in Schipluiden, close to the registration and changing venue. It’s an accessible event and ideal for training, with a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to chat afterwards in the IJsclub Vlietland clubhouse.
course_highlights: Small-scale race through the Duifpolder between Schipluiden and Maasland
Three distances to choose from: 3.5 km, 7 km and 11.7 km
Start at the Trambrug, close to the registration venue and clubhouse
additional: Registration takes place at the IJsclub Vlietland clubhouse, Zouteveenseweg 2a, Schipluiden. Registration opens at 12:45. Changing facilities and toilets are available, but there are no showers. Drinks are available in the clubhouse after the race. Start location: Trambrug, Schipluiden; no shower facilities; drinks available after the race

name: Plantsoenloop
description: The Plantsoenloop Groningen is Groningen’s oldest and most beautiful running race, suitable for young and old, with four different distances. This atmospheric event takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, and takes participants along a beautiful hilly course through Noorderplantsoen. This 68th edition is a true running classic that should not be missed in your calendar.
course_highlights: Beautiful hilly course
Run through Noorderplantsoen
Four different distances for all ages
additional: Four different distances, course through Noorderplantsoen, organised from Sportcentrum Kardinge

name: Salbam Lemelerbergloop
description: The Salbam Lemelerbergloop is a challenging cross-country race held on the Lemelerberg near Ommen. The race is part of the Vechtdal Cross Competitie and offers several distances: a 2 km youth race and approximately 6 km and 12 km races for adults. The course is entirely off-road and hilly, with significant elevation changes in the Lemelerberg nature reserve, the largest nature reserve managed by Landschap Overijssel. The race is ideal for runners who enjoy a challenging trail run in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Entirely off-road course
Hilly terrain with significant elevation changes
Lemelerberg nature reserve near Ommen
additional: Start times: 2 km youth race at 12:30, 6 km at 13:00, 12 km at 14:00. The race is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competitie, which consists of five races in total. To be eligible for the overall win, participants must take part in and finish four of the five races. Several distances, start times for youth and adults, and part of a regional cross-country competition.

name: Schipholloop
location: Amsterdam Airport Schiphol, Haarlemmermeer, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Schipholloop returns on 7 November 2026 as a unique running event around Amsterdam Airport Schiphol. With a rich history spanning more than 50 years, this 60-kilometre ultrarun offers a pure, partially self-supported trail experience focused on the experience and the challenge. Participants can choose from several distances, including a half marathon and the ultrarun, and enjoy a beautiful route through the varied polder landscape, with breathtaking views. With a limited field of no more than 100 participants, it is an exclusive and unforgettable run for long-distance runners of all levels.
course_highlights: An iconic 60 km ultrarun around the Haarlemmermeerpolder
Beautiful, varied surroundings with unexpected and breathtaking views
Trail-style run with GPS navigation and full autonomy
additional: A maximum of 100 participants per edition. Not a traditional race with tape and traffic marshals. The run is partially self-supported and trail-style, with GPS navigation and fixed checkpoints. A special tryout edition was held on 23 May ahead of the November edition. Limited to 100 participants, with facilities such as drop bags, aid stations with drinks and snacks, and medals for finishers. The event emphasises the experience and natural surroundings, and is organised as a private initiative and by AV Haarlemmermeer.

name: Waalbosrun
location: Bezoekerscentrum De IJsvogel, Rijsoord, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Waalbosrun is a fun and sporty running event organised by IJsclub Rijsoord in collaboration with De IJsvogel visitor centre. Participants follow a beautiful route through the Waalbos in Rijsoord, along green paths, waterways and wooded areas. The event is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners, with different distances for all ages. The start and finish are at the visitor centre, where supporters are welcome to cheer on the runners. Alongside sport, the event celebrates a friendly atmosphere and community spirit, and part of the proceeds go to charity.
course_highlights: A beautiful route through the Waalbos along green paths
Run alongside waterways and through wooded areas
Start and finish at De IJsvogel Visitor Centre
additional: There are three distances: the Kidsrun (approx. 1.8 km) starts at 12:00, the 10 km starts at 13:00, and the 5 km starts at 13:10. The start and finish are at De IJsvogel Visitor Centre. The event is suitable for all ages, and part of the proceeds go to charity. Participants contribute to a good cause; the event takes place in autumn, when cool and changeable weather is expected.

name: Watersley Halloween Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 KM WALK € 15 Walk the trail in a small group. Pick a time slot between 18:20 and 20:00.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 KM RUN € 15 Run the short loop through the forest. Joint start at 18:00. Your time gets recorded.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 KM RUN € 18 The full route. The darkest parts of the park and forest. Joint start at 18:00.

description: The Watersley Halloween Trail takes place on Saturday, 7 November 2026, in Sittard. Participants can choose from a 5 km walk, a 5 km run or a challenging 10 km run through the darkness of Watersley park and forest. The evening begins with an exciting experience in the Haunted House at Watersley Plaza and ends at The Monastery with a free drink. The routes are atmospherically lit and feature hidden actors, creating a unique and spooky trail experience.
course_highlights: Start in the Haunted House with an exciting walkthrough experience
Routes through the park and forest with 14 illuminated points and hidden actors
Finish at The Monastery with a free drink (hot chocolate or lemonade)
additional: The start location is Watersley Plaza, Watersley 31, Sittard. The 5 km walk takes place in small groups, with flexible start times between 18:20 and 20:00. The 5 km and 10 km runs start together at 18:00 and are timed using RaceGorilla. Minimum age: 8 years for the 5 km and 16 years for the 10 km. Children under 12 may participate only when accompanied by an adult. Parking is free. The trail includes forest paths and illuminated points, a Haunted House experience, free parking and a free drink at the finish. Registration is available for both timed and untimed routes, with age restrictions for each distance.

name: Zuidduinloop
location: Katwijk aan Zee, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Zuidduinloop is part of the Duinloopcircuit, a unique running series along the most beautiful coastal areas of the Netherlands. The race offers a varied course with challenging dune trails and fast beach sections, suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners. The atmosphere is always fantastic, and the event invites everyone to enjoy running outdoors. The Zuidduinloop takes place in Katwijk aan Zee and is part of a series of running events held throughout the year.
course_highlights: Varied course with dune trails and beach sections
Unique coastal setting in Katwijk aan Zee
Suitable for a range of ages and abilities
additional: There are rankings for all distances, separated into girls/women and boys/men, based on the four best results in the circuit. Race in Katwijk aan Zee, with various distances including short kids’ runs and longer races, plus GPX routes and results.

name: Knallende Kilometer
location: Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas, Bergschenhoek, South Holland, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kosten € 7,50 om deel te nemen inclusief een pannenkoek OF kop snert van Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas.

description: De Knallende Kilometer is a unique running event organized by Athletics and Walking Club De Kieviten, taking place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas in Bergschenhoek. It is a time-trial start, with each runner setting off individually at 30-second intervals, giving you the chance to run a fast kilometer on a straight, flat course. Afterward, instead of a medal, you’ll receive a delicious pancake or a warm bowl of snert as a reward. The event is open to both competitive runners and recreational runners looking to enjoy a friendly run.
course_highlights: Straight, flat 1,000-meter course on the cycle path above the Rottemerentunnel
Start near the 'Zwijnenplaats' car park and finish near the 'Mollenplaats' car park
Individual time-trial start from 11:00, with a new runner setting off every 30 seconds
additional: Collect your race number at Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas. The best place to park is Mollenplaats. After finishing, you’ll receive a pancake or a bowl of snert at the restaurant. Participants will receive their start time by email one week before the event. On-the-day registration is not possible, and places are limited. Flat, 1,000-meter course on the cycle path above the Rottemerentunnel; start at Familierestaurant Bergsche Plas; parking at Mollenplaats; advance registration required.

name: Athlos Hydro Trail Run
description: The Athlos Hydro Trail Run takes place on Saturday, November 7, in Harderwijk, Veluwe. This trail run offers a challenging route through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Veluwe, where participants can enjoy autumn scenery and water crossings. The event is organized by Atletiekvereniging Athlos, known for its involvement in the local running community. The Hydro Trail Run is a sporting and recreational event for trail runners who enjoy a varied course.
course_highlights: Trail run through the natural surroundings of the Veluwe
Beautiful autumn scenery
Water crossings and challenging terrain
additional: Photos from the 2025 edition are available in various albums. The start and finish of the routes are in the center of Harderwijk. The organizers use mobile photographers to capture water fun and other moments. Trail run over varied terrain, including forest, heathland, and sand; registration open; collaboration with sponsors; practical information and results available.

name: Slangenburg trailrun
description: The Slangenburg Trailrun takes place on Saturday, 7 November 2026, at De Pokkershutte in IJzevoorde. This trail run takes you along winding forest paths and unpaved routes, surrounded by the beautiful autumn colours of the Slangenburg forest. There are four distances to choose from, including a special Kidsrun for young trail runners aged 6 and up, and an official half marathon of 21.1 kilometres. The atmosphere is relaxed, with the focus on enjoying nature and exercising outdoors, without an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Winding forest paths and unpaved routes
Autumn colours in the Slangenburg forest
Official half marathon route of over 21 kilometres
additional: There are aid stations along the way with drinks and snacks. First aid is available during the trail run. Parents may accompany their child during the Kidsrun, provided they are registered themselves and have a race number. After the event, every participant receives a free bowl of split pea soup with rye bread and bacon. Free parking is available at the venue. There is no awards ceremony; the focus is on having fun and enjoying nature. Drinks and snacks are available to buy at De Pokkershutte after the event. Trail through forests, online registration, start and finish at De Pokkershutte, free parking, parents may accompany children, no awards ceremony

name: JM ATB toertocht
location: Restaurant de Babbelaar, Oostkapelle, Zeeland, Netherlands
description: The JM ATB tour is an annual mountain bike ride held on the first Saturday of November in Oostkapelle. The beautifully marked 30 and 50 km routes take riders through forests, country lanes, dikes and surprising trails on Walcheren, without going onto the beach. The ride starts between 08:30 and 10:00 at restaurant De Babbelaar, where participants can also enjoy food and drinks and chat after the ride. It attracts more than 300 to 400 participants each year and is known for its excellent organisation and on-route support.
course_highlights: 30 and 50 km routes through forests, country lanes and along dikes
Beautiful, varied trails on Walcheren
On-route refreshment station and bike-washing facility after the ride
additional: You can start between 08:30 and 10:00 from restaurant De Babbelaar, Dorpsstraat 18, Oostkapelle. There is a refreshment station along the route and first aid is available. After the ride, firefighters will wash bikes at the fire station. Helmets are compulsory; participation is at your own risk. There are no showers and no breakdown support, so bring your own repair kit. Parking is available near the start location. Routes pass through forests, country lanes and along dikes; start and finish at restaurant De Babbelaar; register in advance via inschrijven.nl; participation is at your own risk, helmet compulsory; no showers; first aid available; no breakdown support; car parking at Domburgseweg/Ambachtsstraat and Dorpsstraat

name: Feesteloop
price_range: Kinderloop: 6-7 euro, 5 km en 10 km: 12-14 euro, teamrun: 18-21 euro
description: The Feesteloop in Avelgem is a friendly, sporty running event taking place on Saturday, 7 November 2026. The event offers several distances, including a 10 km race and various kids’ runs, and is suitable for both recreational runners and teams. The start and finish are centrally located, with changing rooms and showers available at the Ter Muncken sports complex. The team run combines 5 km and 2.5 km legs, with handovers in a closed-off zone, making the event suitable for teams and clubs as well.
course_highlights: 10 km run through Avelgem
Kids’ runs of 500, 750 and 1,000 metres
Team run with handovers in a closed-off transition zone
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the Ter Muncken sports complex. In the team run, the first runner covers 5 km, followed by two runners who each cover 2.5 km, with handovers in a closed-off transition zone. The kids’ runs start at 14:00, with different distances for boys and girls born in 2019 or later. Participants can choose 2 or 4 laps of 2.5 km, with a festive atmosphere and podium ceremonies. Online registration is available until 6 November.

name: Dom Verdan Trail
description: On Saturday 7 November, it’s happening again: the Dom Verdan Trail! Run the beautiful trails around Reutum in Twente. This year, choose between two routes: approximately 10 and 19 km! And of course, enjoy some tasty food and drinks afterwards! Sign up soon, as the number of starting places is limited!

name: 14. Sollingquerung
description: The Solling Crossing is a unique run from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen, taking place on November 7, 2026. The course is run exclusively by GPS, as it is not marked, making the event particularly challenging and exciting. The field is limited to 100 participants, creating a friendly atmosphere. The start is at 9:00 a.m., after runners are taken by bus from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen at 7:45 a.m. A tip for runners: anyone who completes the marathon distance at the Solling Run on June 6, 2026, is guaranteed a starting place in the Solling Crossing.
course_highlights: Course from Bad Karlshafen to Dassel
No course markings; GPS navigation only
Aid stations along the course
additional: Start at 9:00 a.m. after the 7:45 a.m. bus ride from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen. Field limited to 100 participants. No course markings; GPS navigation only. Tip: A starting place is guaranteed to participants in the Solling Run marathon on June 6, 2026. The course is unmarked, GPS navigation is required, November weather may bring rain and temperatures of around 2–7°C, no on-site entries are possible, and the event sells out quickly.

name: 6. Weserbergland Backyard Ultra
description: The Weserbergland Backyard Ultra Run is a unique ultrarunning event in Höxter, North Rhine-Westphalia, held every year in November. Participants run a lap of about 6.7 kilometers every hour until only one runner remains. The race stands out for its distinctive challenge and the camaraderie among runners. The event is known for its demanding course and the impressive performances of participants, who often run for many hours and cover many kilometers.
course_highlights: A course of approximately 6.7 km per lap
A loop course with challenging climbs on the Heiligenberg
A run through varied terrain in the Weserbergland
additional: The race traditionally starts at 10 a.m. Registration usually fills up quickly, and the field often reaches capacity early. There is currently no waiting list. The event is organized by TuS Lütmarsen e. V. Participant numbers are limited to ensure the quality and safety of the event. It is one of Germany's last major Backyard events of the year, with typical November weather and long nights. Registration opens on 1 May 2026.

name: Freundschaftslauf der LLG Wustweiler
description: The 22nd Friendship Run of LLG Wustweiler takes place on November 7, 2026, at the Dorfwaldhalle Wustweiler. The event begins at 1:00 p.m. with the Wustweiler Beaver Trail (WuBiT), a challenging trail route, followed at 3:00 p.m. by running and walking groups. This is not a race and there is no timing; the focus is instead on enjoying exercise in nature and in good company. The route follows official forest paths and trails, with a small refreshment station at kilometer 12. Afterwards, participants can gather for food and drinks in the hall.
course_highlights: Challenging route along official forest paths and trails
Small refreshment station at kilometer 12 (no cups)
Three groups at different running paces, accompanied by LLG runners
additional: This is not a race and there is no timing. There are three groups at different paces (6–6:30, 7–7:30, and 8–8:30 min/km), accompanied by experienced LLG runners. The running and walking groups each run or walk for one hour. The route is approximately 7 to 11 km for runners and 5 to 6 km for walkers/hikers. The GPX file for the route is available to download. The event is part of the LLG Illtal Cup, together with the Illinger City Run and the Benin Benefit Run. A hot-air balloon ride will be raffled among participants who complete all three events (participants must be 18 or older; LLG members are not eligible). No race or timing; challenging forest paths and trails; trail shoes are recommended; participation is at your own risk; social gathering after the run.

name: Geilenkirchener Crosslauf
location: Teverener Heide, Geilenkirchen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Geilenkirchen Cross Country Run takes place on 7 November 2026 in the Teverener Heide near Geilenkirchen. Organized by ATV Geilenkirchen, the event has offered a compact, local program since 2006, with distances from 1.1 km to 9.2 km for adults, young people, and children. The course is a true cross-country route with some substantial undulations, running through the heathland and starting and finishing at the Grotenrath parking lot. With usually 101 to 300 participants, the race has a friendly club atmosphere in a natural setting.
course_highlights: A true cross-country course with substantial undulations
Run through the heathland of the Teverener Heide
Start and finish at the Grotenrath parking lot
additional: The race takes place in November, with typical November weather of around 7 °C and rainy days. Participant numbers are usually between 101 and 300 runners. Separate races are held for adults, young people, and children. Run in the Teverener Heide, cross-country race with various distances, more of a club atmosphere, November weather with rain and temperatures around 2–7°C

name: Heiner-Mayr-Staffelberglauf
description: The Heiner Mayr Staffelberg Relay is a challenging mountain relay taking place on November 7, 2026, in Bad Staffelstein. Organized by TSV 1860 Staffelstein e.V. with support from Sparkasse Coburg-Lichtenfels, the route covers 3,960 meters and 260 meters of elevation gain, from the start on Hirtengasse-Horsdorfer Straße up to the Staffelberg plateau at the Adelgundis Chapel. Runners can expect a challenging race with impressive views across the Franconian countryside. The race pays tribute to decades of dedication to running in the region.
course_highlights: 3,960-meter course with 260 meters of elevation gain
Start on Hirtengasse-Horsdorfer Straße in Bad Staffelstein
Finish on the Staffelberg plateau at the Adelgundis Chapel, with panoramic views
additional: Mountain relay, starts at 2 p.m., finish on the Staffelberg plateau, registration until November 6, 2026, open to all age groups

name: Internationaler Fackellauf
description: The 45th International Torch Run in Rodenbach takes place on November 7, 2026, and offers a challenging 7 km course for adults. The course is a hilly loop with a total of 92 metres of ascent and descent, appealing to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers alike. In addition to the main event, there are also races for children and young people; details can be found in the organizer’s official race announcement. The start is at 18:00, and all events share the same finish.
course_highlights: 7 km hilly loop
92 metres of ascent and descent
Very challenging, hilly course
additional: Races for children and young people are offered; see the organizer’s official race announcement for details. All events share the same finish location. The exact finish location display requires RUNME Premium. The event takes place on November 7, 2026, starting at 18:00, with accommodation options near the start and finish area. The event is part of the Red Cross’s international humanitarian commitment, conveying a message of hope and peace.

name: Lauf der 17. OIE-Nahe-Crosslaufserie
description: The OIE-Nahe Cross-Country Series is a long-running running series held in the region around Idar-Oberstein. It includes several races on varied cross-country courses, catering to both middle- and long-distance runners. Participants who take part in at least four races in the series receive a series gift—in 2026, sports socks. The series is organized by TuS Oberbrombach and places great emphasis on community and the enjoyment of sport.
course_highlights: Varied cross-country courses in the Idar-Oberstein region
Middle- and long-distance races with challenging sections
Series standings with attractive gifts for frequent participants
additional: Participants who take part in at least four races in the series receive a series gift (sports socks for the middle- and long-distance races). Sock size must be specified when registering. Children’s races have a different gift. After a weather-related cancellation, a replacement date of 08.02.2026 was set. Registrations remain valid; if participants cannot attend, the entry fee may be refunded. Dates in various locations, registration with sock size, weather-related date change, series standings, WhatsApp channel

name: Limes- Winterlaufserie - 1. Lauf über 10 km
description: The Limes Winter Running Series is a three-part winter running series in Pohlheim. The first race, a 10 km run, forms the basis for the overall standings. The series attracts runners from the region, particularly from the Lahn-Dill district, and has a long tradition, with its 49th edition taking place in 2026. The race offers a great opportunity to compete with other runners during the colder months and kick off the winter running series.
course_highlights: 10 km run through Pohlheim, Watzenborn-Steinberg
Part of a three-race winter running series
Popular race with regional participation, particularly from the Lahn-Dill district
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, usually rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Please check the details with the organizer before registering. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge in a wintry atmosphere. The event is open to runners of all ability levels and also provides results and participant lists.

name: Pokallauf
description: The “Rund um Marienberg” Cup Race is a traditional running event held in the Marienberg region. Competitions are held in classic and freestyle technique, with distances of 5 km and 10 km, each run on a 2.5 km loop. The event offers runners of various age groups and ability levels a sporting challenge in a scenic setting. Due to the current snow conditions, technical and course adjustments may affect how the competition is run.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances on a 2.5 km loop
Classic technique for U6–U9; freestyle technique from U10
New 10 km distance from H21
additional: The event is organized by ATSV Gebirge/Gelobtland e.V. The event announcement will not be updated. Competition technique depends on age group: U6–U9 use classic technique with a mass start; U10 and older use freestyle technique with a mass start. Depending on snow conditions, the route may vary, with adjustments to technique and distance. It is a popular event for runners seeking nature and a challenge.

name: Rülzheimer Crosslauf
description: The Rülzheim Cross Country Run, organized by LG Rülzheim, takes place on November 7, 2026, at Peter-Becht-Stadion in Rülzheim. The event offers two distances, 1.1 km and 8.4 km, on a compact cross-country course within the stadium grounds and neighboring areas. Unlike road races, the course crosses varied terrain and features new obstacles introduced by organizer Otto Pfadt. The run is part of a series of events organized by LG Rülzheim, including the Südpfalz Runs near the Moby Dick leisure center.
course_highlights: Compact cross-country course in the stadium and neighboring areas
New obstacles on the course
November event, with typically cool and rainy weather
additional: The start is at Peter-Becht-Stadion in Rülzheim. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. This is not a road race but a cross-country run with obstacles. The race takes place within the stadium grounds; obstacles are present, and weather-dependent conditions may be possible in November. Ask on site for details.

name: SCC Cross Country
description: The SCC Cross Country is a forest race in Berlin at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage in Westend. Two clearly defined cross-country routes are offered: 4 km for U16 through adults and 9 km for U18 through adults; both races start in the morning. The event is deliberately straightforward and is aimed at club runners, young athletes and adults who want to run short off-road loops, setting it apart from the city’s major road races. The course follows paved and unpaved forest paths, where rhythm, sure footing and a fast finish matter more than scenic views. Awards go to the top three in each age and gender category, and there is a prize for the fastest final lap for men and women.
course_highlights: Forest race on paved and unpaved forest paths
Two routes: 4 km for U16 through adults, 9 km for U18 through adults
Focus on rhythm, sure footing and a fast finish
additional: Entry is free for SCC members. Late registration is available shortly before the start for an additional fee. An archive of results is available to document the race. The event takes place at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage on Harbigstraße in Westend, Berlin-Charlottenburg. Typical November weather is around 7 °C, with rainy days. Forest race on paved and unpaved forest paths, entry fee for non-members, late registration for an additional fee, November weather around 7 °C, rainy.

name: Schkölener Stadtparklauf
description: The Schkölen Stadtparklauf is a long-standing running event in Schkölen, Thuringia, taking place on November 7, 2026. Organized by TSV 1885 Schkölen and SSV Friedrich-Schiller-Gymnasium Eisenberg, the event offers various distances for children, teenagers, and young adults. The routes run through the town park and include short and long loops, combined according to age group. The event emphasizes clear age-group divisions and is aimed particularly at young runners.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.6 km to 5 km, tailored to age groups
Loops through the town park, combining short and long loops
Age groups determined by calendar year for fair competitions
additional: Age groups are determined by calendar year; for example, a 6-year-old runner in 2025 belongs to age group 6. Participants are asked to enter the correct age group when registering late. Various running distances, age-group divisions, registration with the correct age, looped running on the sports field

name: Sparkassen-LüneCross
description: The Sparkassen-LüneCross is an exciting and challenging cross-country running event set amid nature and the city of Lüneburg. The varied course follows sandy, root-covered trails, meadows, forest paths and gravel tracks, testing endurance, strength and running technique. Main races are offered over 4 km and 8 km, along with shorter distances for children and young people and 8 km relay races. Alongside the sporting challenge, the focus is on the enjoyment of running and community, with a school competition and a convivial awards ceremony afterwards.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with sandy, root-covered trails
Routes through meadows, forest paths and gravel tracks
8 km relay races can be run by teams of 3 to 6 runners
additional: There is a school competition with prizes for schools with the highest participation rate. Food and refreshments are available, followed by an awards ceremony and a convivial get-together. Relay teams of 3 to 6 runners can be formed from family, colleagues, teammates or friends. The route passes through natural surroundings, including forest paths, meadows, sand and gravel. Registration is required; family and group participation is possible.

name: TSV Bayer 04 Talent- und Speed-Cross
description: The TSV Bayer 04 Talent and Speed Cross in Leverkusen is an established cross-country race, serving in particular as a talent scout event for school-age categories up to U16, as well as for the U18 and older age groups. The event is a regular fixture on the Nordrhein Cross Cup calendar and features a varied course on the grass auxiliary field at the Fritz-Jacobi-Anlage. With a tight schedule and exciting races, including cross sprints, it offers an engaging experience for both participants and spectators. The event is attracting growing numbers of participants and is accompanied by good catering and professional commentary.
course_highlights: Varied course on the grass auxiliary field at the Fritz-Jacobi-Anlage
Part of the Nordrhein Cross Cup for age groups M/W 11 to 15
Exciting cross sprints, particularly in the U18 category
additional: The event saw an increase of almost 200 participants. Good catering and professional commentary are provided. The races follow one another in a tight schedule. Dates in November 2026; cross-country race as part of the Nordrhein Cross Cup; various age groups; competition on unpaved terrain.

name: Westerwinkellauf
location: Wasserschloss Westerwinkel, Ascheberg-Herbern, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Westerwinkellauf is a traditional fun run around Westerwinkel moated castle in Ascheberg-Herbern. The course runs mainly along park paths and offers scenic surroundings. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ages and uses modern Race Result timing. The start and finish areas are at the sports and swimming hall in Herbern. Local partners provide refreshments, and professional commentary helps create a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course runs mainly along park paths around Westerwinkel moated castle
Start and finish at the sports and swimming hall in Herbern
Scenic running surroundings with good facilities
additional: Timing is provided by Race Result using a disposable chip attached to the race bib, which is collected at the finish. No refunds for non-participation. Parking is available in the schoolyard of Mariengrundschule. Commentary by Janik Broszeit from Dortmund. Refreshments for participants and spectators provided by Getränke Zimmermann. Courses, start times, site map, registration, results, certificates, running and walking categories, participation for school groups, free participation for registered pupils.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim
description: The Rodgau Winter Running Series is a traditional running event that has been held in Rodgau since 1980, attracting recreational runners as well as top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series features four race dates, each with 5 km and 10 km routes through the Jügesheim Forest, described as fast and flat. The event takes place at the Maingau-Energie Stadium in Rodgau Jügesheim and offers team rankings for men’s, women’s and mixed teams. The organization receives high praise, and there is a COVID-safe outdoor changing area. Timing is handled with a bib chip.
course_highlights: A flat, fast route through the Jügesheim Forest
Event held at the Maingau-Energie Stadium in Rodgau Jügesheim
Team rankings for men’s, women’s and mixed teams
additional: Start times: 5 km at 14:00, 10 km at 15:00. Chip timing using a bib chip (gun-time recording). The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. Club members receive a 50% discount on the entry fee when registering by email. Payment is in cash on site. There is a COVID-safe outdoor changing area (covered). The route is very popular for personal bests. The event takes place on four Saturdays: 1.11.2025, 6.12.2025, 3.1.2026, 7.2.2026. The series comprises several races, with chip timing and refreshments at the stadium. Teams of three are possible. The event is also geared toward winter training, with training plans provided.

name: Augsburger AOK-Winterlaufserie Südring
description: The Augsburg AOK Winter Running Series organized by TG Viktoria Augsburg consists of four races through the beautiful Western Forests Nature Park. The courses run through hilly terrain in the western forests of Augsburg and require good fitness and health. The event offers age-group rankings and an overall ranking with attractive prizes and trophies. The races take place on Saturdays and one Sunday in November and December and are a popular series for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Western Forests Nature Park
Hilly terrain with challenging sections
Course distances of approximately 2.8 to 3.2 km per race
additional: Race numbers are distributed in the start/finish area each time. Portable toilets are available at the Kathreinerstraße car park (races 1–3), and there is space to leave a change of clothes or luggage in a tent or pavilion (at your own risk). Finish refreshments include tea, water and a cake buffet at races 1–3; the fourth race also offers mulled wine and children’s punch. The overall awards ceremony takes place at the forest hut after the fourth race. Parking is available in Bergheim, on Kathreinerstraße and on surrounding streets, but not at the Bergheim sports clubhouse. Races take place in November, with distances ranging from approximately 2.8 km to 9.9 km. The meeting point is usually by the forest car park near Kathreinerstrasse and Brennhölzerweg in Augsburg-Bergheim. November weather can be cool and rainy.

name: Hybrid Challenge Randers
description: Hybrid Challenge Randers 2025 is an indoor fitness race for both recreational runners and experienced athletes. The race consists of 5 km, with
