description: The Jigler Run by Night is Barneveld’s most atmospheric running event, taking place on Friday evening, 13 November 2026. The start and finish are at Sportpark Norschoten, the sports complex of SDV Barneveld. Participants can choose from a 5-kilometre run, a 10-kilometre run or the corporate run. The course passes through the Norschoten neighbourhood and offers an enjoyable, sporty evening, with atmosphere-enhancing accessories such as lights and fluorescent clothing. There is a special corporate run for businesses, with a pasta buffet beforehand and an after-party with a DJ and singer.
course_highlights: 5-kilometre course through the Norschoten neighbourhood
Start and finish at Sportpark Norschoten (SDV Barneveld)
The running course uses public roads, where normal traffic rules apply
additional: Toilets, changing rooms and showers are available. There are no lockers. The organisers are not liable for the loss of valuables. The corporate run requires at least three runners per team. A shared pasta buffet takes place before the corporate run, followed by an after-party with a DJ and singer. Parking is available at Sportpark Norschoten, Aeres, Schaffelaarse Bos and Vetkamp. Cycling is recommended. Parts of the route are not closed to traffic, so please pay attention to road safety. Atmosphere-enhancing accessories such as lights and luminous balloons are encouraged. The run is a nighttime event without official road closures, with parking available at SDVB and nearby. Registration is required.

name: Vijfhoekparkloop
description: Saturday, October 26 is the first Vijfhoekpark Run of 2024! The other runs are on November 9 and 30. This relaxed fun run takes pla

name: Lage Vuursche Trail
description: The Lage Vuursche Trail is a challenging, varied trail with many single tracks, sandy paths and forest trails, located in the unique area of the U

name: Hobbeldebobbelloop
description: The Hobbeldebobbelloop in Zoutelande is an annual running event, taking place this year on 14 November 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km and 11 km. The event is organized by Dynamica and offers a great opportunity to run in the area around Zoutelande. For more details about registration and facilities, please contact the organizers.
course_highlights: Choose between a 6 km or 11 km course
Run in the area around Zoutelande, Zeeland
Organized by Dynamica
additional: Registration via an external link; the event takes place on 14 November 2026 between 14:30 and 17:00.

name: Wine and Dine Buitenpepers
description: Wine and Dine Buitenpepers is a welcoming neighbourhood dinner taking place on Saturday evening, 14 November, in Buitenpepers, a lively neighbourhood in ’s-Hertogenbosch. The event brings local residents together for an unforgettable evening of good company, delicious food and wine, held throughout the neighbourhood. It is a wonderful opportunity to meet one another and strengthen the community in a warm, festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Neighbourhood meal with a variety of dishes
Friendly and festive atmosphere
Strengthening the community
additional: The event is a neighbourhood dinner held throughout the area, where residents gather to share a meal and wine. It is a social event, not a competition, organised by the De Buitenpepers neighbourhood association. Activities calendar, neighbourhood gatherings, neighbourhood meal, neighbourhood dinner, community support

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 1. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a long-standing running event held in the Buseck/Alten-Buseck region. It comprises several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and a half marathon (21.1 km). The races each start at 2:00 p.m. at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck and offer a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. The series promotes a sense of community with a series classification for participants who take part in all three races. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the fastest runners follow the finish.
course_highlights: Course profiles for 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km are available on Komoot
Start and finish at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck
Timing with a passive transponder from Raceresult
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. There is a series classification for participants who take part in all three races in the series. After finishing, runners receive a complimentary soft drink. Coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at the Harbig Hall. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, recognising the three fastest participants (men/women) in each race on the day, as well as the age-group winners at the end of the series. Winter running series, cross-country character, several race distances, community event in November 2026

name: Bezirksmeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The District Cross-Country Championships in Velpke are a long-standing cross-country running competition organized by the NLV Braunschweig District. The event gives runners of various age groups, from children to Masters, the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The course crosses varied terrain and offers a challenging test for all participants. Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, and the event takes place on February 8, 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country course through varied terrain
Competition for children, youth, adults, and Masters
Organized by the NLV Braunschweig District in Velpke
additional: Online registration is open until February 1, 2026, at 23:59. The organizer is the NLV Braunschweig District. The event category is 6.4.2 District Championships. Cross-country terrain; registration deadline is February 1, 2026; various course distances, including children’s and youth categories.

name: Biegerparklauf
location: Biegerpark, Duisburg-Huckingen, Duisburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Biegerparklauf in Duisburg-Huckingen is an officially DLV-measured race on asphalt, with distances of 1.2 km for schoolchildren, 5 km for everyone, and 10 km for youth and adults. The races follow a loop through Biegerpark, with the final 300 meters run on the stadium’s cinder track. All participants receive certificates; schoolchildren and Bambinis receive Weckmänner, and the top runners are awarded medals. The event is organized by Sportgemeinschaft Duisburg-Süd 98/20 e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Loop through Biegerpark on asphalt
10 km runners complete 3 laps; 5 km runners complete 2 laps
The final 300 meters are on the stadium’s cinder track
additional: Late entries are possible in limited numbers on the event day, up to 30 minutes before the start. Certificates are issued online and at the venue, where there may be a wait. Schoolchildren and Bambinis receive Weckmänner at the finish. The event provides sports liability insurance under the NRW sports aid insurance agreement. The final 300 meters are run on the stadium’s cinder track. Course: loop through Biegerpark, paved paths, final 300 m on the cinder track; dates and registration by email; start times for different age groups; medals and Weckmänner for children.

name: Bokeler 6 Stundenlauf
description: The Bokeler 6-Hour Run is an established ultramarathon challenge in northern Germany, held in Bokel, Schleswig-Holstein. Participants run a loop course approximately 3.67 kilometres long, completing as many laps as possible in six hours. The event attracts endurance athletes looking to test their limits and offers a family-friendly atmosphere in scenic surroundings.
course_highlights: 3.67 km loop course
Flat terrain in Schleswig-Holstein
Six-hour run with individually determined distance
additional: The course is a loop that runners complete multiple times. The event is a longstanding tradition and takes place annually. Results from previous years are available on the website. The race is held on a 2,040 m loop course, with a growing number of participants and a legendary refreshment buffet. A participant record was set in 2023, and the event was already fully booked well in advance for 2024. November weather is usually cool and rainy, adding to the challenge.

name: Deutsche Polizeimeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The German Police Cross-Country Championships are the police’s official cross-country running championships and focus on competition within the police force. The event takes place in Ravensbergerwald in Potsdam and features distances of 3.6 km and 9 km. The races are part of a wider German running series regulated by the German Athletics Association (DLV), with officially measured courses and professional timing. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The race offers a challenging cross-country experience in typical November weather, with cool temperatures and frequent rain.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in Ravensbergerwald
Officially measured courses of 3.6 km and 9 km
Part of the DLV-regulated police championships
additional: Typical November weather: around 7 °C, a low of 2 °C, an average of 45 mm of precipitation, and rainy days. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The event is not an open road race but is exclusively for police runners. It is not open to the general public and is organized within the police force. The challenging course includes uphill and downhill sections and sandy terrain.

name: Graal-Müritzer Schneckenlauf
description: The Graal-Müritz Schneckenlauf is a long-standing running event held annually at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium. Runners and walkers of all ages can choose from several distances, including a Bambini race, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and awards for the strongest classes and best teams. The Streuselschnecken pastries served after the finish are especially popular.
course_highlights: Red course: 2 km run
Blue course: 5 km and 10 km (2 x 5 km laps)
Start and finish at the Graal-Müritz Forest Stadium
additional: Start times: 10:00 a.m. Bambini race, 10:30 a.m. 2 km run, 11:00 a.m. 5 km and 10 km runs. Walkers start 5 minutes after the runners. Training for children takes place on Wednesdays from 4:30–6:00 p.m. in the sports hall at Ostseegrundschule. Traditional awards are given to the strongest class and best team. Streuselschnecken pastries are a popular post-race treat. The race takes place at the Forest Stadium. Advance registration is available, with categories for children and adults as well as team and class competitions.

name: Gudensberger Crosslauf 2026 Hermann Kilian Gedächtnislauf
description: The Gudensberg Crosslauf Hermann Kilian Memorial Run is a long-standing cross-country race in Gudensberg, offering short off-road distances. The start and finish are on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool on Schwimmbadweg. The course runs mostly on unpaved paths, and spikes are allowed, emphasizing its classic cross-country character. The event commemorates Hermann Kilian, a dedicated runner and coach with TSV Obervorschütz.
course_highlights: Start and finish on a dirt track and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool
Course mostly on unpaved paths; spikes allowed
Three distances: 1000m (two small laps), 2000m (two large laps), 4000m (one longer lap)
additional: Depending on the event announcement, district championships may be included. Typical November weather is expected, with temperatures around 7 °C and rainy days. November is usually rainy; the terrain has a cross-country style. The event honors Hermann Kilian for his dedication to running.

name: Herzowerke-Trail 2026
location: TSH sports grounds, Herzogenaurach, Bavaria, Germany
description: The 3rd Herzowerke Trail takes place on 14 November 2026 in Herzogenaurach. The trail starts and finishes at the TSH sports grounds and runs through the Dohnwald around the town. There are several distances from 0.5 km to 16 km; the longest distance can be run as one or two laps. This is a true forest trail, and poles are permitted. There are no refreshment stations along the course; refreshments are available only in the start and finish area. The event is organised by the running section of Turnerschaft Herzogenaurach.
course_highlights: Trail through the Dohnwald around Herzogenaurach
A true trail where poles are permitted
Refreshments only in the start and finish area; no support along the course
additional: There are several distances: 0.5 km Bambini Trail, 2 km Kids Trail, 4 km Youth Trail, 8 km Speed Trail and 16 km (one or two laps). Participants must be self-sufficient on the course; there are no drink or refreshment stations in the forest. Times, results and placings will be published online. The top three will be honoured. A trail with various distances, self-sufficiency required on forest sections, start and finish at the TSH sports grounds, results and placings online. Cold and wet November weather is possible.

name: Int. DEULUX-Lauf
description: The International DEULUX Run takes place annually on the second Saturday in November in Langsur and offers four different races for all age groups. From a 360-meter run for the youngest participants to the 10-kilometer road race—the largest 10-kilometer road race by number of participants in Rhineland-Palatinate—there is something for everyone. The event is part of the 4-Regio Cup and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization. Runners can look forward to varied courses and special awards.
course_highlights: Four different races, from 360 m to 10 km
The largest 10-kilometer road race by number of participants in Rhineland-Palatinate
Family-friendly event with a special award for every participant
additional: Start times: youngest participants’ race 13:30, children’s race 14:00, youth race 14:30, main race 15:00. All children’s races are free to enter. RFID chip timing for the children’s and youth races. Late entries are not possible, including on the day of the event. Several race distances, including children’s and youth races; registration will open in a few weeks. The event takes place in Langsur.

name: Kerner Nachtlauf
description: The Kerner Night Run is an atmospheric autumn race taking place on the evening of Saturday, November 14, 2026, in Kernen. Runners set off at dusk on a loop of approximately 4.5 km along illuminated paths through gardens, vineyards, and residential streets around Kernen. A 10 km distance is also offered. The event celebrates a passion for running and the shared enjoyment of sport in a special atmosphere.
course_highlights: An approximately 4.5 km loop along illuminated paths
The course passes through gardens, vineyards, and residential streets
Starts at dusk on Saturday evening
additional: Run along illuminated paths, with 4.5 km and 10 km options; an atmosphere enhanced by lights and torches; finish in the stadium with snacks and drinks

name: Landesoffener Crosslauf des KLV Segeberg
description: The KLV Segeberg open cross-country race takes place every November in Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park. It offers races for children, youth, adults and Masters, with distances ranging from approximately 625 m to 7.9 km. The event is open to runners from across Schleswig-Holstein. The course runs across meadows, parks and wooded areas, offering a varied alternative to traditional road or track races. The event is organised by KLV Segeberg and Kaltenkirchener TS, which also hosts it on site.
course_highlights: Distances of approximately 625 m to 7.9 km
The course runs through Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park, across meadows, parks and wooded areas
Open event with categories for children, youth, adults and Masters
additional: Typical November weather, around 7 °C, with rainy days. The event is part of the KLV Segeberg cross-country championship series, which also includes other local club venues in the Segeberg district. Cross-country running in November in typical rainy weather, with temperatures around 2–7 °C, on an outdoor course, suitable for trail running and cross-country fans.

name: Neusser Erftlauf
description: The Neuss Erftlauf is a traditional running event organized annually by DJK Novesia 1919 Neuss e.V. The 53rd edition takes place on 14 November 2026 and offers runners of different ability levels an attractive course along the Erft. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organization, and support from numerous sponsors. The 15 km main race is especially popular and has attracted many more participants in recent years.
course_highlights: 15 km main race with a construction detour; the 5 km loop is eligible for rankings
Course along the Erft with varied terrain
Refreshment stations and drinking water at Durstlöscher
additional: The Erftlauf is supported by numerous volunteers, who help ensure the event runs smoothly along the course, in the start and finish areas, and at refreshment stations. Sponsors include the RheinLand Versicherungsgruppe, Stadtwerke Neuss, and other partners. There is a construction detour on the 15 km course, but the 5 km loop remains eligible for rankings. An extensive photo album is available online. Courses on paved paths and roads; spikes are not allowed; online registration opens on 01.09.2025; start times from 11:30 a.m.; medals for children; prizes in kind for winners; limited parking; showers available.

name: Potsdamer Cross im Rahmen der 22. DPM
description: The 2nd Potsdam Cross, held as part of the 22nd German Police Championships (DPM), takes place on November 14, 2026, in Potsdam. The event is organized and hosted by OSC Potsdam Luftschiffhafen e.V., Athletics Department. It offers runners the opportunity to compete in a challenging cross-country race and take part in a long-standing competition series. Registration is open until November 9, 2026.
course_highlights: Participation in the German Cross Championships (DPM)
Off-stadium course in Potsdam
Event held as part of a national championship
additional: The entry deadline is November 9, 2026; the scenic venue offers a varied cross-country course.

name: Potzberg-Berglauf
description: The Potzberg Mountain Run is a traditional hill race organised by TuS Glan-Münchweiler. The course covers 8.2 kilometres with 350 metres of elevation gain and offers runners a challenging experience in the beautiful landscape around Potzberg. The race takes place annually and attracts both ambitious runners and hill-running enthusiasts. The organisers thank their sponsors and are happy to answer any further questions.
course_highlights: Course distance: 8.2 kilometres
Elevation gain: 350 metres
Landscape around Potzberg
additional: The Potzberg Mountain Run is the 4th race in 2026. Results from previous races are available on the website. No events or registration dates are listed on the website. TuS Glan-Münchweiler can be contacted by telephone for further information. The race is part of the Pfälzer Berglauf-Pokal-Cup and has categories for adults and young people, as well as a convenient baggage and clothing transport service to the finish. The event takes place in November.

name: Steverlauf
location: Sportpark Senden, Senden, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Steverlauf is an established running event held annually at Sportpark Senden, welcoming runners of all ages. The courses over 5 km and 10 km, officially measured by the DLV, run along park paths and paths beside the canal, offering an attractive running setting. Children and young people have a separate entry option at a reduced entry fee. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers changing and shower facilities, as well as refreshments including coffee, cake, soup and bratwurst. The organizing team looks forward to welcoming many participants and to a successful event.
course_highlights: Courses over 5 km and 10 km, officially measured by the DLV
Routes run along park paths and paths beside the canal
Changing and shower facilities at Sportpark Senden
additional: Refreshments including coffee, tea, cake, biscuits, soup and bratwurst provided by roterkeil Senden e.V. The event takes place in all weather conditions. No liability for damages. Changing and shower facilities are available. Routes pass through Schloss Senden, along the canal and through Königspark; there is a good supply of cake, drinks and hot food; the event can take place in any weather.

name: Waldlauf
location: Remsecker Waldlauf, Hochdorfer Wald, Büchenbach, Bayern, Germany
description: The Remseck Forest Run is a family-friendly race through the picturesque Hochdorf Forest, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers a range of distances, from a Bambini run and children’s and youth races to short, middle- and long-distance races. The varied forest trails, with muddy, uneven ground and small obstacles, make the race a memorable and adventurous experience. The run is organized by Sport- und Gesangverein Hochdorf e.V. and places great importance on community and experiencing nature.
course_highlights: All routes lead through the beautiful Hochdorf Forest
Muddy, uneven ground and narrow trails with small obstacles
A variety of distances for children, young people and adults
additional: Race number collection: Friday, 16:30–18:00, and Saturday from 9:30. Each participant receives a race number with an integrated chip. Recycled technical shirts can be ordered online as an option until 05.09.2026 (children €15, adults €20). Late registration is possible on the event day until 60 minutes before the start; the late registration fee is €3.

name: Zeiler Waldmarathon
location: Zeil am Main, Haßberge, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Zeil Forest Marathon takes place on 14 November 2026 in Zeil am Main and offers challenging running routes through the Haßberge Nature Park. The course runs mainly along paved forest paths, following a varied route over Schlossberg and Bischofsheimer Höhe and past several lakes. Events include the marathon, half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking over 21.1 km and 7.5 km. The event is organised by TV 1884 Zeil and features professional timekeeping with an integrated chip.
course_highlights: Challenging course through the Haßberge Nature Park, almost entirely on paved forest paths
Route over Schlossberg and Bischofsheimer Höhe and past the Seven Lakes
Aid stations every 5 km with mineral water, tea, isotonic drinks, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the Setzbachbrunnen in the Zeil am Main running park. Timekeeping with an integrated chip. Marathon runners can switch to the half-marathon course after one lap. Parking is available at the indoor swimming pool and school car parks, as well as the Tuchanger car park, with a city bus transfer. Race number collection is at the school on Friday evening and Saturday morning. Showers and changing facilities are available in the school gym. There is no baggage storage in the start/finish area. Free buses run every 5 minutes from the school building to the start line. The course runs almost entirely along paved forest paths in the Haßberge Nature Park. Aid stations are available every 5 km. Race numbers include a chip. Parking is available at the indoor swimming pool and school car park, and showers and changing facilities are available in the school gym. Medals are awarded to all participants after the race, and a free bus transfer is available.

name: Griseriløbet
description: Griseriløbet is a traditional fun run held by Brande Motion. The race takes place on paths and roads around Brande, and the worse

name: De Kievitloop
description: During the autumn and winter months, Athletics Association SPADO organizes a special run on the third Sunday of every month in the wooded surroundings

name: Bertusloop
description: The Bertusloop is held on the 3rd Sunday of every month, except in July and August. This recreational fun run

name: Hafkamp Groenewegen De Ronde Venen Marathon
Chocolademelkloop
description: The Chocolademelkloop is a friendly family running event in the forests of Bilthoven, suitable for runners of all levels. On Sunday, November 15, 2026, participants can choose from distances of 1, 2, or 5 kilometers. The event is known for its warm atmosphere, delicious hot chocolate afterward, and the presence of Piets who take part in the run. It is a sporty, accessible event where young and old can enjoy being active in nature together.
course_highlights: Run through the forest of Bilthoven
Mostly unpaved paths
A friendly family run with Piets and hot chocolate
additional: Parents registered for the 2 or 5 km can join their child in the 1 km family run at no extra cost. The 1 km family run is aimed at children aged 3–8 and follows mostly unpaved forest paths. There is a prize draw, with prizes awarded among all participants regardless of their time. The start and finish area is at the Werkplaats in Bilthoven. Distances: 1 km, 2 km, 5 km; no timing; parents can run alongside their children for free; start and finish at the Werkplaats grounds

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplas, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a running series consisting of three races in November, January and February, organised by AAV'36 in Alphen aan den Rijn. The races take place around the Zegerplas and offer distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, as well as 400 m and 1,000 m youth races on the athletics track. The course is almost entirely free of traffic and runs through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas, making it suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The start and finish are on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers, a canteen and a massage room are also available.
course_highlights: An almost entirely traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around the Zegerplas
Distances range from 400 m for children to 20 km for adults
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with facilities including changing rooms and showers
additional: Official timekeeping is provided by MyLaps. Walkers can choose 5 km and 10 km routes, with a time limit of 2 hours; they start at the same time as the 20 km running race. There is no drinks station along the Aarkanaal because plastic cups are prohibited, but water is available at the finish and at a drinks station on the track for 15 km and 20 km runners on their second lap. Free leg massages are available in the massage room, provided by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn. Changing rooms, showers, a canteen and a limited number of lockers are available. Registration is via the website. Free leg massages are provided by Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn. Winter conditions are possible.

name: Sterke Start Loop 2026
description:
Whether you’re going for 5, 10 or 21 kilometres, every route takes you through the beautiful natural area around Zevenhuizen.
You’ll run alongside water, through the forest and on (mostly) paved paths. It’s a varied course, with a different challenge for each distance.
Whichever distance you choose, every step helps give the tiniest babies a strong start.
course_highlights: Routes through nature, alongside water and through the forest
Mostly paved surfaces, with unpaved paths on the 21 km route
1 km Kids Run with obstacles for children
additional:
Stand up for the tiniest babies
On Sunday 15 November, World Prematurity Day, the whole of the Netherlands gets moving during the Sterke Start Loop. The run for everyone who wants to give the tiniest babies a strong start.
The live event takes place in Zevenhuizen, but with your home-entry ticket you can take part wherever and whenever you like during the week leading up to 15 November.
New this year is the Kids Run in Zevenhuizen. Children run 1 km, with a few obstacles at the end. These symbolise the challenges that babies born prematurely have to overcome.
Together, we stand up for the tiniest babies. By taking part, you’ll raise money for research, kangaroo care chairs and parental support, and help give every child the best possible start.
Take part and make a difference.

name: Loetcross
description: The Loetcross in Lekkerkerk is a challenging cross-country race taking place on 15 November 2026. The course crosses varied terrain, including grass, shell paths and ditch edges, offering a varied and natural running experience. Several distances are available, ranging from 1.2 km to 7.2 km, to suit different ages and abilities. The race is known for its rugged character, so shoes are guaranteed not to stay clean. Pre-registration is open until 13 November 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country course over grass, shell paths and along ditch edges
Distances ranging from 1.2 km to 7.2 km
Natural, varied terrain with challenging sections
additional: Women may enter the 7.2 km long-distance race, but their participation is not included in the women’s competition or prize-giving. Shoes will not stay clean during the race because of the terrain. Fields marked with * are mandatory when registering. The event includes several race categories for different ages and abilities, and registration is required.

name: Bommelasloop
description: The Bommelasloop is a popular recreational trail run that has been organised by Rekreatie Sport Twente for many years. The run takes place in the beautiful Het Buurserzand Natura 2000 area, between Enschede and Haaksbergen. There are four different distances, so every runner can find a suitable challenge. The start is at 11:00, and participants receive a free refreshment afterwards. The atmosphere is relaxed and focused on recreation, with no prize-giving or medals.
course_highlights: Trail run in the Het Buurserzand Natura 2000 area
Four distances: 7.6 km, 11.7 km, 16 km and 20.5 km
Start and finish at Camping Twente in Enschede
additional: Late registration and race-number collection are possible on the day from 09:45 to 10:50, subject to availability. There is no prize-giving or medal, but participants can receive a refreshment by handing in their race number at the bar at the campsite. Cycling is recommended because parking is limited. Trail run in Buurserzand; registration on the day is possible; no prize-giving or medal; free refreshment afterwards; dogs and wheelchairs are not allowed.

name: Sytze Wetting Trail
location: Outdoor centrum Copini, Leeuwarden, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Sytze Wetting Trail is an annual trail run organised by AV Lionitas in the Lytse en Grutte Wielen nature reserve near Leeuwarden. The trail features an adventurous course made mostly of unpaved paths, grass and narrow trails, with enjoying nature at its heart. There are three distances: 19 km, 7.9 km and a 1 km Kids Run. The race is more challenging than a road race and requires good trail shoes or shoes with grip. Free snert is served to participants afterwards.
course_highlights: Mostly unpaved course through the Lytse en Grutte Wielen nature reserve
Adventurous route over grass and narrow trails
Your feet may get wet; good trail shoes or shoes with lugged soles are recommended
additional: Changing facilities and showers are available. Racks are provided for storing bags. Refreshments are available on the course and after the race. Please park at Kleine Wielen (Groene Ster), not at Restaurant Groote Wielen. After the race, free snert is provided by Restaurant de Groote Wielen. The trail runs through a nature reserve over unpaved terrain, with the start and finish near Outdoor centrum Copini, Leeuwarden, and refreshments and free snert afterwards.

name: 1. Volkslauf Seelze
description: The ADAC Marathon Hannover offers a varied running experience with distances from 4 to 42 km, including the marathon, half marathon, marathon relay, 10 km run and handbike marathon. The course is one of the flattest in Germany, with just 19 m of elevation difference, making it ideal for fast times. The event combines an urban atmosphere, modern music and green stretches, taking runners through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a varied programme of events featuring an expo, Power Party and finisher celebration.
course_highlights: Flat course with just 19 m of elevation difference
Route through the city centre and past notable Hannover landmarks
A range of distances from 4 to 42 km, including relay and handbike events
additional: Race packs are distributed at the Marathon Expo over marathon weekend. The course is very flat and therefore ideal for fast times. Live tracking is available via the ADAC Marathon app. Massage facilities and showers are available. The programme includes the ROSSMANN Power Party, the expo and a finisher party at the brewery. Free public transport on the event day is included. Information about the course, registration, results and photos is available on the event website. The race is part of a broad Laufpass programme featuring a variety of events in the Hannover region.

name: Bremer Kuhcross QX
description: The Kuhcross is a challenging and varied cross-country race organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen. It gives runners the opportunity to test themselves on demanding terrain and enjoy the ultimate cross-country experience. The event traditionally takes place in Bremen in November and attracts cross-country enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: Challenging and varied cross-country terrain
A traditional event in Bremen
Organised by ATS Buntentor Bremen
additional: The race is open to children, young people and active runners, with various categories and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Geislinger Volkslauf
description: The Geislingen Volkslauf is a long-established running event held annually in Geislingen. It offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages, including student races and an integration run. The course starts at the Schlossparkhalle and is known for its varied, well-organized route. The event is popular in the region and is hosted by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V.
course_highlights: Start at the Schlossparkhalle Geislingen
Student race for all school grades
Inclusion run for inclusive participation
additional: The Volkslauf takes place on Sunday, 15 November 2026. There are student races and an integration run. The event is organized by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V. The start is at 10:30 a.m. at the Schlossparkhalle. Runners can register online until 12 November 2025; the event includes children’s, youth, open and masters competitions.

name: itdesign-Nikolauslauf Probelauf
description: The itdesign Nikolauslauf in Tübingen is a traditional half marathon organized by Post-SV Tübingen since 1976. The course is officially measured and recognized as a road race, making it eligible for ranking lists. The route runs along finely graveled forest paths and paved sections with moderate climbs, and water, tea, and special sports drinks are available at several refreshment stations. A high-quality technical shirt is included in the entry fee for all participants and can be collected at the runners’ expo. In addition to the main race, there is also a 10 km school competition and a virtual 10 km race.
course_highlights: Officially measured half marathon (21.1 km), eligible for ranking lists
Finely graveled forest paths and approx. 8.5 km of paved paths
Maximum elevation difference approx. 82 meters; total elevation gain approx. 300 meters
additional: Refreshments at kilometers 5, 11, and 17 with water, tea, and UltraSports products; finish refreshments with raisin rolls, water, UltraRefresher, and hot tea; start and finish at Waldhäuser Straße 120, 72076 Tübingen, near the runners’ expo; runners’ expo and race office in the sports hall of Geschwister-Scholl-Schule; free Nikolauslauf app for current information and race bib management; high-quality technical shirt included in the entry fee, with the option to exchange it at the runners’ expo; shirts for virtual 10 km participants are shipped within Germany only. The test run takes place on November 16, 2025, is free, and requires no registration; run in groups with pacers; parking available at Geschwister-Scholl-Schule; finish refreshments with pretzels and vegetable broth; no shower facilities on site.

name: Jetzendorfer Hobby Crosslauf
description: The Jetzendorf Hobby Cross-Country Run is a local cross-country event held at LOWA Stadium in Jetzendorf, Bavaria. Organized by TSV Jetzendorf, the event takes place in November and offers various distances for different age groups. It is aimed at recreational runners, families, and club athletes, and is now in its 17th edition. In addition to the running races, there is also a Nordic walking course suitable for beginners and recreational walkers.
course_highlights: Cross-country running at LOWA Stadium Jetzendorf
Distances from 650 m to 5.8 km
Nordic walking course, approx. 2.9 km
additional: The program includes an 800 m stadium cross-country race for younger children, approx. 1,600 m for older children and teenagers, and the main race of approx. 5.8 km for older teenagers and adults. The event takes place in the morning in November. Typical November weather, with temperatures of approx. 7 °C and frequent rain, is to be expected. Several running distances and a Nordic walking option make the event ideal for families and recreational runners. The event takes place in November at LOWA Stadium.

name: Kreis Herbst Waldlauf Meisterschaften
description: The District Autumn Forest Running Championships take place on 15 November 2026 in Usingen/Merzhausen. This event is part of the traditional competitions organised by the HLV Hochtaunus District and gives runners in various age groups the opportunity to compete in cross-country running. The course winds through autumnal woodland and promises a varied, nature-filled running environment. The championships are an important fixture in the regional athletics calendar and support the development of young athletes.
course_highlights: Run through autumnal woodland
Nature-filled cross-country course
Event in Usingen/Merzhausen
additional: Weather-dependent event in November; no fixed distances for all categories; regional event with several participating clubs

name: Lila-Eule-Cross
description: The 37th Lila-Eule-Cross in Kappeln is a long-running cross-country race on the Schlei that is very popular with runners. At the most recent edition, 308 runners reached the finish, setting a participation record. The course is known for its autumn atmosphere and for being less muddy than in previous years, making the race especially appealing. The event is organised by the Schleswig-Holstein Athletics Association and offers a sporting challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Traditional cross-country race on the Schlei
Autumn atmosphere and strong performances
Less muddy course than in previous years
additional: Cross-country race on a varied course along the Schlei, including children’s and youth races, with a focus on autumn weather and state championships.

name: Offenbacher Behörden- und Volkswaldlauf
price_range: Erwachsene 6,00 EUR, Jugendliche U18/U20 3,00 EUR, U10-U16 1,00 EUR, Nachmeldung 2,00 EUR
description: The Offenbach Authorities and Volkswald Run is a traditional running event that has taken place annually since 1972. The race is open to municipal employees, company sports participants and guest runners, who compete on forest paths in Offenbach am Main. The course is 100% forest paths, with the start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings. In addition to individual events, there are team classifications, with trophies for the winners. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers shower and changing facilities as well as free refreshments after the finish.
course_highlights: Course consists entirely of forest paths
Start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings
Various distances for youth, adults and walkers
additional: The Authorities Forest Run takes place in all weather conditions. Shower and changing facilities are available at the Arbeiterwohlfahrt recreation grounds. Free tea is offered after the finish. The award ceremonies include trophies for team winners and individual events. For travel, participants are advised to use the car park at Nasses Dreieck, opposite the Stadthalle. The course consists entirely of forest paths, with the start and finish at the clock tower in front of the AWO/WHG buildings. Registration is open until November 6, 2025; late entries are accepted until 9:30 a.m. on race day. Free tea, changing rooms and showers are available.

name: Riegeler Crosslauf - Rund um den Michaelsberg
location: Riegel am Kaiserstuhl, Freiburg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The 50th Riegeler Crosslauf - Rund um den Michaelsberg is a traditional cross-country race in Riegel am Kaiserstuhl, organized by TV Riegel. The event offers various distances for children, young people, open runners and Masters, including short cross-country and road races. The courses run around Michaelsberg and offer local runners and young athletes an excellent opportunity to gain race experience. The longest distance is 8.1 km and is open to men, women and Masters.
course_highlights: Cross-country race around Michaelsberg
Distances from 0.5 km to 8.1 km
Separate starts for children, young people, open runners and Masters
additional: The program includes children's races (520 m), youth races (840 m, 1,400 m), a 2,900 m race for older youths and adults, and the main race over 8,100 m. Typical November weather, with temperatures around 7 °C and frequent rain, is to be expected. An off-road running event in November, with typical weather conditions around 7°C, often rainy, and various distances for all age groups.

name: Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition
description: The Volksbank run Crosslauf Beach Edition takes place in Xanten, with the 5 km race as the main distance. The race is held on an afternoon in November and promises a cross-country feel on the beach, setting it apart from a regular road race. Alongside the main distance, there are shorter 400 m races and longer 7.5 km races, offering suitable distances for both young and experienced runners. Children’s and youth races are also part of the program. The finish line for all races is at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten.
course_highlights: Cross-country feel on the beach
Distances from 400 m to 7.5 km
Finish line at Am Meerend 2 in Xanten
additional: Typical November weather, with temperatures of around 7 °C, lows of around 2 °C, and rainy weather on most days. Results are linked via RUNME.de. Children’s and youth races, a weather-dependent November event, outdoor atmosphere at Naturbad Xantener Südsee

name: USP Night Run - powered by Runnersworld Utrecht
description: The USP Night Run is an atmospheric night run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park, with distances for both adults and children. The route passes through the beautiful, illuminated Botanical Gardens, creating a unique and spectacular running experience. The event offers an enjoyable and sporty evening, with an atmospheric start and finish area, water stations along the route and at the finish. Teams and companies are also welcome to take part together, with extra options such as running shirts and pasta meals.
course_highlights: Run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park
Spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, plus kids’ runs of 800 m and 1.5 km
additional: Start and finish at Sportcentrum Olympos. There are start corrals and water stations along the route and at the finish. Optional extras when registering: USP Night Run shirt, cancellation insurance, pasta meal. Company teams can participate in their own running shirts and with drink tokens. First name on the race bib with registration chip. The event supports charities and offers discounts and extras such as a running shirt and pasta meal.

name: Utrecht Science Park Night Run
description: The Utrecht Science Park Night Run is an atmospheric running race taking place on Friday evening, 20 November 2026. Participants run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park, including a spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens. Several distances are available, including 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and kids’ runs. The event is organised by Central Events and supports the charity Stichting ALS Nederland.
course_highlights: Run through the illuminated Utrecht Science Park
Spectacular passage through the illuminated Botanical Gardens
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, plus kids’ runs
additional: Start and finish at Sportcentrum Olympos. There are start waves and a race with a prize ceremony. Optional extras when registering include a running shirt, cancellation insurance and a pasta meal. There is also a special kids’ run of 800 metres and 1.5 km. Registration includes options for shirts, insurance, a pasta meal and donations to ALS; proceeds go to Stichting ALS Nederland.

name: Derko Night Trail
description: The Derko Night Trail is the region of Utrecht’s premier running event in the dark, organized by BodyRun and IJ-run together with many volunteers. The start and finish are at Skipiste Nieuwegein, where a lively afterparty is also held. The trail runs through a beautiful nature area and offers various distances for both trail and paved-surface runners. Participants must use a headlamp because the event takes place in the dark, adding to its unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail runs on unpaved paths through a nature area
Start and finish at Skipiste Nieuwegein with catering facilities
The route is marked with reflectors and ribbons; headlamps are mandatory
additional: All participants must use a headlamp because the event takes place in the dark; it is mandatory for the trails and recommended for the fun run. The route is marked with reflectors and ribbons. Mixed changing facilities and first aid are available. The event aims to reduce the use of cups; participants take their own waste with them. After the event, there is an afterparty at the catering venue by the start/finish. Trail and paved routes, headlamp mandatory, online registration, charities supported

name: Finnensturm
location: Sport- und Solepark Große Wiese, Arnsberg-Hüsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Finnensturm is an evening race in November on a joint-friendly Finnish track at the Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park in Arnsberg-Hüsten. The 1,000-metre-long and 2.50-metre-wide track has a soft, springy surface that provides a pleasant running surface, different from asphalt or synthetic tracks. The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event attracts several hundred participants each year and is ideal for a November race with a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run on a 1,000 m-long, joint-friendly Finnish track
Soft, springy surface instead of asphalt or synthetic track
The course is lit in the evening, creating a special atmosphere
additional: The Finnish track is 2.50 m wide and runs independently of the rest of the path network. It is lit from 5:00 a.m. and in the evening until 11:00 p.m. The Große Wiese Sports and Saline Park is signposted from the Hüsten exit on the A46. The event takes place on a woodchip track at the Hüsten Sports and Saline Park; in November, weather conditions can make it wet and slippery. Refreshments and showers are available on site.

name: Hollands Duin Trail
description: The Hollands Duin Trail in Noordwijk offers a beautiful experience in the well-known nature reserve on the North Holland coast. Participants can

name: Halve van Monster 10 km
description: The Halve van Monster takes place every year in November. Participants can choose from the following distances: 21.1 km, 10.3 km, and 5.4 km. Pe

name: Eemsmondloop
description: The Eemsmondloop is a half marathon held in Uithuizermeeden on Saturday, November 21, 2026. This running race is a challenging test in the north of the Netherlands and attracts many participants each year. The organizers offer the option to collect race numbers in advance and arrange train transport to the start in Eemshaven. The race is known for its scenic course and good organization.
course_highlights: Half marathon distance of 21.1 km
Start in Eemshaven, with train transport from Uithuizermeeden
Option to collect race numbers in advance
additional: Race numbers can be collected up to 45 minutes before the start. Trains depart from Uithuizermeeden to the start in Eemshaven at 09:30, 10:00, and 10:30. Parking is available at Uithuizermeeden train station. Registration opens on March 1, 2026; participants can use the train and transport options, and a results page is available.

name: Halve van Monster
price_range: vanaf €11,00 tot €16,00 plus €4,50 voor de chip

price_tiers.distance: Lopers Company Westland Walkingtours (10.3 km & 5.4 km)

description: The Halve van Monster is an annual running event held in November in Monster. Participants can choose from several distances, including the half marathon (21.1 km), a 10.3 km run and a 5.4 km run. The course passes through the dunes and along the beach, with the start and finish at De Wielepet sports hall. Walking tours are also offered over the same routes in the opposite direction. Each year, the organizers support a charitable cause, giving the event extra meaning.
course_highlights: Course through the dunes
Run along the beach
Start and finish at De Wielepet sports hall
additional: Timing with a reusable SAW chip is mandatory. The chip costs €4.50 and can be returned after the event in exchange for a refreshment. Registration on the day is not possible; online registration is available until 11:00 on race day. The prize ceremony takes place at De Wielepet sports hall after the half marathon. Registration is online in advance only; donations to the charitable cause are possible. No registration on the day.

name: Zac Freudenburg Cross
description: The Zac Freudenburg Cross (ZFC) is an annual cross-country race organized by WegCie of the Groningen Student Athletics Association Vitalis. The race takes place at Hoornseplas in Groningen and honors American athlete Zac Freudenburg, known for his impressive performances in longer-distance events. The ZFC has a rich history and attracts runners who enjoy challenging cross-country courses in a natural setting. The event is organized by a dedicated student committee that ensures a well-organized and sporting day.
course_highlights: Cross-country course around Hoornseplas
Natural and challenging terrain
Historic connection to athlete Zac Freudenburg
additional: Location: Hoornseplas, Groningen; organized by WegCie of GSAV Vitalis

name: Halve Marathon Uithuizermeeden
location: Eemshaven, Municipality of Het Hogeland, Groningen, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname kost € 17,50 per persoon. Dit is inclusief vervoer van Uithuizermeeden naar de Eemshaven.

description: The Halve Marathon Uithuizermeeden is a challenging 21.1 km run that starts in Eemshaven and finishes in Uithuizermeeden. The race has a time limit of 2.5 hours and provides participants with train transport from Uithuizermeeden to the start. The organizers ensure that clothing brought to the start is transported to the finish, making the run more comfortable. The event attracts many enthusiastic runners each year, who brave the elements in a welcoming and well-organized setting.
course_highlights: Starts in Eemshaven and finishes in Uithuizermeeden
21.1 km distance with a time limit of 2.5 hours
Train transport from Uithuizermeeden to the start
additional: Race numbers can be collected up to 45 minutes before the start. Parking is available at Uithuizermeeden train station. The organizers transport clothing from the start to the finish. Trains depart from Uithuizermeeden to the start at 09:30, 10:00 and 10:30. Train transport, including transport from Uithuizermeeden to Eemshaven; no return shuttle service; registration usually opens from March 2026; the race attracts hundreds of participants each year.

name: 13. Schloss Marienburg Marathon
description: The 13th Schloss Marienburg Marathon takes place on November 21, 2026, in Nordstemmen-Adensen. This varied scenic marathon is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The course follows village streets, paved and unpaved country lanes, woodland paths, and trails, with about 560 metres of elevation gain. A special highlight is the refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg, where runners can take a break. The 21.1 km course is shaped like a figure eight, with three refreshment stations in Adensen, and offers beautiful views of the Calenberger Land and the Leinebergland in good weather.
course_highlights: Varied course featuring village streets, country lanes, woodland paths, and trails
Refreshment station in the courtyard of Schloss Marienburg
Figure-eight course with about 560 metres of elevation gain and views of the Calenberger Land and Leinebergland
additional: Early marathon start at 9:00 a.m. for runners who need more than 6 hours. Official electronic timekeeping. Refreshments approximately every 5 km, including water, tea, isotonic drinks, cola, fruit, and gingerbread. Changing rooms, showers, toilets, and baggage storage in the start/finish area. German Red Cross medical service in the start/finish area and along the course. Participant limit: 550 runners, including a maximum of 300 half-marathon runners. Hilly course with trails, 560 metres of elevation gain, scenic views, aid stations every 5 km.

name: 4. Heartbeat Ultra
description: Heartbeat Ultra is a participatory charity ultrarun in Fulda, taking place on November 21, 2026. Participants run laps of approximately 6 km, covering up to 112 km, and decide for themselves when to start, take breaks and finish their run. Each lap raises donations for children with half a heart, supporting research and quality of life. The event is open to everyone, from beginners to ultrarunners, and wheelchair users are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: A loop of approximately 6 km in Sportpark Johannisau, Fulda
Charity laps covering up to 112 km
Flexible start and running time between 06:00 and 21:00
additional: This is a charity run where every lap counts and the entry fee is donated in full. Participants receive a personal fundraising page where supporters can donate for each lap completed. There is a 400-metre children's run in the stadium, with each lap counted. The event is also available virtually, so people can take part from anywhere in the world. Flexible running time, virtual participation, donations for children with heart defects, registration with a personal fundraising page, medal for the first 1,500 participants.

name: 50. See-Park-Lauf
description: The 50th Bad Gandersheim See-Park Run is a traditional road race held in late November in Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark. Organized by SVG GW Bad Gandersheim, it offers categories for various age and performance groups, including boys, girls, men, women, juniors, open runners, and masters up to 95+. The event is closely connected with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, whose students and teachers take part and support the organizing team. After the race, results, personalized certificates, and a photo gallery are published online.
course_highlights: Road race around the grounds of Bad Gandersheim’s Seepark
Separate categories for a range of age and performance groups
Strong connection with Bad Gandersheim Oberschule, with active participation
additional: There are two distances: 400 m and 10 km. Typical November weather is expected, with daytime highs of about 7 °C and rainy days. The organizing team comprises about 50 people, supported by around 80 students and teachers. Results, certificates, and a photo gallery are published online after the race. Road race in the Seepark, distances of 400 m and 10 km, organized by the school, with rainy November weather expected.

name: Bönnigheimer Stromberglauf
description: The Bönnigheim Stromberg Run is a traditional autumn race at the foot of the Stromberg, attracting both elite and recreational runners. The event offers scenic courses through vineyards, fields, and meadows, with varied elevation and wonderful panoramic views. The 5-kilometer loop is fast and flat, while the 10-kilometer distance features challenging climbs and an encouraging atmosphere. The race takes place around the Strombergkeller and is known for its lively atmosphere and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop with just 20 meters of elevation gain through fields and residential areas
Challenging 10 km course with 60 meters of elevation gain and panoramic views over vineyards
2 km schoolchildren’s race around the Strombergkeller, mostly on paved paths
additional: Registration is through the raceresult service provider. Special awards are available for schools, companies, and cultural associations, with attractive prizes such as a case of wine from the Strombergkeller. The course is mostly paved and offers a varied challenge, with around 70 meters of elevation gain per lap. Participants without a stated time will be placed in the final starting block. The event is organized by LG Neckar-Enz with support from the City of Bönnigheim. Distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 2 km; cultural activities; children’s and youth races; online registration

name: Crossmeisterschaft SC Magdeburg
description: The SC Magdeburg Cross Country Championships is a traditional cross-country running competition organized by SC Magdeburg and the City of Magdeburg in Saxony-Anhalt. As a championship cross-country race in the German athletics calendar, it offers a challenging off-road course that differs from classic track races. The event is part of the DLV system, with official entries, rules, and timing, and is supported by the volunteer club and federation culture. The races take place in November, typically in cool and rainy weather, offering an authentic cross-country experience for club and federation runners.
course_highlights: Cross-country course, not on a track
Distances: 700 m and 1.4 km
Event held as part of the German athletics calendar
additional: The event is officially listed in the DLV system, with entries, rules, and timing. Typical November weather is cool (7 °C, low of 2 °C) and rainy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The start location is in Magdeburg; detailed directions are available. Cross-country course, distances of 700 m and 1.4 km, held in November in rainy weather

name: Int. Brubbellauf
description: The International Brubbellauf in Wallenborn is a long-standing running event organised annually by SV Wallenborn. It takes place in November and is open to runners of all ability levels; beginners are also very welcome. The event has a friendly atmosphere, and late entries are accepted until 30 minutes before each start. Results and certificates are available in the “Information” section of the website.
course_highlights: Route through the centre of Wallenborn
A varied programme for all ages and ability levels
On-site late entries available
additional: Late entries are accepted on site until 30 minutes before each start. Distances range from 200 m to 10.2 km, including children’s races, a fun run, a corporate run and walking. The event takes place in mild November weather, with average temperatures of 2–7°C, and is suitable for families, beginners and ambitious runners.

name: Kunstweglauf Rednitzhembach
description: The Kunstweglauf in Rednitzhembach is organised by the endurance sports club PowerBärs Rednitzhembach e.V. and will take place for the 18th time in 2026. The event brings art and sport together in a unique symbiosis and is centred around the school building in Rednitzhembach, which offers excellent facilities including changing rooms, showers and refreshments. The start and finish are right in front of the school, creating a pleasant atmosphere for participants and spectators. The race is an established event in the region south of Nuremberg and offers a friendly, sporty experience in November.
course_highlights: Start and finish directly in front of the school building in Rednitzhembach
Excellent facilities including changing rooms, showers and the school café
A running event that brings art and sport together
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day up to 60 minutes before the respective start. The event takes place in and around the school building, which serves as its hub, with an assembly hall for the awards ceremony and refreshments. The event also includes results, race information and photos, and is a creative blend of art and running fun in Rednitzhembach.

name: Lindenseelaufserie
location: Rüsselsheim am Lindensee, Groß-Gerau, Hesse, Germany
description: The Lindenseelauf Series in Rüsselsheim at Lindensee is a traditional annual running event. It offers runners of various ages and ability levels the opportunity to run on attractive routes around Lindensee. The series is known for its friendly atmosphere and varied course. The event is organized by LG Rüsselsheim and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Running routes around picturesque Lindensee
Varied course for different age groups
Friendly, sporting atmosphere
additional: Races in November and January; no series standings in November and January; certificates for the top three in each age group and for teams; awards ceremony after the race

name: Lipperland Marathon
description: The Lipperland Marathon in Dörentrup offers a friendly, family atmosphere without crowds along the roads. The event is known for its straightforward organization and takes place in the beautiful Lipperland region in autumn. Runners can look forward to great views and a pleasant atmosphere in Humfeld. The event is organized by TuS Humfeld 1911 e.V. and is aimed at all participants looking for a personal running experience.
course_highlights: Marathon in a family-friendly setting
Beautiful Lipperland region in autumn with great views
No crowds along the roads
additional: The course runs through hilly terrain; start at the Humfeld sports hall; family-friendly; includes half-marathon and loop-course options; registration by bank transfer

name: Nussdorflauf
description: The Nussdorf Run is a traditional running event in Nussdorf near Eberdingen, held annually in November. The event offers various competitions for all age groups, from Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to beginner and panoramic runs, as well as Nordic walking. All participants receive a medal and certificate after crossing the finish line, and some also receive trophies or cash prizes. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the broad support of sponsors and volunteers.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400 m to 10 km
10 km panoramic run with age-group categories for all ages
Courses for Bambini, schoolchildren, teenagers and adults
additional: Late registration is possible on race day from 10:30 a.m. at the Nussdorf community hall, up to 30 minutes before the respective start. All participants receive a medal and certificate. Trophies and cash prizes are awarded to places 1–3 in various categories. Registration for the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races is handled through the schools. Various race distances; registration opens on 01.09.2025; participation conditions, results and photos available online.

name: Rhädenlauf
description: The Rhädenlauf takes place on November 21, 2026, in the Rhäden Nature Reserve in Wildeck-Obersuhl. The race is organized by TV 1888 Obersuhl and is part of the 2026 competition year. The event is for runners who want to experience a nature-rich route through a protected landscape. Timing has been provided by a modern ALGE system since 2022, ensuring precise results.
course_highlights: Run through the Rhäden Nature Reserve
Nature-rich and scenic route
Modern ALGE timing system in use since 2022
additional: Timing is provided by an ALGE system, including a start trigger with an integrated flash (E-Start). The department head is Luisa Wunn, who can be reached at 0177 4691132. Club training takes place on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays from 17:30 to 19:00 at the stadium or the Obersuhl indoor sports hall. Route through the nature reserve, training plans for participants

name: Ring Running Series 2026
description: The Ring Running Series at Hockenheimring offers a unique running experience on November 21, 2026, on an officially measured Formula 1 circuit suitable for personal bests. The flat, fully paved course follows the legendary Grand Prix circuit, featuring highlights such as the Motodrom, the Bernie Ecclestone Curve and the South Curve. Participants can choose between the half marathon and marathon and benefit from a secured course, high-quality refreshments and professional timing. The event combines a motorsport atmosphere with an athletic challenge and is ideal for runners looking for a special course and fast times.
course_highlights: Officially measured course with an AIMS certificate, suitable for personal bests
Flat, fully paved race track with long straights
Passes all the highlights of Hockenheimring, including the Motodrom and Bernie Ecclestone Curve
additional: Race number collection on site on November 20 and 21, with a personalised race number and integrated timing chip. Changing facilities in the pit lane, medical support along the course, high-quality refreshments on the course and at the finish, baggage storage near the finish, jacket drop-off in the start area with collection near the finish, free parking and shower facilities. The finish is on the original Formula 1 finish line. Schedule: marathon start 10:00, half-marathon start 11:00, course closes at 16:00, awards ceremony at 13:30. The event offers live tracking, race number collection, accommodation options at Seehotel Ketsch and a unique atmosphere that motivates runners to achieve personal bests.

name: Rurbrückenlauf
location: SIG Combibloc Systems, Linnich, Düren, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
distance_verbose: 12.5 km, 11.5 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Rurbrückenlauf is a running series in Linnich, starting and finishing at SIG Combibloc Systems. Various distances are offered for children, young people, and adults. Adults can choose between a flat 5.2 km run and an 11.5 km run with a rolling profile that offers a little more variety. The event takes place in November and is aimed at runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at SIG Combibloc Systems in Linnich
Flat 5.2 km run for a straightforward, flat course
11.5 km run with a rolling profile for more variety
additional: The event includes distances from 0.5 km to 12.5 km, including races for children and young people. Typical November weather in Linnich is around 7 °C, with rainy days and an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Distances: 0.5 km, 1 km, 1.5 km, 4.9 km, 11.5 km, 12.5 km; start and finish at SIG Combibloc Systems; November weather: around 7 °C, rainy; event for all ages.

name: Schwollener Crosslauf - 2. Lauf der 17. OIE Nahecrosslaufserie
location: Schwollen, Landkreis Bad Kreuznach, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Schwollen Cross-Country Run is the second race in the 17th OIE Nahe Cross-Country Series and offers runners a varied cross-country course in the Schwollen region. The series is known for its friendly atmosphere and gives participants the opportunity to take part in several races to receive a series gift. The event is supported by dedicated volunteers and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The races take place at various sports grounds and in natural surroundings, which is what makes the series special.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in natural surroundings near Schwollen
A range of distances for children, middle-distance and long-distance runners
Part of the long-standing Nahe Cross-Country Series, with several stages
additional: Every participant who takes part in at least 4 races in the series receives a series gift (sports socks for middle-distance and long-distance runners). Sock size is requested during registration. Registration is online via the website. After a weather-related cancellation, a replacement date was set for another race in the series. The series includes several dates at different locations in the region. Dates at different locations, registration including sock size, series scoring, weather-related schedule changes, series gift for participants.

name: Stadtwerke Night Run
description: The Stadtwerke Night Run in Sindelfingen is the perfect event to end the 2026 running season and get participants in the mood for Christmas. Runners wear headlamps on an illuminated course, making for a special running experience in the dark. A varied programme of events for all age groups ranges from the Glühwürmchenlauf for the youngest participants and school races to 5 km and 10 km races. The event winds down in the Winterdörfle, with Swedish fires creating a festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run with a headlamp on illuminated courses
Events for children, school students and adults
Wind down in the Winterdörfle with Swedish fires
additional: The event is subject to an entry fee. Events are offered for various age groups: the Stadtwerke Glühwürmchenlauf for the youngest participants, the Kreissparkassen school races, the Wohnstätten 5 km race and the Stadtwerke 10 km race. The course is illuminated, and runners wear headlamps. The event winds down in the Winterdörfle with Swedish fires. Run with a headlamp on an illuminated course; various events for children and school students; finish in the Winterdörfle by fire pits.

name: Werler Straßenlauf
description: The Werl Road Race is a long-standing running event taking place for the 36th time on November 21, 2026. With distances for Bambini, recreational runners, and ambitious athletes, it offers a wide range of running options. The event marks the final stretch of the DJK competition year and welcomes runners of all abilities to run together with heart. It takes place amid the autumn atmosphere of Werl and combines sporting ambition with a sense of community.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from short routes to 10 kilometers
Suitable for Bambini, recreational runners, and ambitious athletes
Long-standing event with a 36-year history
additional: Distances for Bambini, recreational runners, and athletes; takes place on November 21, 2026; ideal for fast times and personal bests

description: The SAV cross takes place on 22 November 2026 near the SAV track in Grootebroek. This cross is part of the All4running cross circuit and counts towards the overall standings. There are several race distances for youth and seniors, ranging from 5,100 metres to 9,400 metres. The cross is a challenging, competitive event where participants can earn points towards the circuit standings.
course_highlights: Race distances range from 5,100 metres (youth and recreational women) to 9,400 metres (men and recreational women or longer categories)
Part of the All4running cross circuit, with points counting towards the overall standings
Age categories are divided into five-year groups from age 19 onwards
additional: The circuit's final prizes are awarded in age groups for youth and adults. To qualify for the standings, participants must take part in at least four circuit races; their four best results count. Anyone who runs all five cross-country races receives 10 bonus points. Lost property is kept by the organising club for 14 days. The category entered in the first race applies throughout the circuit. Daily prizes are awarded based on the category on race day. The race is part of the All4running cross circuit, with events scheduled in October, November and December 2026. Registration is available on race day, and participants must run at least four races to qualify for the standings. Locations include Hoorn, Wieringermeer and Spierdijk.

description: The Schalmloop Mariënheem is a popular winter cross-country race that has been part of Mariënheem’s sporting winter calendar since 1986. The race takes place around the Boetelerveld nature reserve, on a recently renewed course consisting of more than 80% unpaved paths and muddy sections. Since 2024, the start has been at Kinderopvang ’t Schoapie, improving accessibility and atmosphere. The Schalmloop offers distances for all ages and is known for its challenging, varied nature route with gentle elevation changes. The event promises a friendly, active winter day outdoors.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly through the Boetelerveld nature reserve
More than 80% unpaved sandy paths and muddy sections
A varied route with gentle elevation changes and plenty of nature
additional: The Schalmloop offers several distances: 1.3 km (start 11:45), 2.6 km (start 11:25), 5.2 km (start 12:00) and 10.7 km (start 10:00). The start is at Kinderopvang ’t Schoapie, Raamsweg 47A. More than 80% of the course is unpaved and it can be deceptively slippery depending on the weather. The short loops make the event appealing to spectators. Raamsweg from Raalte is closed during the event; approach via Kroepeweg. Distances: 1.3 km, 2.6 km, 5.2 km, 10.7 km; terrain: unpaved and muddy; date: 22 November 2026

name: Westeinderloop
location: Sportpark Calslagen, Kudelstaart, Aalsmeer, North Holland, Netherlands
price_range: gratis voor jeugd en G-Run, inschrijving via www.inschrijven.nl
description: The Westeinderloop is a running event organized by Atletiek Vereniging Aalsmeer, held at Sportpark Calslagen in Kudelstaart. The race offers runners a great opportunity to take part in a competition in a friendly, sporty atmosphere. The route runs through the area around the Westeinderplassen, making for a varied and appealing course. The event is suitable for different ages and ability levels and contributes to the local sporting culture.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportpark Calslagen
Run through the area around the Westeinderplassen
A varied course with beautiful scenery
additional: Course along the Westeinder, several categories including youth and G-Run, parking at RKDES, accessible by public transport

name: Sperwers trailrun
description: The Sperwers trail run is a challenging trail race set in the beautiful landscape of Exloo, Drenthe. The race offers two distances, 7 km and 14 km, and takes participants along natural paths and through wooded areas. The event is suitable for trail running enthusiasts who want to enjoy a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings. Registration closes on 15 November 2026.
course_highlights: Trail run through wooded areas in Exloo
Natural paths and challenging terrain
Choice of 7 km and 14 km distances
additional: Trail terrain, registration closed, event on 22 November 2026, weather information available

name: Maarten Maartens Trailrun
description: The Maarten Maartens Trail Run is a welcoming trail race held on the beautiful Zonheuvel estate in Doorn, on the Utrechtse Heuvelrug. The 6, 10 and 20 km routes wind through the hills of the Kaapse Bossen forest and are mostly unpaved, with the entire course marked with arrows and ribbons. There is no electronic timekeeping; participants can read their time from the race clock. After the race, refreshments are available, and the winners are honoured at the historic Maarten Maartens House. The trail run is suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike who enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Routes through the hills of the Kaapse Bossen forest on the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Mostly unpaved course, clearly marked with arrows and ribbons
Start and finish at the historic Maarten Maartens House on the Zonheuvel estate
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 12:30 until 15 minutes before the start. The 20 km race consists of 2 laps, with a refreshment station halfway. There is no electronic timekeeping; participants read their time from the race clock. Prizes are awarded to the first three women and men. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:00 on the steps of the Maarten Maartens House. No electronic timekeeping; refreshments are available after the race and halfway for 20 km runners; prizes for the top three women and men; race numbers can be collected in advance.

name: Wilscher Geburtstags-Etappen-Marathon
description: The VfR Wilsche-Neubokel Birthday Stage Marathon is a special group run that annually honors all runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. Participants run together at a moderate pace of 6:00 to 6:15 minutes per kilometer and can join at various refreshment stops. At these stage points, the birthday celebrants treat the runners to culinary delights, making the run a unique and enjoyable experience. The event combines sporting camaraderie with a festive atmosphere and is a cherished club tradition.
course_highlights: Group run at a pace of 6:00–6:15 min/km
Refreshment stops approximately every 5–10 km, with a 10-minute break
You can join at any refreshment stop
additional: The run honors all fellow runners celebrating a milestone birthday that year. The birthday celebrants lovingly prepare the refreshments at the stage points. Recent photos from the run are available via an external Flickr link. Group run, approx. 6:00–6:15 min/km; registration via an external link

name: WMF BKK AST Süßen Herbstlauf
description: The WMF BKK AST Süßen Autumn Run is a long-established running event held annually in Süßen. It offers main races over 5 km and 11 km, a 1.8 km youth race, and a 5 km walking route. The event takes place at the Kultur- und Sporthalle Süßen, which is open from 11:00 a.m. into the evening. The Autumn Run welcomes runners of all ability levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main races over 5 km and 11 km
1.8 km youth race
5 km walking route
additional: The venue is the Kultur- und Sporthalle Süßen, open from 11:00 a.m. until the evening. Races are available for different age and ability groups, along with a walking route. The event is part of AST Süßen’s club life. Courses are not officially measured; on-site registration is available; bibs use transponder timing; various running and walking options are offered for all age groups.

name: Winterlaufserie TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen – 1. Lauf
description: Die Winterlaufserie des TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung im Weidelsburgstadion in Wolfhagen-Ippinghausen. Sie umfasst mehrere Läufe mit Distanzen von 310 m bis 15 km auf befestigten und geteerten Waldwegen. Die Serie richtet sich an alle Altersklassen und bietet eine Einzel- und Mannschaftswertung mit Urkunden und Auszeichnungen. Die Veranstaltung ist vom Hessischen Leichtathletik-Verband genehmigt und legt Wert auf faire Bedingungen, beispielsweise ist das Tragen von Spikes nicht erlaubt.
