name: Ameland Adventure Run
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km

name: Ameland Adventurerun
description: The Ameland Adventurerun is an adventurous running event held in December on the Wadden Sea island of Ameland. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, as well as special children’s distances of 1 and 2 kilometres. The event combines a sporting challenge with the island’s unique natural surroundings and winter elements. It is a welcoming event with a finish party and a warm reception for runners and supporters.
course_highlights: Run between the Wadden Sea and the North Sea amid unspoilt nature
Distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, plus children’s distances
Winter elements and a lively finish party with Christmas tunes
additional: After the finish, participants in the 5, 10 and 21.1 km races receive a medal and a special Ameland Adventurerun bandana. The race office is at Sporthal Nes, where participants can collect their race pack. The organisers promote sustainability by minimising the use of cups at aid stations and offering ECO cups. Participants must book their own ferry crossing through Wagenborg Passenger Services. First aid is provided by professionals. A shirt for the Kidsrun is available through Eilandverhuur Ameland. Distances: 5, 10 and 21 km, plus children’s distances; registration opens on 1 April; winter conditions are possible; location: Nes, Ameland.

name: Spaarnwoude Park Ultra
location: Speelvijver Peddelpoel, Velsen, North Holland, Netherlands
description: Spaarnwoude Park Ultra is a unique running event in Velsen-Zuid where participants run laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve. Each lap must be completed within 30 minutes to continue to the next lap. Participants can choose on the day which distance they run. The event takes place at the Peddelpoel recreational lake and is limited to 150 participants. It is organised by volunteers from Loopmeesters and RunX Haarlem. The start and rest area has facilities including toilets and picnic tables. After the event, all runners receive hot chocolate as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve
30-minute time limit per lap
Start and finish at the Peddelpoel recreational lake, with facilities
additional: A maximum of 150 participants per edition. Participants bring their own food and drinks. There are transition cups for the fastest runners in the final lap, one per distance. The start and rest area has space for tents, chairs and support crews. All participants receive a keepsake and hot chocolate before they leave. Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km, a 30-minute time limit per lap, participants bring their own food and drinks, keepsake and hot chocolate after the event.

name: Bootsgym RUN TEGEN KANKER
description: Bootsgym RUN TEGEN KANKER is a running race taking place in Tuitjenhorn on 12 December 2026. The race is listed on Inschrijven.nl, where participants can register and find more details. The event is presented on the WeTri platform, which supports a wide range of triathlon and running events in the Netherlands. The race invites runners to take on a sporting challenge while also raising awareness of cancer.
course_highlights: Supporting cancer research
Location in Tuitjenhorn
Registration via Inschrijven.nl
additional: The event focuses on charity and running, with an emphasis on supporting cancer research. No specific distance or course information is available.

name: KNRM West Coast Challenge
location: Hoek van Holland, Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands

price_tiers.distance: Duo - hele of halve challenge (halve prijs + sponsoractie)

description: The KNRM West Coast Challenge is a unique one-day endurance event in which teams of two take turns running and cycling over 130 kilometres from Hoek van Holland to Den Helder, almost entirely along the beach. There is also a 62-kilometre Half Challenge for pairs and solo entrants; solo entrants may be accompanied by a cyclist. The event raises funds for the KNRM, with all proceeds going towards its rescue work. The Full Challenge starts on 12 December 2026 at 04:30 and the Half Challenge at 11:00. The atmosphere is friendly, and participants are encouraged to strengthen their connection with the KNRM.
course_highlights: 130 kilometres, almost entirely along the beach, passing twelve KNRM coastal stations
The course is unmarked, so participants find their own way
The crossing at IJmuiden on KNRM lifeboats and the changing tides are important
additional: Participants must find their own route because the course is unmarked. Front and rear bicycle lights are mandatory in the dark (04:30–08:00 and from 17:00). If beach conditions are poor, the cyclist may ride through the dunes. There is a reserve date of 16 January 2027 in case of bad weather. The Half Challenge starts at 11:00 at restaurant Sea You in Velsen-Noord. Teams can choose to pay the full fee or pay half price by organising a fundraising campaign through samenvoorknrm.nl. Registration is confirmed after payment or after reaching the fundraising target. The event follows a run-bike-run format and has a strong focus on fundraising for the KNRM. Details about registration and participation fees are not specified.

name: Rotary Santa Run Bussum
description: The Rotary Santa Run in Bussum takes place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, and is a fun running event for the whole family, teams, friends, and neighbors. The event starts at 15:30 and combines sport with fun and support for a good cause, Stichting Hulphond. After the run, there is an awards ceremony and a get-together in Kapelstraat. The Santa Run is a festive event that brings people together in the center of Bussum.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the center of Bussum
Festive atmosphere with a warm-up and medal ceremony
Drinks in Kapelstraat after the event
additional: Schedule: 15:00 gathering, 15:15 warm-up, 15:30 run starts, 16:00–16:45 medal ceremony, 16:15–17:00 drinks for runners in Kapelstraat. On the day, organizers can be reached through identifiable Rotary members wearing yellow vests. The event includes fun runs for families, classmates, teams, friends, and neighborhoods; several Rotary Clubs in the Netherlands organize similar events; in 2026, participation will expand to include extensive nationwide involvement.

name: Adventscrosslauf
description: The Wilscher Advent Cross-Country Run Gifhorn is a traditional cross-country race held during Advent in Gifhorn, Lower Saxony. The main distance is 7.5 km and runs through the winter landscape of the Wilsche district. The race starts at 14:00 at the meeting point at An der Masch 4. The event is organised by VfR Wilsche/Neubokel, and the entry fee is 7 euros.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through the winter landscape of Gifhorn-Wilsche
Main distance: 7.5 km
Start and meeting point at An der Masch 4
additional: The meeting point and start are at An der Masch 4 in the Wilsche district of Gifhorn. Typical December weather includes temperatures around 3 °C and snow cover on most days. The race starts at 14:00, with the meeting point at An der Masch 4 in Gifhorn. Registration is via the club website. The event is a lovely opportunity to enjoy the Advent season in an active and sociable way.

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 2. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a traditional running event organised by TSG Alten-Buseck. It includes several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and the half marathon (21.1 km). The races take place during the colder months and offer a great opportunity to enjoy the winter landscape around Alten-Buseck together with other runners. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, with special races for children and young people. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy refreshments, followed by an awards ceremony for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km
Start and finish at Harbig Halle in Alten-Buseck
Winter running routes; the course may be changed because of construction work
additional: Timing is provided using passive transponders from Raceresult. The awards ceremony takes place after the races, with awards for the three fastest participants of the day (men/women) and age-group winners. Certificates, results and photos are available online. After crossing the finish line, participants receive a free refreshing drink; coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Harbig Halle. Parking at Harbig Halle is limited. The Bambini run starts at approximately 14:15 (December only). Distance options: 700 m and 15 km; the event is expected to take place in winter conditions; start location: Alten-Buseck, Buseck.

name: Bühlerzeller Winterlauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 6.5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 0.9 km
description: The Bühlerzell Winter Run is an established winter running event in Bühlerzell, Germany, organized by Sportfreunde Bühlerzell. With at least 21 editions, the event offers various distances from 900 m to 10 km, including 3 km, 5 km, and 6.5 km. The program is aimed at younger runners, beginners, and experienced road runners, and takes place in typical December weather, with courses usually covered in snow.
course_highlights: Various distances from 900 m to 10 km
Winter running conditions with snow
Start and finish in Bühlerzell
additional: The event offers very short races alongside the 10 km race to include a range of runner groups. Typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall, shapes the event. Races over various distances, including walking, take place in winter in Bühlerzell; typical temperatures are around 3°C. Check details with the organizer before registering.

name: Ellewicker Adventslauf
price_range: 4 Euro für Kinder- und Schülerlauf, Nachmeldegebühr 2 Euro
description: The Ellewick Advent Run is a traditional running event in Vreden-Ellewick, held every December. It offers a 1.5 km children’s and schoolchildren’s run and a 5 km run, each over two laps. The event is family-friendly and supported by a dedicated organizing team. It gives runners of all ages the opportunity to get active and enjoy the Advent season together.
course_highlights: 1.5 km children’s/schoolchildren’s run over 2 laps
5 km run over 2 laps
Route through the village of Ellewick
additional: Photos and videos are taken during the event for use in the press and on social media. Participant data is used to compile the race results and can be deleted on request. Terrain: loop course of 0.5 km or 2.5 km; online registration until 12.12.2025; trophies, certificates and a raffle; weather-dependent conditions, with possible snow cover and temperatures around 3°C.

name: Jahresendlauf
location: Bad Berka, Weimarer Land, Thuringia, Germany

description: The year-end run in Bad Berka is a traditional running event held every December. The routes pass through the scenic Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas on paved, gravel and forest roads. The event offers various distances, including a free 400 m mini-run for children and longer distances for young people and adults. It is open to all running enthusiasts and is organized by the sports club Spielvereinigung Bad Berka e.V.
course_highlights: Routes through the Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas
Paved, gravel and forest roads
Start and finish at Ilmtalstadion Bad Berka
additional: The 400 m mini-run is free. On-site registration is available on race day, with an additional service fee (€1.00 up to age 16, €2.00 from age 17) and cash payment only. Changing rooms and showers are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße (approx. 500 m walk). The race office opens at 9:00 a.m. The routes have a rolling profile. Online registration is available. Showers and changing rooms are available. Parking is available at the sports ground and on Tannrodaer Straße.

name: MB Brandschutz-Nachtwächterlauf
description: The MB Brandschutz Night Watchman Run is a winter race in Ottweiler, usually held before the New Year’s Eve runs. It offers short road-race distances of 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, suitable for both beginners and club runners. The event is organised by the athletics section of TV Ottweiler. Registration is available for individuals and groups, making it easier for teams to sign up.
course_highlights: Short road-race distances: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
Winter race with typical December temperatures around 3 °C; roads are often snow-covered
Starting point in Ottweiler
additional: The race is usually held before the New Year’s Eve runs. Younger runners are eligible for the 2.5 km race; higher minimum age limits apply to the 5 km and 10 km races. Group registration is also available, making it straightforward for teams to sign up. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with roads often snow-covered. Winter race, road race, individual or group registration available, age limits vary by distance.

description: Welcome to the Mescherbergloop, a true classic among hill races in the Netherlands, which has been making runners’ hearts beat faster for more than 30 years

description: The Texel Wintercross takes place in De Dennen on Texel, near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld. This race is sheltered in the forest, with winding trails.

name: Winterse social run Utrecht - Run Your City
Ter Specke Loop
location: Sportpark Ter Specke, Lisse, South Holland, Netherlands
price_range: Inschrijving via inschrijven.nl, korting voor verzekerden van Zorg en Zekerheid
description: The Ter Specke Loop takes place in the beautiful, wooded surroundings of Sportpark Ter Specke in Lisse. The distinctive course is flat and sheltered, with the start on Spekkelaan and the finish on the athletics track. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, with runners completing one to three laps. Families and the youngest participants can take part in the free 1 km GeZZinsloop, with a medal for everyone afterward. After the finish, runners are welcomed at the Health Square with fruit and water, provided by the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit.
course_highlights: Flat, sheltered course in a wooded setting
Start on Spekkelaan, finish on the athletics track
Distances of 1 km (GeZZinsloop), 5 km, 10 km and 15 km
additional: Registration takes place in the sports hall, with card payment. Separate changing rooms are available for women and men. Valuables can be left in a tent on the track. Massage may be available in the sports hall afterward. Parking is available on Spekkelaan, at the cycling track and on van Lyndenweg, as directed by parking attendants. Circuit participants can switch between the short and middle distances as often as they like via the information desk; switching to the long distance is only possible through individual registration. Various distances (5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 1 km kids' run), start and finish at Sportpark Ter Specke, on-site registration with card payment, free kids' run, massage available afterward

name: Urban City Run 053
description: The Urban City Run 053 takes place on December 13, 2026, in Enschede and offers participants a unique 5 km or 7.5 km exploratory run through the city centre. The start and finish are at Performance Factory, and the course takes you past attractive squares, streets and various buildings. This is not a race and there is no timekeeping, so you can enjoy the special moments along the way and take selfies. All participants receive a unique running shirt, which serves as their entry pass and must be worn. After the finish, you can chat together over food and drinks.
course_highlights: Varied course through Enschede city centre, including asphalt, carpet and grass
Run through various buildings and climb several staircases
Start and finish at Performance Factory
additional: Maximum of 2,000 participants. Start waves between 09:00 and 10:00; choose your start time when registering. Minimum age: 12. The running shirt is mandatory and serves as your entry pass. No race number. Parking is available at Performance Factory and Irenegarage (limited and paid). Bicycle parking at Performance Factory is limited. Changing facilities are available; there are no showers. Luggage storage is in the gymnasium and is at your own risk. No timekeeping and no minimum time. Start and finish at Performance Factory, start waves between 09:00 and 10:00, minimum age 12, no showers, luggage storage at your own risk.

name: Wintercross ASV Eibergen
description: The Wintercross ASV Eibergen is a challenging cross-country running event that is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie. The race takes place in the beautiful natural area around Eibergen and offers distances ranging from 1 km to 10 km, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The competition encourages runners of all ages to enjoy athletics in a welcoming and sporting environment. The event is organised jointly by six athletics clubs, ensuring a professional and friendly experience.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from 1 km to 10 km
A natural and challenging cross-country course in Eibergen
Races for youth, seniors and masters
additional: The races start at 10:30 with the 10 km for seniors and masters. This is followed by various youth distances from 1 km to 5 km. The age reference date for youth and masters is the final race and the first race of the competition, respectively. The event is organised jointly by six athletics clubs from the region. Registration is available via inschrijven.nl, with on-site registration also possible; the event is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held at RCN campsite Zeewolde. It offers several distances, including 1, 2, 5 and 10 kilometres, with the longer distances consisting of multiple laps. The run is open to both beginners and experienced runners and is organised by TVZ Zeewolde, a sports club with a rich history in multisport and triathlon. The atmosphere is sporty and sociable, with an emphasis on having fun and enjoying the event together.
course_highlights: Routes of 1, 2, 5 and 10 km, with multiple laps for the longer distances
Start and finish at RCN campsite Zeewolde
Varied course suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The 2 km route consists of 2 laps. The 10 km route consists of 2 laps of 5 km. Photos and results from previous editions are available on the organiser’s Facebook page and photo page. Registration is required; the event takes place during the winter months and is suitable for the whole family.

name: Pit Makelaars L'Avant Sylvestre
description: The Pit Makelaars L'Avant Sylvestrecross is a classic cross-country race organised annually by AVR'69 in Reusel. The technical course features several hills and bends and is located at Burgemeester Willekenslaan. The race attracts a strong field, including many Belgian runners, and is part of the Kempische Cross Competitie. Before the race, there is a fun run open to everyone, starting at 1120 metres. The start and finish are at De Oude Brandtoren in Reusel.
course_highlights: Technical course with several hills
Plenty of bends
Located on Burgemeester Willekenslaan in Reusel
additional: Start and finish at De Oude Brandtoren, Burgemeester Willekenslaan 2, Reusel. The cross is part of the Kempische Cross Competitie, a series of 7 cross-country races in region 14 (Kempen). Medals are awarded to the first 3 participants in each race category. The short cross has 2 categories: Men and Women. Pupils without a competition licence or club membership may take part and can also reach the podium. Registration on the day of the race is not possible. Course with hills and bends; registration until 12 December; start and finish at De Oude Brandtoren; various categories, including a fun run for all ages.

name: Adventslauf
price_range: 10,00 € bis 16,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Advent Run in Hamm is a traditional winter race on officially measured out-and-back courses through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the Kurpark in Bad Hamm. The start and finish are on the tartan track at Jahnstadion, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with chip-based net and gun timekeeping. Alongside the sporting challenge, charity is also a key focus, with a donation collected for the support association of the hospice in Hamm.
course_highlights: Officially measured out-and-back courses
Lippeaue nature conservation area
Kurpark in Bad Hamm
additional: Young people and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). An additional €3.00 deposit is charged for the race bib (refunded when returned), along with a €1.00 donation for the support association of the hospice in Hamm. Timing is provided using Race Result systems via a chip in the race bib. The timing is eligible for best-list results and is forwarded to the DLV federation. Headphones, dogs and jogging strollers are prohibited during the race. The awards ceremony takes place approximately 45 minutes after the first runner finishes. Discounted admission is available at the neighboring Maximare adventure swimming pool. Courses are timed using Race Result; race bibs contain a chip; the awards ceremony is approximately 45 minutes after the finish; admission to Maximare is available.

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series associated with the traditional Rund um Wellen. The event is organized by the local running community, which also organizes the Wellen Marathon, and offers a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere away from large city events. The course includes several distances and runs through the rural surroundings, supported by local volunteers, sponsors, and the fire brigade. The series preserves its traditional character and offers runners a challenging, authentic winter running experience.
course_highlights: Rural course with a traditional character
Event with a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere
Support from local volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather conditions: around 7 °C, mostly rainy; start location: Beverstedt-Wellen; the event is part of a series with several distances (3 km and 11 km). Distances: 3 km, 11 km; traditional, community-oriented; December weather is usually cool and rainy.

name: Sparkassen Advents-Cross der LG Nordheide
location: Jahnplatz, Schützengehölz, Winsen (Luhe), Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: U10-U16 2,50 Euro, U18-U20 3,00 Euro, Erwachsene 5,00 Euro
description: The Sparkassen Advent Cross-Country Run hosted by LG Nordheide takes place on December 13, 2026, in Winsen (Luhe), at Schützengehölz by Jahnplatz. The event is open to participants from across the state and offers races for all age groups from U10 to seniors, including age groups up to M/W 95. The races cover various distances of approximately 1,400 meters to 9 kilometers. Team rankings are held separately for male and female participants. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available, as well as signposted parking nearby.
course_highlights: Various distances from approx. 1,400 m to 9 km
Races from U10 through senior age groups, including M/W 95
Venue in Schützengehölz, with a signposted walking route
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a 50% surcharge. Entries submitted by email incur a surcharge of EUR 1.00 per start. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available. Parking is available behind the Stadthalle and at the Stadthalle car park; the venue is about a 300-meter walk through Schützengehölz along a signposted route. Registration constitutes consent to the publication of the participant’s name, year of birth, club, and photo and video material in results lists and the media. Distances range from approximately 1,400 m to longer distances; registration is open until December 6, 2026. Late entries are possible for an additional fee. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available; parking is behind the Stadthalle.

name: Winterlauf
description: The Aachen Winter Run is a traditional 16.1-kilometre race from Bürgerhaus Venwegen to the ATG sports field at Am Chorusberg. Held annually in December, it attracts many runners of all ages. The route passes through the Voreifel and the city of Aachen, offering varied and scenic running. The event is well organised, with race bib collection available on several days, a bus transfer to the start and refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: 16.1 km route from Bürgerhaus Venwegen to the ATG sports field at Am Chorusberg
Run through the Voreifel and the city of Aachen
Start at Bürgerhaus Venwegen, with a heated indoor area and refreshments
additional: Race bibs can be collected at various locations on several days before the race. Free bus transport from Chorusberg to the start is available from 8:15 a.m.; taking an early bus is recommended. Bürgerhaus Venwegen is heated and serves as a place to wait and get refreshments. Clothing is transported from the start to the finish. Late entries are not possible. Starting places can be transferred up to one hour before the race via the individual change link or by email. The Winter Run takes place on 13 December 2026; further information about start times, registration and logistics is available on the website.

name: X-MAS Trail
description: The X-MAS Trail in Weiskirchen is a challenging winter trail run through the picturesque landscape of the Hunsrück-Hochwald Nature Park. Three demanding courses with singletrack trails and technical sections lead through moss-covered forests, over small bridges and past rock formations. Participants need suitable equipment and experience handling winter conditions, as runners are self-sufficient. The course is marked with flagging tape and spray chalk, and there is a course briefing before the run. This is not a road race, but a genuine trail run with strict cutoff times.
course_highlights: A high proportion of singletrack, with many technical sections
Winter scenery in the Hunsrück-Hochwald Nature Park, with moss-covered forests and waterways
Sections crossing small bridges and passing rock formations and the spectacular Felsenpfad
additional: Mandatory equipment is required, especially for the longer distances. The course will be confirmed shortly before the race and made available to download. The longer distances are part of the ITRA National League Challenge. Cutoff times are strictly enforced, and sweepers may remove very slow participants from the race. The event is not suitable for walkers. Aid stations are available on the longer distances. A headlamp is recommended and mandatory for the long distance. Winter trails, technical sections, no walkers permitted, mandatory equipment required, course changes possible, no dogs allowed.

name: Zeller MEHR Raiffeisenbank-Adventslauf
location: Zell an der Mosel, Cochem-Zell, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Zeller MEHR Raiffeisenbank Advent Run is an atmospheric race in Zell an der Mosel, traditionally held during Advent. The event offers runners a festive atmosphere and an attractive course through the picturesque Moselle landscape. The race is open to all ages and ability levels, combining sporting ambition with Christmas spirit.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque Moselle landscape
Festive Advent atmosphere
Suitable for all ages and ability levels

Die 16 km Strecke besteht aus zwei Runden mit teils hügeligem Gelände rund um Borgholzhausen und einer Schleife um den Barenberg, die zweimal durchlaufen wird. name: Santa Run

The event was launched in 2008 by Rotary Club Gorinchem and has since grown into a nationwide phenomenon, with dozens of editions in the Netherlands and a few abroad. In 2019, Santa Runs were held in 58 cities, raising a combined total of more than €450,000 for over 100 good causes. The Rotary Santa Run aims for a uniform look and a powerful mass start on the Saturday before Christmas.

Each location has a minimum of 240 participants, and the event is preferably held on the Saturday before Christmas. The organisation is a turnkey concept, with an operations manual, an emergency plan and a uniform look. Participants dress as Santa Claus and support good causes; the event takes place in multiple cities and has a strong focus on charity and community spirit.

additional: Late entries are possible online until December 27 at 10:00 and in person on December 27 from 15:00 to 17:00 and on December 28 from 10:30 until one hour before the respective start. Only cash payments are accepted in person. Free parking is available in the parking garage at Saarland University, about a 5-minute walk from the start area. Certificates can be printed online at www.meisterchip.de. Trophies and vouchers are awarded to the top finishers in various categories, and medals are awarded in the children’s races. Winter race; free parking in the parking garage at Saarland University; in-person late entry is cash only.

name: Drenthe Trail Run
price_range: 7 km: €25,50 + €1 administratiekosten; 18 km: €36,50 + €1 administratiekosten; 26 km: €42,50 + €1 administratiekosten
description: The Drenthe Trail Run is a winter trail run taking place on 29 December 2026 in Norg. Participants can choose from three distances: 7, 18 or 26 kilometres, which wind through the forests, heathland and unpaved trails of Drenthe. The event celebrates experiencing nature, adventure and a friendly atmosphere, with a varied course suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The start and finish are in Norg, and time slots are used to ensure the course remains calm and safe.
course_highlights: A varied course through forests, sandy roads and trails
Routes of 7, 18 and 26 km through Drenthe’s most beautiful natural areas
A winter trail focused on nature and adventure
additional: Time slots are used for each distance to keep the course calm and safe. Participants receive individual timekeeping and have their first name printed on their race bib. Aid stations offer snacks, sports nutrition and water; participants are asked to bring their own cup for sustainability reasons. First aid and technical support are available at the start/finish. After the finish, there will be food, drinks, music and a friendly atmosphere. A bag-drop area is available for dry clothes. Trail shoes are recommended. Registration opens on 17 June 2023 at 08:00, with time slots used to ensure safety and keep the course calm. The event highlights outdoor adventure, respect for nature and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Oliebollenloop
description: The 53rd Oliebollenloop through the beautiful Amsterdamse Waterleidingduin (De Oase entrance) starts again on Saturday, December 28, 2024. There is a k

name: Wisent Winter Trail
description: The Wisent Winter Trail is the most convivial trail to round off the year! What can you expect? Beautiful courses, almost 100% unpaved

name: Sylvesterloop Elsloo
description: On Tuesday evening, 31 December 2024, the Regiobank-Sylvesterloop will be held in Elsloo for the 41st time. This popular classic, geo

name: Vaarderhoogt Sylvester By Night

price_tiers.distance: Vaarderhoogt Sylvester by Night Family Run

description: The Vaarderhoogt Sylvester by Night Run is a unique evening race in the atmospherically lit Soester Dunes. Participants can choose to run up to three laps of 1,300 metres each through a beautifully decorated forest and dune area, following the official Sylvestercross course. The finish is at the familiar location, offering a preview of the big Sylvestercross day. Alongside the run, there is also a Family Run for children and a walking tour, making the event suitable for the whole family. Get ready for a magical evening full of fun and a special running experience.
course_highlights: Run through a beautifully lit forest and dune area
Official Sylvestercross course
Finish at the familiar location in the Soester Dunes
additional: Participants can order an LED foam stick when registering and collect it along with their race number. The walking tour starts at 18:30 and is one lap of 1.3 km. The Family Run is specifically for children aged 5 to 15 and starts at 19:00. The course is difficult to navigate with strollers and walkers. The run offers a magical evening, with various experience points along the course. Decorations, optional foam stick, registration with the option to enter the originality prize, start and finish in the dunes, donation to the Prinses Maxima Centrum Foundation.

name: AH Oudejaars Crossloop Vorden
location: Het Grote Veld, Vorden, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: The AH Oudejaars Crossloop in Vorden takes place on Wednesday, December 30, and offers a scenic run along the forest trails and sandy paths of the Het Grote Veld nature reserve. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, or 15 km, and there is a special 1 km kids’ cross for children aged 4 to 12. The organizers create a friendly atmosphere, with coffee, tea, and oliebollen after the race, and prizes in various categories. Registration is open until December 27 at 18:00, after which participants will receive their race numbers.
course_highlights: Run along forest trails and sandy paths in the Het Grote Veld nature reserve
Distances of 5, 10, and 15 km available
A 1 km kids’ cross for children aged 4–12
additional: The entry fee includes coffee or tea and an oliebol after the race. Kids’ cross participants receive squash drink, an oliebol, and a medal. The race number with a timing chip is emailed the day before the race and can be collected up to half an hour before the start. Registration on race day is not possible. Registration is open from mid-September until December 27 at 18:00. The event attracts many participants from the region and is known for its friendly atmosphere.

name: Nytårsløb
description: The New Year’s Run 2024 starts and finishes in Østerbro, with participants running through Fælledparken. It’s a fantastic opportunity to say goodbye to the old year

name: Total El Nytårsløbet
description:
New Year's Race in Herning 2025 – A festive start to the new year!
Start the new year with fresh air, a great atmosphere and plenty of energy at New Year's

name: Run for KiKa Marathon
description: A (half) marathon with Run for KiKa Marathon is about much more than just running 42.195 or 21.1 kilometres. You train and raise money for

name: Oudjaarsrun
description: On 31 December 2026, LSV Invictus will organize the second edition of the Oudjaarsrun in Appelscha, a sporting event to end the year actively. Participants can choose between two distances: 5 km and 10 km. The course is fully paved and runs through the beautiful Drents-Friese Wold National Park, with the start and finish in the center of Appelscha. After the finish, there will be an opportunity to celebrate the sporting year with music and a convivial atmosphere in the Steegdenhal.
course_highlights: Fully paved course
Run through Drents-Friese Wold National Park
Start and finish in the center of Appelscha, on Boerestreek
additional: Bib pickup and the awards ceremony will take place in the Steegdenhal. After the event, there will be a festive gathering with music and a convivial atmosphere. Ample parking is available for participants and visitors. Start times are 11:00 and 11:10. Parking is available at Pretpark Duinenzathe and in the center of Appelscha. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km. Festive gathering in the Steegdenhal.

name: Oliebollenloop
description: The Oliebollenloop is the final sporting challenge of the year in the north, held on 31 December in and around Gorredijk. The race offers 4-mile and 10 km distances, with separate starts for solo runners and businesses. There is also a kids’ run with three distances for different age groups. The route is safe from traffic and well marked, and a delicious reward awaits afterwards: oliebollen.
course_highlights: 4-mile and 10 km courses through Gorredijk with aid stations
Low-traffic route with traffic marshals for safety
Kids’ run with distances of 600m, 900m and 1600m for different age groups
additional: Kids’ run start times: 600m at 10:45, 900m at 11:00, 1600m at 11:15. 10 km starts at 12:05, 4 miles at 12:20. Business run available for teams of 3–5 participants; finishing time is based on the first 3 finishers. No race-day registration. Register online until 30 December at 22:00 or until the limit is reached. Entries in October and November receive a free Craft Oliebollen running shirt. Bib transfers are possible via the platform until 13 December at 23:59. Registration is online until 30 December; no race-day registration is available. Start times are around 12:00, with the start location at Sportcentrum Kortezwaag. Parking advice: cycle or carpool; road closure from 11:00.

name: Sylvestercross
description: The Sylvestercross is an annual running event in the Lange Duinen of Soest, known as the most beautiful cross-country race in the Netherlands. The event takes place over two days, with atmospheric Sylvester by Night runs on 30 December and various fun runs and official races on 31 December, including cross-country races for different age groups and ability levels. Since 2025, the Sylvestercross has held bronze status in the World Athletics Cross Country Tour, making it an important event for competitive runners. The course features challenging routes through dunes and woodland, with special loops for young runners and recreational runners, as well as a new 21.5 km trail run.
course_highlights: Course in the Lange Duinen of Soest, through dunes and woodland
Four different loops ranging from 400 metres to 3,300 metres
New Sylvester Trail Run of 21.5 km along the former forest marathon course
additional: The Sylvestercross includes various races for different age groups and ability levels, including a relay cross-country race and a G-cross. The relay cross-country race is a team event with 4 participants, each running one 1,900-metre loop. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The Sylvestercross is part of the National Cross-Country Circuit and gives athletes the opportunity to earn points in the World Athletics rankings. Various distances and categories, including a night run and relays; event on 30 and 31 December 2026; registration available via the website.

name: Tankloop Westkapelle
location: De Tank, Zeedijk, Westkapelle, Zeeland, Netherlands
description: The Tankloop Westkapelle is a running event held annually on the dike in Westkapelle. The race offers a unique experience along the coastline, with a challenging course suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The Dynamica Sport organizers welcome participants of all levels for a sporting end to the year. You can easily register via the registration link provided.
course_highlights: Run along the sea dike in Westkapelle
Unique coastal course with beautiful views
Suitable for both competitive and recreational runners
additional: Register via inschrijven.nl; participant list available; invitation available as an attachment; Dynamica members receive a discount on the entry fee when registering in advance. Paved terrain, registration open until 29 December at 23:59, start and finish at ‘De Tank’ on the Zeedijk, first aid available, no showers available

name: Silvesterlauf Bremen
description: The Silvesterlauf Bremen is a popular running event on December 31 that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers various distances, from 400 m for Bambinis to 10 km for experienced runners, through the beautiful surroundings of Werdersee. Alongside a sporting end to the year, festive music and a New Year’s Eve atmosphere make for a special experience. Participants in costumes are warmly invited to add their own creative touch to the event and run together into the New Year.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Werdersee
More accessible 2.5 km route for beginners and people with special needs
Festive New Year’s Eve atmosphere with music and medals for all finishers
additional: Start times vary by distance: 5 km run at 12:00, 2.5 km walk at 12:30, 5 km and 10 km walks at 12:50, 400 m Bambini run at 12:55, 1,000 m kids’ run at 13:00, 10 km run at 13:15. Race materials can be shipped for a fee. More accessible 2.5 km route suitable for everyone. Costumes are expressly encouraged for a special New Year’s Eve feeling. Various distances, including children’s and walking options, festive atmosphere, medals for everyone, creative costumes welcome.

name: Silvesterlauf Hannover
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a traditional year-end race held on December 31. The event features a 7.7 km loop, mostly on paved paths through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and along the Stichkanal to the Ihme. The race starts at 13:00 at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer. After the race, participants can refuel with mulled wine and bratwurst and receive a finisher wheat beer glass as a keepsake. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and mass start.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course goes through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the Stichkanal
Start and finish at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer
additional: Mass start; mulled wine and bratwurst at low prices after the race; every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass in the event design. On-the-day registration is possible on site from 12:00 (cash or PayPal). The race takes place on December 31, with online registration open until 31.12.25 at 10:00. There is a mass start and festivities that make the race a sociable way to end the year.

name: Silvesterlauf Wernigerode
description: The 49th Wernigerode New Year's Eve Run is the perfect end to the year in the Harz district for running enthusiasts. The race takes place on December 31, 2026, at Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode and offers a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V., this popular event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode
Run through Wernigerode's picturesque old town
Festive end-of-year atmosphere in the Harz district
additional: The course goes around Wernigerode Castle; start and finish at Marstall; no shower facilities; several events, including youth races and training sessions.

name: Silvesterlauf Burgwedel
description: The Burgwedel New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Burgwedel. The races cover several distances, including 10.6 km, 5.3 km and 2 km for children, and follow a scenic course with the start and finish at the modernised stadium on Ramhorst. The event attracts numerous runners and spectators and is organised by Schwimmverein Burgwedel. It is a popular sporting way to round off the year, with a family-friendly atmosphere and a diverse range of participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the recently modernised stadium on Ramhorst
Distances: 10.6 km, 5.3 km and a 2 km children’s race
Beautiful blue running track in the stadium
additional: The starting signal is given promptly at 12:00 by the local mayor. The event traditionally takes place on Ramhorst, where the series began in 1984. There is an award for the largest group, and the event is supported by numerous volunteers, sponsors and spectators. Distances: 2 km, 5.3 km, 10 km; December weather is usually cold and snowy; the event involves local clubs, fire brigades and families; course records have been set.

name: Silvesterlauf Salzgitter
organizer: Move SZ - Wir fördern Sport e.V.
description: The Silvesterlauf at Salzgittersee is a traditional running event held on the last day of the year. The event offers various running and walking distances for different age groups and ability levels. The race is a sporting highlight and a meeting place for runners and spectators who want to end the year on an active note together. Alongside the sporting competition, there is a team classification and an awards ceremony that gives special recognition to the children’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes at Salzgittersee of 5.7 km and 11.4 km
Children’s race over 1.2 km for age groups 2013 to 2019
Team classification based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners
additional: Race number collection and late registration (plus €3) from 16.12. to 28.12.2025 at the Stadtbad Salzgitter pool cashier. Changes of registration and late registration are possible on 30.12. (15:00–17:00) and 31.12. (11:00–13:00) in the Stadtbad foyer. Online registration is available until 31.12.25 at 10:00 without an extra fee, unless the event is full. Team classification based on the combined times of each team’s three fastest runners. Race packs do not need to be collected in person. Online registration until 31.12.25, race number collection at Stadtbad Salzgitter, refreshments in the finish area, parking available at Salzgittersee, dogs and jogging strollers allowed

name: Silvesterlauf Magdeburg
description: The Magdeburg New Year's Eve Run is a traditional popular sporting event that has been held on the last day of the year for over 50 years. It brings together runners of all ages and ability levels in the city of Magdeburg. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and its sporting end to the year, with over 900 participants crossing the finish line. The run is part of the Magdeburg City Rankings and is very popular in the region.
course_highlights: 5 km loop, run twice
10 km main race
1.5 km children's run for the youngest participants
additional: The New Year's Eve Run is the eighth and final event in the Magdeburg City Rankings. More than 950 runners of all ages take part. The event is organized by the Magdeburger LaufKultur 08 e.V. club. Courses, registration, results, photos, press reports; the weather in December is usually cold and snowy.

name: Silvesterlauf Berlin
description: The Berlin New Year’s Eve Run on December 31 gives runners the chance to end the year on an active note. The event offers three different distances (4 km, 6 km and 10 km) through the scenic Grunewald, with challenging sections such as Drachenberg and Teufelsberg rewarded with great views over Berlin. Alongside the sporting experience, fun takes centre stage, particularly with the option to run in costume and prizes for the best costumes. At the finish, all finishers receive a delicious Pfannkuchen as a sweet keepsake to hang around their neck.
course_highlights: Route through the Grunewald, including Drachenberg and Teufelsberg
Fantastic views across Berlin before the turn of the year
A choice of distances: 4 km, 6 km and 10 km
additional: The start and finish are near Mommsenstadion (Waldschulallee 34, 14055 Berlin). The race pass and race number will be sent by email in advance. Race materials can be collected on site from 10:00 a.m. on the event day. Timing is provided by a disposable transponder attached to the race number. The time limit is 1 hour 30 minutes. Water, tea and Pfannkuchen are available at the finish. Only reusable cups are used. Changing facilities are available at Mommsenstadion, but there is no bag drop. Results and certificates are available online that evening. Distances vary between 2, 4, 6 and 10 km; a run for all age groups; start and finish at Mommsenstadion; refreshments include Pfannkuchen, with awards for the top finishers and the most original costumes.

name: Silvesterlauf Neuss
description: The Silvesterlauf Neuss is an established 10 km race that starts at 12:00 on December 31, 2026, at the Uedesheimer Deichtor. The course offers beautiful views of the Rhine as it passes through the Rhine meadows and Uedesheim fields, making it a perfect sporting end to the year. The event is suitable for all runners, from beginners to professionals, and combines a sporting challenge with a festive year-end atmosphere. The race also supports Aktion Luftballon, the support association for the children’s clinic at Lukaskrankenhaus Neuss, through fundraising.
course_highlights: 10 km course approved by the DLV
Start at the Uedesheimer Deichtor with views of the Rhine
Run through the Rhine meadows and Uedesheim fields
additional: A supporting program in the start/finish area at the Deichtor creates a pleasant year-end atmosphere. The race raises funds for Aktion Luftballon, the support association for the children’s clinic at Lukaskrankenhaus Neuss. Record participation in 2025, with 1,040 registrations and 859 finishers. The event begins at 12:00 on December 31, 2026, at the Uedesheimer Rhine embankment and features a 10 km course. Training plans are also available, and the event is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic running route.

name: Silvesterlauf Nürnberg
description: The Silvesterlauf Nürnberg is a traditional running event held annually on December 31 around Lake Wöhrder See. Various races are offered for all age groups, from the Bambini run through the children’s and fun runs to the 10 km main race. The course is mostly flat and entirely paved, making fast times possible. The event is open to runners of all abilities and offers a festive atmosphere to round off the year.
course_highlights: Loop around Lake Wöhrder See, entirely paved
Flat course, ideal for fast times
Out-and-back courses for the Bambini and children’s races along the northern shore
additional: The start and finish are in front of Café Tante Noris im Wastl on Johann-Soergel-Weg. Race packs are distributed at Sebastianspital. Nordic walking poles and jogging strollers are allowed in the fun run, but not in the main race for safety reasons. Participant limits apply: 150 for the Bambini and children’s races, and 1,300 for the fun and main races. A Silvesterlauf long-sleeved shirt can be ordered for an additional charge; children’s sizes can only be ordered until 16.11.2025. Races take place on 31.12.; registration is open until 18.12.2025. Participant numbers are limited, and race-day entries may be possible for certain races. Race number distribution is at Sebastianspital. Participation is open from certain birth years.

name: Silvesterlauf Schifferstadt
description: The Silvesterlauf Schifferstadt is a long-established running event held annually on December 31 at the School and Sports Center on Neustückweg. The flat, fast courses follow paved and compacted paths and finish in the stadium, where spectators can watch the runners cross the line. Alongside the main race, there is also a mini run for children, catering to the growing number of participants. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and attracts runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Flat, fast courses on paved and compacted paths
Finish in the stadium, with the course adjusted to ease congestion at the bottleneck
Mini run for children with its own course
additional: The finish was adjusted in 2012 to ease congestion at bottlenecks in the stadium. The event is approved by the DLV. Children aged 2–5 can take part. Race numbers are issued to all participants. The event takes place at the School and Sports Center on Neustückweg. Registration opens in October 2025 and includes course maps and children’s races.

name: Silvesterlauf Zossen-Ludwigsfelde
description: The 46th Zossen-Ludwigsfelde New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional race covering approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde. The event begins at Zossen Town Hall Square with a ceremonial start at 9:00 a.m. and the official start at 9:15 a.m. on the outskirts of Zossen. The route follows firmly frozen paths that are easy to run on in good weather. At the finish in Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, participants receive a commemorative medal and a prosecco as a reward.
course_highlights: Approximately 18 km from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde
Start on the outskirts of Zossen, beyond the railway crossing on the old B246
Finish at Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, with a medal and prosecco
additional: Ceremonial start at 9:00 a.m. at Zossen Town Hall Square. In frosty conditions, the route is firmly frozen and easy to run on. At the finish, runners receive a commemorative medal and prosecco. Registration deadline: December 28, 2025; route may be frozen depending on the weather; commemorative medal and prosecco for finishers; event away from the stadium.

name: Silvesterlauf Gießen
description: The traditional Sparkasse Gießen New Year’s Eve Run takes place on 31 December 2026 in Gießen-Ost and offers runners a varied event with four distances: a schoolchildren’s race, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The event is sold out, with 1,800 starting places, and is known for its family atmosphere and high-quality organisation. The start and finish are at Karl-Reuter-Weg, and all finishers receive a medal sponsored by Autohaus Erben. In addition to the races, there are awards and ceremonies for walkers and Nordic walkers, as well as a team competition with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Karl-Reuter-Weg in Gießen-Ost
Four distances: schoolchildren’s race, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon
Separate results and awards ceremony for walkers and Nordic walkers
additional: Race-number pickup is available before Christmas at Sparkasse Gießen premises and on the day before the race at Sporthalle Ost. Changing and shower facilities are available at Sporthalle Ost. Every finisher receives a medal; for the first time, fruit will be provided in the finish area. Start times are staggered to ease congestion on the course. The field is limited to 2,200 participants, and medals go to the first 2,000 finishers. Finisher shirts can be ordered at an additional cost. Parking is available at Philosophikum I and the Studierendenwerk on Otto-Behaghel-Straße. GPX files of the courses are available and can be used with navigation apps. Participant limit: 2,200. Online registration is open until 27 December 2025. Race-number pickup is on 27.12.2025. Medals for the first 2,000 finishers. Entry fee includes a deposit. Shower and changing facilities are available at Sporthalle Ost.

name: Silvesterlauf Frankfurt
location: Deutsche Bank Park, Frankfurt, Hesse, Germany
description: The Spiridon Mainova New Year's Eve Run in Frankfurt is a traditional 10 km race taking place on December 31, 2026, at Deutsche Bank Park. The course is mostly flat and runs through wooded areas on asphalt and well-maintained forest paths. It is accurately measured according to AIMS rules and is open to both club and recreational runners. In addition to the main race, there are also schoolchildren’s and Bambini races, which are particularly popular and regularly see record participation. The event is organized by Spiridon Frankfurt e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a broad field of participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course, mostly through woodland, on asphalt and well-maintained forest paths
Mostly flat and accurately measured according to AIMS rules
Every kilometer is marked
additional: Start and finish at the Wintersporthalle at Deutsche Bank Park. Participation is limited to a maximum of 3,000 athletes. Race materials are mailed to participants who register in advance; late registrants receive them at the venue. There are schoolchildren’s races over 2 km and 4 km, as well as Bambini races. The race is eligible for best-list rankings and is a scoring event in the Rosbacher Main-Lauf-Cup 2025. The HLV Frankfurt district championships are held as part of the race. The New Year's Eve Run is open to club and recreational runners, with the start and finish at the Wintersporthalle at Deutsche Bank Park. Registration is online only. Race numbers include a chip, and there is refreshments at the finish, as well as showers and toilets in the hall.

name: Silvesterlauf Bad Staffelstein
description: The Silvesterlauf Bad Staffelstein is a traditional running competition held annually on December 31. The event attracts both recreational and competitive runners and offers an appealing course in the Bad Staffelstein region. The race is known for its team rankings and the personal bests achieved by participants. The event is organized by Böhnlein Sports Bamberg e.V., which also provides professional training programs.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer race course
Team rankings with strong participation
Appealing course in Bad Staffelstein
additional: Böhnlein Sports Bamberg e.V. offers professional training with experienced coaches. The event is part of the club calendar and is organized by a dedicated team. It features strong team rankings, and participants often achieve personal bests. The event takes place at the Adam-Riese-Halle in Bad Staffelstein and offers both individual and team competitions. It is a popular opportunity to end the year on an athletic note.

name: Silvesterlauf Tuttlingen
description: The Silvesterlauf Tuttlingen is a popular running event with a flat, officially measured course along the Danube that is eligible for rankings. Events include 5 km and 10 km races and walking, complemented by Bambini and schoolchildren’s races over shorter distances. The event attracts many participants each year and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, supported by numerous volunteers and sponsors. The 13th edition takes place on December 31, 2026, and promises another sporting highlight to close out the year.
course_highlights: Flat, 5,000-meter loop course along the Danube
Course officially measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings
Bambini and schoolchildren’s races over short distances of 250 to 1,000 meters
additional: The event set a new record in 2025 with 2,512 participants. The 10 km course record is 29:30 minutes. The start and finish for the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races are at the Ferdinand-von-Steinbeis School. The schoolchildren’s races go around the Fritz-Erler School. The course is flat and measured by the DLV. Children’s and schoolchildren’s races are included, and registration and results are available online.

name: Silvesterlauf Schwalmstadt
description: The New Year's Eve Run in Schwalmstadt-Ziegenhain is a traditional race that has taken place every year on December 31 since 1970. The event offers a short 2.7 km race for children and young people, as well as a long 8.1 km race for adults. The race marks the end of the Schwalm-Eder Cup series and is known for its musical program, with samba rhythms by Sola Quente accompanying runners along the course. The event is organized by a dedicated team from TuSpo Ziegenhain and is a popular way for many track and field athletes to end the year.
course_highlights: Short race: 1 lap = 2,740 m; long race: 3 laps = 8,100 m
Samba rhythms by Sola Quente provide musical accompaniment
The course runs through Schützenwald, with parking nearby
additional: Parking is available in the woods between the hospital and the start. Access to the parking lot at the start is possible until 12:45 p.m. After 12:45 p.m., free parking is available at the Asklepios Hospital parking lot. The awards ceremony takes place at the venue in Schützenwald after the races. The race takes place in Schützenwald; online registration is available. The start and finish area is by the pond at Ziegelhütte. Parking is available nearby. There are no shower facilities. Food and drinks are available, along with a program of music and community activities.

name: Silvesterlauf Winsen (Aller)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt für Erwachsene und Jugendliche 5,00 € und ist im Vorfeld per Überweisung zu entrichten.

description: The MTV "Fichte" Winsen (Aller) New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional year-end running event that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 1,600 m for children to 10,300 m for adults, as well as a 6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure. The run starts and finishes at the Allertalsporthalle, where changing rooms and showers are also available. The event is officially sanctioned by the German Athletics Association and features a celebratory awards ceremony for the fastest participants in each distance.
course_highlights: Distances from 1,600 m to 10,300 m for all age groups
6,400 m walking route with no competitive pressure
Start and finish at the Allertalsporthalle, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Race bib distribution from 2 December 2024 at the business office (Mon–Fri, 8:00–12:30). Late registration is possible on the event day from 12:00 to 13:45 for an additional fee. Plenty of parking is available at the Allertalsporthalle. Awards ceremony at approximately 15:30. Distances: 3 km, 5 km, 10.3 km, children’s race 1.6 km; walkers welcome. Start at 14:30. Register online or on site.

name: 12. Silvesterlauf an der Leine
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a popular end-of-year race that traditionally starts at 1:00 p.m. on December 31. The event offers a 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths along the Leine, through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and back along the Ihme. The race is organized by Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC), Bladerunner and Trimindous UG, and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with mulled wine and bratwurst after the race. Every finisher receives a wheat beer glass featuring the event design as a keepsake. There is also a walking category, making the event appealing to a range of participants.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course runs through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the Stichkanal
Return route along the Ihme
additional: Mass start at 1:00 p.m. Late entries are available on site on the day of the event from 12:00 p.m., payable in cash or via PayPal. Every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass featuring the event design. There is a walking category. The event venue is the clubhouse of Hannoverscher Radsportclub (HRC) at Weddigenufer 23, near Unisport. The race has a relaxed atmosphere, with mulled wine, bratwurst and a wheat beer glass for finishers. There is also a walking category, and the course is ideal for anyone who wants to round off the running year in good company.

name: 25. VR-Bank Mitte Silvesterlauf
location: Seeburger See, Bernshausen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The VR-Bank Mitte New Year’s Eve Run is an active way to round off the year, taking place around Lake Seeburger See in Bernshausen. The flat loop course on paved paths offers runners an attractive route of one or two laps around the lake, depending on the distance. The event traditionally takes place on 31 December and welcomes runners of all abilities for a festive end to the year. The start and finish areas are on Kreisstraße 106, near the Bernshausen multipurpose hall.
course_highlights: Flat loop course around Lake Seeburger See
Paved paths
5 km lap (1 lap around the lake) and 10 km lap (2 laps around the lake)
additional: Bib pickup on event day from 10:30 a.m. at the Bernshausen multipurpose hall, until 30 minutes before each start. Online late registration is not possible after 26.12.2025. The start and finish are on Kreisstraße 106, near the Bernshausen multipurpose hall. No bib pickup at Laufline Göttingen. No refund of the entry fee is available if a participant does not start or if the event is cancelled. Run on paved paths, online registration until 26.12.2025, bib pickup in Bernshausen, no late registration, no showers, winter conditions possible, recommended parking in Seeburg.

name: 38. Silvesterlauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The SC Altenrheine New Year’s Eve Run is the region’s sporting finale to the year and, with up to 800 participants of all ages, is one of the largest running events in the area. The event offers various distances that run through Altenrheine and each finish with a lap of the stadium. The varied courses include out-and-back sections and loops through the town. The run is a popular opportunity to end the year on a sporting note and enjoy a sense of community.
course_highlights: 600 m out-and-back section along Schürweg towards the car park, plus 1 lap of the stadium
2,000 m out-and-back section along Schürweg towards Außenhook, plus 1 lap of the stadium
10,000 m with 3 loops through Altenrheine, plus 1 lap of the stadium
additional: The event is designed for up to 800 athletes of all ages. Each course finishes with a lap of the stadium. Distances range from 600 m to 10,000 m. Registration is online; registration details and prices are not explicitly listed on the website. The run offers a festive atmosphere at the end of the year, with courses in the region and a broad participant base.

name: 40. Haseder Silvesterlauf
description: The Hasede New Year's Eve Run is a friendly, community-oriented event in Hasede, organized by TuS Hasede, a local sports club with a range of activities. The run is part of the club calendar and is aimed primarily at the local community, without a commercial focus or large numbers of visitors from further afield. There are two distances, 600 meters and 10 kilometers, but no detailed course description has been published. The event offers a relaxed way to close out the year in the Giesen region.
course_highlights: Two distances: 600 m and 10 km
Organized by the local sports club TuS Hasede
Typical winter weather; snow cover is possible
additional: The run takes place in Giesen. December weather is typically cold, with temperatures around 3 °C, lows of about -2 °C, and frequent snow cover. In addition to the New Year's Eve Run, TuS Hasede offers running groups, sports badge activities, and hikes. This is a local club event with no detailed course information, but a friendly community atmosphere. No exact entry fees are provided.

name: 44. Bad Harzburger Silvesterlauf
location: Sportpark an der Rennbahn, Bad Harzburg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Bad Harzburg New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event organized by MTK Bad Harzburg since 1981. The race takes place every year on December 31 in the Sportpark an der Rennbahn and is the oldest New Year’s Eve run in the region. The event offers several distances, including 2,500, 5,000 and 10,000 meters, run on a 2,500-meter loop. Participants can record and follow their lap times electronically, making the race especially appealing.
course_highlights: 2,500-meter loop in the Sportpark an der Rennbahn
Electronic chip timing with split times after each lap
Traditional New Year’s Eve run since 1981, with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: The race office opens at 11 a.m. on race day. Live results are available online for the first time at https://oresults.eu/events/2639. Timing is provided by a SportIdent chip, which is scanned after each lap on the 5,000- and 10,000-meter courses. Certificates and trophies are presented at 3:30 p.m. Distances: 2,500 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m; registration by post or on race day; electronic timing; awards ceremonies for top finishers; start at 1:30 p.m.

name: 47. Silvesterlauf rund um die Thülsfelder Talsperre
description: The 47th International New Year’s Eve Run around the Thülsfelder Talsperre is a traditional race held on New Year’s Eve in Molbergen, Lower Saxony. The course runs around the Thülsfelder Talsperre and offers two distances: 0.8 km and 16.1 km. Organized by SV Molbergen since 1975, the race is the final competition of the year for many runners and officially counts toward rankings. After the finish, traditional pea soup provides a sociable end to the event.
course_highlights: Loop course around the Thülsfelder Talsperre
Scenic route in Lower Saxony
Traditional start with a cannon shot
additional: The race starts with a cannon shot fired by a local fireworks club; traditional pea soup is served after the race; the event attracts many local runners and club runners; December weather is typically cold, with possible snowfall. Distances: 0.8 km and 16.1 km; held on December 31, 2026; traditional communal meal after the race; large fields of participants can cause bottlenecks at the start.

name: Aachener Silvesterlauf presented by J&J MedTech
description: The Aachen New Year’s Eve Run presented by J&J MedTech is a traditional New Year’s Eve race in Aachen, taking place on December 31, 2026. Two distances are offered: a short 1.9 km loop and a longer 9 km course. Now in its 49th edition, the event is firmly rooted in the region and gives runners the opportunity to round off the running year with a sporting finish through the city. The race takes place in typical December weather, with cool temperatures and frequently snow-covered roads.
course_highlights: Two distances: 1.9 km and 9 km
The course runs through the city of Aachen
Traditional end-of-year race on New Year’s Eve
additional: Typical December weather: approx. 3 °C, low of -2 °C, frequently snow-covered roads, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Start location: Aachen. Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. Terrain: city race; registration details not specified; typical December weather in Aachen

name: Active Laufshop Silvesterlauf
description: The ACTIVE LAUFSHOP New Year’s Eve Run in Münster is a popular running event traditionally held on December 31. Organized by Laufsportfreunde Münster e.V., one of Germany’s largest running clubs, the event offers several race distances for runners of all abilities. The routes pass through the city of Münster, creating a varied and lively atmosphere to round off the year. The event is open to recreational runners and competitive athletes and supports community and running in the region.
course_highlights: Distances: 3 km, 5 km and 10 km
Routes pass through the city of Münster
A varied and lively running atmosphere at the end of the year
additional: Course maps for the 3 km, 5 km and 10 km races are available as PDFs on the website. The run takes place annually on December 31 and is a popular way to end the year on an active note. Registration is already open.

description: The Backnang New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional race for everyone and the largest sporting event in Backnang. It offers various distances from 0.5 km to 10 km, including a Bambini Run, Mini Marathon, team relay, 5 km race and 10 km main race. The route runs through the city over cobblestones, creating a lively atmosphere with thousands of spectators. The run is a year-end highlight that appeals to recreational and elite athletes alike and is a celebration for the whole family.
course_highlights: Route through the city over cobblestones
2.5 km circuit per lap, with multiple laps depending on the distance
Thousands of spectators and a lively atmosphere with mulled wine and emotion
additional: Late entries are possible online on the event day until 12:00, subject to availability. Race numbers can be collected at the race office or at INTERSPORT GRABERT on 29 and 30 December. Late entries are not possible for the team relay. Age-group classifications follow the DLV event regulations. The event begins with the Bambini Run at 14:00, followed by the Mini Marathon, team relay and 5 km race, and ends with the 10 km main race at 15:10. Routes pass through the city centre, including cobblestones and short climbs, with various race categories and family activities.

name: Bietigheimer Silvesterlauf
description: The Bietigheim New Year’s Eve Run is one of the largest New Year’s Eve running events in southern Germany, attracting both elite and recreational runners. Traditionally held on December 31 in Bietigheim-Bissingen, it features a spectator-friendly, two-lap course through the Enz river meadows and the historic old town. With a lively atmosphere, commentary in the market square, and music along the course, the run is a special sporting spectacle at the end of the year. The event is organized by LG Neckar-Enz with support from the City of Bietigheim-Bissingen.
course_highlights: Two-lap course through the Enz river meadows and historic old town
Mostly paved roads and paths
Commentary in the market square and music along the course
additional: The participant limit of 4,000 runners has already been reached to ensure safety. Youth and women’s relay races are also available, with limited places. The event will be livestreamed from 13:45 on race day. Course in Bietigheim-Bissingen; registration until 17.12.2023; entry fee not explicitly stated; charity donations possible

price_range: 20 € für Erwachsene, 12 € für Jugendliche, 6 € für Kinder inkl. Buff
