description: The Bitburger 0.0% New Year’s Eve Run in Trier is an atmospheric year-end race that has been held annually on December 31 since 1990. The event follows a 1 km loop through Trier’s historic old town and is known for its Brazilian-inspired atmosphere, with samba drummers and Brazilian beauties. The 37th edition of the race in 2026 offers various events for children, young people and adults, including an elite race and a people’s race. Registration is online, and the event attracts runners of all ages who come together to end the year on a sporty note.
course_highlights: 1 km loop through Trier’s old town
Past many historic buildings
Atmospheric race with samba drummers and a Brazilian flair
additional: The event begins with a samba welcome at 13:00 by the Mayor of Trier. There are various races for toddlers, primary school pupils, young people and adults. Registration is exclusively online via cologne-timing.de with SEPA direct debit. The course is a flat 1 km loop through the historic city centre. There is a shortened 0.6 km loop for toddlers. The awards ceremony for the top six women and men takes place after the elite and people’s races. Course: 1 km loop through Trier; online registration; bib-number collection on December 30 and 31; chip timing; refreshments in the finish area; medical services on site.

name: Dübener Silvesterlauf
description: The 47th Dübener New Year's Eve Run takes place on December 31, 2025, in Bad Düben and is organized by SV Bad Düben, Athletics Department. The event gives runners of all ages the opportunity to end the year on an active note. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Bad Düben and promises a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Registration is online via SV Bad Düben.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic surroundings of Bad Düben
Traditional New Year's Eve run to close out the year
Event for children, young people, and adults
additional: The registration deadline is December 27, 2025. Registration is online via SV Bad Düben. The event is for children, young people, and active runners. The venue is the Obermühle sports facility, Parkstraße 1, Bad Düben. Cross-country run through heathland and woodland, children's and walking races, compact club event

name: Emmerthaler Silvesterlauf
description: The Emmerthal New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing race held on New Year’s Eve in Emmerthal, celebrating its 51st edition in 2026. Organized by TSG Emmerthal, the event gives runners the opportunity to track their performance with detailed lap times. It is supported by local sponsors and volunteer helpers from the fire brigade, police, the German Red Cross (DRK), and the club. The race is known for its friendly, community spirit and warmly welcomes all participants.
course_highlights: Distances: 300 m and 7 km
Results published with lap times
Race held on New Year’s Eve in Emmerthal
additional: Supported by local sponsors and helpers from the fire brigade, police, the German Red Cross (DRK), and TSG Emmerthal. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with frequent snowfall. The venue is in Emmerthal, with directions provided. December weather is typically cold and snowy; results are published with lap times; the event is very popular with runners and families.

name: Finale Furioso 2.0 - Silvesterlauf der DJK Göggelsbuch
location: Sportgelände des Vereins, Allersberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: Finale Furioso 2.0 is a New Year’s Eve run organized by DJK Göggelsbuch at the club’s sports grounds in Allersberg. The race is open to everyone, from ambitious runners to families with children, and offers several distances, including a Bambini run, a children’s race, a 5.5 km run and the 10 km main race. The flat routes follow paved farm and forest paths with short asphalt sections and are easy to run. After the race, the sports hall provides a cozy atmosphere with refreshments, music and an awards ceremony, under the motto “Welcome among friends.”
course_highlights: Flat routes over paved farm and forest paths
Short asphalt sections
Start and finish directly at the DJK clubhouse
additional: Refreshments in the sports hall include Weißwurst, Vienna sausages and pretzels; music and awards ceremony; a compact race day centered around the club. Distances: 700 m, 5.5 km, 10 km; family-friendly, flat routes, refreshments, music, awards ceremony, and food such as Weißwurst and pretzels.

name: Geraer Silvesterlauf
description: The Gera New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held annually on December 31 in Gera. The event offers various distances from 3 km to 20 km, with varied routes featuring elevation changes. The run is suitable for both competitive and recreational runners and ends in a festive atmosphere to mark the close of the year.
course_highlights: A range of distances: 3 km, 4 km, 11 km, and 20 km
Varied routes featuring elevation changes
Start and finish in front of the Panndorfhalle in Gera
additional: Online registration includes direct payment by credit card, Klarna, or PayPal. Participant certificates can be printed after the race until March 31 of the following year. The event offers extensive online media galleries and result records. The run takes place on December 31; details about the terrain and registration are available on the website.

name: Griesheimer REWE/Michael Weisbrod-Silvesterlauf
description: The Griesheim REWE/Michael Weisbrod New Year’s Eve Run is a longstanding running event held every year on December 31 in Griesheim. Organized by TuS Griesheim, one of the region’s largest sports clubs, the event offers a wide range of sporting activities for all age groups. Its motto is “One club for Griesheim. One club for everyone!” and it welcomes runners of all ability levels to end the year on an active note. The races take place around Gerhart-Hauptmann School and foster community spirit and sporting ambition.
course_highlights: Races on paved forest trails in the city forest
Various distances for all age groups
Measured courses for competitions
additional: The event includes children’s races, school races, walks, and road races. The start, finish, registration, and awards ceremonies are at Gerhart-Hauptmann School. The event is a local tradition with a broad range of participants.

name: Haseder Silvesterlauf
location: Dorfgemeinschaftshaus Giesen, Giesen, Hildesheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Hasede New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Giesen. With courses for children and adults, the run offers a sporting and sociable way to see out the year with friends and family. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, professional timing and dedicated team of volunteers. The courses run through the residential area around the sports hall and offer both short and longer distances for different ability levels.
course_highlights: The 600 m course loops once around the sports hall, through the residential area and back
5 km and 10 km courses for ambitious runners
Family-friendly atmosphere with children’s races over 0.6 km and 1.2 km
additional: Professional timing is provided by Eichels-Event from Hanover. The event is supported by a large team of volunteers. Bambini races are offered for children over 0.6 km and 1.2 km. The awards ceremony takes place in the sports hall, which also serves as a meeting point. Courses for children and adults, results, photo gallery, timing by Eichels-Event, refreshments on site

name: Hohenloher Silvesterlauf 1. Lauf zum 4 Jahreszeiten Laufcup 2027
description: The Hohenloher Silvesterlauf is a traditional race in Germany’s Hohenlohe region, starting and finishing in Hengstfeld on December 31, 2026. The event offers two distance options: a 5 km fun run and a 10 km main race. As the first race in the 4-Seasons Running Cup, it combines a year-end run with a larger series spanning all four seasons. The race is aimed at club runners, recreational joggers, and beginners who want to end the year on an active note.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the clubhouse of SpVgg Hengstfeld-Wallhausen e.V.
Two distances: 5 km and 10 km
Run through the scenic Hohenlohe region
additional: Typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. The race is the first of four events in the 2027 Seasons Running Cup. Start at 13:00; weather-dependent winter conditions with snow cover. Suitable for different ability levels and part of the Four Seasons Running Cup.

name: Hueber-Silvesterlauf in Pleinfeld
description: The Hueber New Year’s Eve Run in Pleinfeld is a long-standing race held at the Brombachhalle Sports Park. With over 600 participants, it marks the finale of the Raiffeisen Läufer-Cup Roth/Weißenburg series. The event offers races for Bambini, schoolchildren, walkers, and adult runners. After the competitions, the Brombachhalle provides refreshments and an awards ceremony for a pleasant end to the day.
course_highlights: Race at the Brombachhalle Sports Park in Pleinfeld
Distances: 0.5 km and 9 km
Finale of the Raiffeisen Läufer-Cup Roth/Weißenburg series
additional: After the races, the awards ceremony and refreshments take place in the Brombachhalle. The event is open to all age groups, from Bambini to adults. Distances: 0.5 km and 9 km; December weather: approx. 3°C, with snow cover on some days; includes an awards ceremony and refreshments after the race.

name: Int. Forchheimer Silvesterlauf
description: The Int. Forchheimer Silvesterlauf in Rheinstetten is a traditional New Year’s Eve race with a history spanning more than 30 years. The main race follows a 10 km loop through the Rheinauenwald, starting at Karlsruher Straße and Kastenwoertstraße, with the finish at the clubhouse of Sportfreunde Forchheim. Alongside the 10 km race, there is also a 5 km course, which is suitable for walkers and Nordic walkers. Timing is electronic, using a chip in the race bib, and the event relies on the voluntary commitment of many helpers. The award ceremony is brief, and certificates can be collected directly at the results tent to speed things up.
course_highlights: 10 km loop through the Rheinauenwald
Start at Karlsruher Straße and Kastenwoertstraße
Finish at the clubhouse of Sportfreunde Forchheim
additional: Timing uses a chip in the race bib, with timing mats at the start and finish for net times. There is no lengthy award ceremony; certificates are handed out at the results tent. The event relies heavily on volunteers. Alongside the 10 km race, there is also a 5 km course open to walkers and Nordic walkers. Course through the Rheinauenwald; chip-based timing; race on New Year’s Eve; December weather-dependent; no explicit price information.

name: Int. LEW Silvesterlauf Gersthofen
description: The International LEW Gersthofen New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional end-of-year race in Gersthofen, Bavaria. It offers various events, including the main race of approx. 9.7 km, a schoolchildren’s race, the Flitzi Run for the youngest participants, and walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, professional organisation and varied programme throughout the day, with musical accompaniment. The start and finish areas are on the grounds of the TSV sports hall in Gersthofen.
course_highlights: Main race of approx. 9.7 km through Gersthofen
Schoolchildren’s race of approx. 2.2 km
Walking and Nordic walking routes of approx. 9 km
additional: Start and finish on the grounds of the TSV sports hall in Gersthofen. Late entries are possible until 31.12.2026 for a fee. Race packs will be distributed on 30 and 31 December in the TSV Gersthofen sports hall. Group warm-up before Nordic walking and walks. Musical accompaniment by the Gersthofer Blasharmoniker on event day. Race routes, online registration, start in the sports hall, limited to 1,500 participants

name: Int. Silvester-Straßenlauf Kottweiler-Schwanden
description: The International New Year’s Eve Road Race in Kottweiler-Schwanden is a long-standing race held annually on December 31. The course covers 10 kilometers through the towns of Kottweiler, Steinwenden, Ramstein, and Miesenbach and is officially measured. The race starts at 14:20 at the Sulzbachhalle in the town center. Participants can expect a varied road course suitable for both competitive runners and running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer officially measured course
Route through Kottweiler, Steinwenden, Ramstein, and Miesenbach
Start and finish at the Sulzbachhalle in the town center
additional: The start and finish are at the Sulzbachhalle in the town center. The event is organized by SV Kottweiler-Schwanden 1946 e.V. The course is a road-race route and has been officially measured. Photo galleries and results from previous races are available on the website. The race starts at 14:20 at the Sulzbachhalle, and the route passes through the surrounding communities. The event offers trophies, certificates, and prizes in kind for the winners.

description: The International Britzingen New Year's Eve Run is a traditional race held on December 31 in Müllheim-Britzingen. The main race follows a 10 km loop through Britzingen, Güttigheim, St. Ilgen, Buggingen and Dattingen before returning to Britzingen. It is designed for runners aged 16 and over and offers a sporting challenge to round off the year. The event is organised by the TV Britzingen running group and concludes with an awards ceremony at the Neuenfelshalle.
course_highlights: 10 km loop through Britzingen, Güttigheim, St. Ilgen, Buggingen and Dattingen
Start and finish at the town hall in Müllheim-Britzingen
The course is challenging, so children under 16 may not enter the main race
additional: Race number collection takes place at Britzingen Primary School on two days (30.12.2025 from 15:00 to 18:30 and 31.12.2025 from 09:00 to 12:45). The field is limited to 1,100 runners. There is no on-site registration. The awards ceremony takes place at the Neuenfelshalle. For the St Nicholas Run on 14.12.2025, changing and shower facilities are not available at the Neuenfelshalle; toilets are available. New Year's Eve Run hoodies can be ordered. The participant limit is 1,100; registration is online, with no on-site registration. Parking is available in the surrounding area. The start is at 13:30. Prizes are awarded to the top runners, and all finishers receive a New Year's pretzel.

name: Kieler Silvesterlauf
description: The Kiel New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held on December 31 in Kiel-Ellerbek at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz. The event is organized by LTV Kiel-Ost e.V. and is limited to 250 runners. In addition to the sporting competition, there is a costume contest for individuals and teams, as well as a draw for prizes. The awards ceremony takes place in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School, and every participant receives a memento and has the option to order a certificate.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz
Limited to 250 runners
Costume contest for individuals and teams, with prizes
additional: Race materials can be collected at the sports hall on 30.12.2026 from 15:00 to 16:30 and on 31.12.2026 from 11:00 to 12:30. Late entrants must pay a fee and may receive a place if any are still available. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 14:30 in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School. There are no age-group rankings, but men and women are ranked separately. Participants who hand in their race number after the run are entered into a draw for prizes; attendance is required. Participant limit: 250; start times on 30.12.2026 and 31.12.2026; late registration possible; awards ceremony at approximately 14:30; certificates and prizes

name: Kißlegger Silvesterlauf
price_range: kostenlos für Kinder und Bambini, sonst nicht explizit angegeben
description: The Kißlegger New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Kißlegg. The run gives participants of all ages the opportunity to end the year on an active note. The event is organized by Sportgemeinde 1865 Kißlegg e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and efficient organization. Registration is online, and results are published promptly.
course_highlights: Various race distances, including the 7.7 km main race
Festive atmosphere with music and creative costumes
Free entry for children and Bambini
additional: Late registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start for a €3 late registration fee. The entry fee is collected during online registration and includes the chip number. The event was photographed, and pictures are available to download. The event features music, costumes, prizes, a festive atmosphere, free participation for children and Bambini, and refreshments provided by partner Linde.

name: Kölner Silvesterlauf

description: The Kölner GAG Silvesterlauf celebrates its 50th edition on 31.12.2026 and invites both experienced runners and newcomers to a traditional sporting end to the year. The course runs through the traffic-free parkland of Merheimer Heide and is flat, fast, DLV-certified, officially measured, and eligible for rankings. The start and finish are in front of the stadium. The 10 km race covers three large laps, while the 5 km race covers two shortened laps, each including a lap inside the stadium. Relay teams share the course and make their handovers in the stadium. The event offers races over 950 m for students, 5 km, 10 km, and relay races.
course_highlights: Course through the traffic-free parkland of Merheimer Heide
Flat and fast, DLV-certified and officially measured
Start and finish at the stadium, with laps through the stadium and park
additional: Online registration is open until 27.12.2026 at 24:00. Late registration is available on the event day until 45 minutes before the start. The race office is in the TuS Köln rrh. tennis clubhouse. Race numbers can be collected on the event day from 09:45 to 12:45. The relay changeover zone is in the stadium. Changing rooms and showers are available. Courses through Merheimer Heide; online registration until 27.12.; late registration on the event day; start and finish at the stadium; timing with the Raceresult system.

description: The münz New Year's Eve Run in Montabaur is a sporting highlight at the end of the year, delighting runners of all ages. The event offers various race distances, including Bambini, children’s and youth races, as well as 5K and 10K runs through the Montabaur city forest, featuring challenging elevation gains. Its welcoming atmosphere and professional organisation make the New Year’s Eve Run a popular event, with music, refreshments and a special year-end atmosphere.
course_highlights: 5K route with 70 metres of elevation gain
10K route with 150 metres of elevation gain
Run through the Montabaur city forest
additional: Late registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start of the respective race. Race packs can be collected from 16.12.2025; they will not be mailed. Strollers, walking poles, bicycles and dogs are not permitted on the course. Free drinks and a large, freshly baked pretzel are included at the finish. Prizes are awarded to the largest groups, and the fastest runners are honoured. Race routes, on-site registration, race packs available from 16.12.2025, participation for children and adults, donations to clubs/schools/running groups, extras included at the anniversary event

name: Nellschützer Silvesterlauf
description: The Nellschütz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional 10 km road race in Lützen, Saxony-Anhalt, held on the morning of December 31. Since 2000, it has been a regular fixture in the local running calendar and offers runners in the Burgenlandkreis a chance to end the year together. The race starts near the church in Nellschütz and is officially organized within the German athletics framework, including insurance and coordination of the event date. Its characteristic relaxed style means runners usually run and chat in small groups rather than aiming for a personal best. After the race, participants are traditionally treated to hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family.
course_highlights: 10 km road race through Lützen and the surrounding area
Dedicated aid station on the course
Finish area with hot food, tea, and mulled wine in the courtyard of the Kitze family
additional: Typical December weather: around 3 °C, a low of -2 °C, usually snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The race is designed as a communal year-end event, with runners taking part in small groups. The start is near the church in Nellschütz. The race starts in Nellschütz near the church, with a dedicated aid station on the course. The event is known as a year-end race with a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: OTB Silvesterlauf
description: The OTB New Year’s Eve Run in Osnabrück is a traditional year-end race that welcomes recreational runners, walkers and competitive athletes alike. On the last day of the year, participants can choose from several distances, including a 10 km main race, walking routes, a 5.6 km short race, an accessible fun run and a Bambini run. The event offers a lively atmosphere and modern timing with a disposable chip. The route passes through scenic areas such as Rubbenbruchsee and Natruper Holz, and the race has been a fixture on Osnabrück’s running calendar since 1980.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race goes to Rubbenbruchsee, through Natruper Holz and over Finkenhügel before returning to Illoshöhe
Walking route along Rubbenbruchsee (approx. 8 km), not timed
Accessible fun run on the Illoshöhe track, with up to 5 laps of 400 m each
additional: Timing uses a disposable chip attached to the race number (walking is not timed). From 2025, the Bambini route goes through the “big finish.” The accessible fun run is new from 2025. Start times vary by distance: walkers at 11:20, Bambini at 11:30, fun run at 11:50, 5.6 km short race at 12:10, and 10 km main race at 12:20. Spikes are not allowed on the 10 km and 5.6 km routes. Several race options are available, including an accessible run, a children’s race and walking; spikes are not allowed; online registration is available; field limited to 3,000 runners.

name: Ottenbacher Silvesterlauf
description: The Ottenbach New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional running event in Ottenbach, held annually at the end of the year. It gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to enjoy being active together and round off the year with a sporting highlight. The courses pass through the scenic surroundings of Ottenbach and offer varied running conditions. The event is organized by TSV Ottenbach and is a popular meeting point for the regional running community.
course_highlights: Running routes through the beautiful surroundings of Ottenbach
A range of distances for different age and ability groups
Traditional New Year’s Eve running atmosphere to round off the year
additional: The event is organized by TSV 1904 Ottenbach e.V. Information about travel and parking is available on the website. Registration is online via the official registration page. The event includes various age groups and race distances; details about the routes are available on the website. The race takes place on December 31, with online registration available. The course is approximately 10.4 km; details are available on the official website.

name: Pönitzer Silvesterlauf
description: The Pönitz New Year’s Eve Run is a traditional road race held in Pönitz, a district of Scharbeutz in Schleswig-Holstein. On December 31, 2026, runners set off at 9:00 a.m. to choose between 7.5 km and 15 km on a flat course that finishes at Lindenstraße 34. The event is organized by SVG Pönitz and features electronic timing. After the race, participants receive a hot drink, a Berliner doughnut and a commemorative medal, as well as a personalized certificate on request.
course_highlights: Flat course in Pönitz, finishing at Lindenstraße 34
Electronic timing
Traditional New Year’s Eve event with refreshments and a medal
additional: Registration is easy and available on race day. The event has a long tradition, with more than 40 editions, and attracts numerous runners and walkers even in adverse weather conditions. Typical December weather is around 3 °C, with occasional snowfall. A traditional New Year’s Eve run with a sense of community, electronic timing and small celebrations to round off the year.

name: Katerloop
description: The Katerloop is a traditional running race organized by the Limmer IJsclub during the Limmer Kermis. The race attracts both children and adults and offers various distances, including 5 and 10 kilometers. The course passes through, among other places, the garden of the Cornelius Church and is known for its friendly, sporting atmosphere. The race starts in the morning, with the youngest children setting off at 10:00 and adults at 10:30. The Katerloop is an annual event with a warm community and enthusiastic participants.
course_highlights: Course through the garden of the Cornelius Church
Distances of 5 and 10 kilometers
Starts during the Limmer Kermis in Limmen
additional: Registration is handled via email confirmation. After confirmation, the site administrator will get in touch. There are separate start times for children and adults. The organizer is the Limmer IJsclub, founded in 1895. The Katerloop in Limmen is held during the Limmer Kermis and is known for its small-scale, welcoming atmosphere. The edition in Numansdorp on January 1, 2027, offers participants a race bib including a commemorative cup, and registration is open until December 28.

name: Florijn Winterloop
location: Sportpark De Koekel, Woudenberg, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: The Florijn Winter Run is an annual running and walking event in Woudenberg that has marked the athletic start of the new year for more than 30 years. The routes pass through the beautiful Den Treek Estate and the Utrechtse Heuvelrug, combining paved and unpaved paths. The event is suitable for recreational runners and experienced athletes alike, with several distances, including 5 km and 10 km forest runs. The atmosphere is sporty and friendly, with a rich tradition and a true Florijn spirit.
course_highlights: Routes through Den Treek Estate and the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
A mix of paved and unpaved paths
The private ‘Ravensloot’ path is accessible exclusively during the event
additional: Chip timing by ChronoRace; results can be followed live on the website and social media; race bibs can be collected on the day before the start at De Grift Sports Park; same-day registration is not possible; course records and prize money are available; multiple start times by distance (5 km starts at 13:00, 10 km starts at 14:00). The event also includes a winter walk and features an extensive route at the sports park in Woudenberg.

description: The Nieuwjaarsloop De Wilp is a welcoming running event held annually in the picturesque village of De Wilp. With distances ranging from a youth run to a half marathon, it offers a suitable challenge for every level. The route passes through the beautiful Groningen-Frisian countryside, with wide-open views and a warm atmosphere at the start and finish. The event is known for its friendly, sporty character, bringing runners and spectators together to start the new year actively.
course_highlights: Route through the picturesque Groningen-Frisian countryside
Start and finish at the former church on Plantsoen
Aid stations along the route offering sports drink, tea, water and fruit
additional: Registration is open until 3 January at 23:59 via the website, or from 11:45 until half an hour before the start in the canteen of v.v. De Wilper Boys. Collect your race number no later than 15 minutes before the start. Parking is available in the v.v. De Wilper Boys car park near the canteen. First aid is available at the start/finish and from a mobile team along the route. Refreshments include sports drink, tea, water and fruit. Results and a finish video will be available. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; advance registration; winter conditions; youth and adults; parking near the sports club; first aid available; memento and refreshments included.

name: De Nieuwjaarsloop
location: Leiden Atletiek, Leiden, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Nieuwjaarsloop in Leiden is an accessible running race and a sporty way to start the new year. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with the start and finish on the athletics track. The race is organised by Leiden Atletiek in collaboration with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. It is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. The race focuses above all on the enjoyment of taking part, with prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the athletics track
Choose from 5, 10 or 15 kilometres
Part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit
additional: The Nieuwjaarsloop is organised by Leiden Atletiek together with Currimus and Loopgroep Oegstgeest. The race is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit, but taking part in the circuit is not mandatory. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners. You can register using the registration form on the race page. The race is traditionally held on 3 January, with registration available on the day. The event is part of the Zorg & Zekerheid Circuit and is supported by local sports clubs.

name: Douwe Kleefstra
description: The Douwe Kleefstraloop is a recreational running race starting at Lionitas athletics track in Leeuwarden. It offers several distances: a 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 English miles), with the routes measured exactly. The 10 km route passes through Goutum and Zuidlanden, while the 16 km route follows the same course with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel under the railway and part of the Elfstedentocht route. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. The Douwe Kleefstra and Sietske Rijpstra trophies are awarded to the fastest man and woman in the 10 English miles, respectively.
course_highlights: Starts at Lionitas athletics track
10 km route through Goutum and Zuidlanden
16.1 km route with an extra loop via Bredyk, a tunnel and part of the Elfstedentocht route
additional: Electronic chip timing using the chip in the race number. Participation is entirely at your own risk and responsibility. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. A discounted combined entry is available for the Douwe Kleefstraloop, Leeuwarden-Marsum-Leeuward and Rondje Goutum, including a special Gouden Leeuw race number and a prize draw. The distance selected when pre-registering for the Douwe Kleefstraloop determines the distance for the other races in the combination. Distances range from 1 km to 16.1 km; advance registration is required; special combination and youth prices; starts at Nijlân athletics track.

name: Oliebollen omloop
location: Sportpark Pelzer, Boxmeer, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Olympia's Oliebollen Omloop is an annual running event held on the first Sunday of the new year at Sportpark Pelzer in Boxmeer. The race is intended for members, interested participants, and entrants in the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. With several distances to choose from, it’s a great opportunity to end the Christmas holidays actively, start the new year in a sporty way, and enjoy team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. The route runs through the sports park and the adjacent Brestbos. There are prizes for the winners—and, of course, eternal glory.
course_highlights: Run through Sportpark Pelzer
Route through the adjacent Brestbos
Several distances available
additional: The run is part of the Run Competitie Land van Cuijk & Maasduinen. Prizes are awarded to the winners, and the event promotes team spirit and a friendly atmosphere. Running race over several distances, through the sports park and Brestbos, with prizes for the winners.

description: The Snertloop is a friendly running race organized by TAV80, held in 't Veld with the start and finish at JT Bloembollen on Koggeweg. The race takes place on public roads and offers several distances: 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus a 16 km walking route. After finishing, participants receive a bucket of snert, a traditional treat. Prizes are awarded to the top runners in each distance and age category, and race numbers also serve as raffle tickets. Registration is online only and closes a few days before the event.
course_highlights: Start and finish at JT Bloembollen on Koggeweg in ’t Veld
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km running, plus 16 km walking
Coffee stop for walkers at the Cultuurhuis in Lutjewinkel
additional: Race numbers also serve as raffle tickets. Race numbers can be collected on the Saturday evening before the race or on race day. Timing is recorded using a MyLaps chip in the race number; personal chips are not permitted. Volunteer traffic marshals accompany the race. Participation is at your own risk, and traffic rules must be followed. Walkers can stop for coffee at the Cultuurhuis in Lutjewinkel. Immediately after finishing, participants receive a bucket of snert. The race takes place on public roads near Sportcomplex de Kogge, with the course and registration online, and starts and finishes at JT Bloembollen.

description: The 64th Wallenloop, organised by AV'56 in Goes, is a traditional running race taking place on Saturday, 9 January 2027. The race attracts athletes from the region and offers a challenging course through the city of Goes. The organisers provide a sporting and friendly atmosphere, welcoming both recreational runners and competitive athletes. The Wallenloop is an important event on the Zeeland running calendar and is known for its good organisation and enthusiastic participants.
course_highlights: Course through the historic centre of Goes
Varied surfaces, including city roads
Atmospheric winter race in January
additional: The General Terms and Conditions for Running Events apply to AV'56 races. Shoe checks may be carried out in accordance with the competition rules in the case of outstanding performances. The organisers can be reached via the contact form on the website and by telephone during races at 0113-230788. Race categories range from 900 metres to 7,560 metres. Online registration is possible until a few days before the race; no on-site registration is mentioned.

name: Zandstuve Bosloop
description: The Zandstuve Forest Run is a challenging cross-country race that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition. The race takes place in the beautiful, wooded Zandstuve forest, managed by Overijssels Landschap, and is organised by Loopgroep de Zandstuve in collaboration with Sportlust Vroomshoop. The event offers different distances for children and adults, in a friendly and sporty atmosphere. The competition consists of five races in the region, with participants competing in various age categories for the overall win.
course_highlights: Run through the wooded Zandstuve forest, managed by Overijssels Landschap
Cross-country race that is part of the Prins Sport Vechtdal Cross Competition
Distances: 1,500 m for children, 5 km and 10 km for adults, with laps of 750 m and 5 km
additional: On-the-day registration for individual participation is available until half an hour before the start at the Sportlust Vroomshoop clubhouse. Children run 1,500 metres (2 laps of 750 m), 5 km participants run 1 lap, and 10 km participants run 2 laps of 5 km. Prizes are awarded in all categories for the 5 km and 10 km, children receive medals for the 1.5 km, and Canicross participants receive a commemorative gift. Individual entrants can make a contribution to Landschap Overijssel. Distances: 1,500 m (children), 5 km, 10 km; advance and on-site registration; option to donate to Landschap Overijssel; prizes in various categories.

name: StardGRL
description: The Stard Grote Rivieren Running Circuit (StardGRL) is a running competition in the Drechtsteden region, consisting of nine running events spread throughout the year. The races take place in a variety of typical Dutch landscapes and range in distance from 5 km to a half marathon. Participants compete in age categories, and standings are based on their best six performances from the nine races. The atmosphere is informal and sociable, with plenty of attention to personal goals and friendly rivalry.
course_highlights: Nine running events through typical Dutch landscapes
Distances range from 5 km to a half marathon
Standings based on the best six performances from nine races
additional: The competition consists of nine races, with standings based on the best six performances. Participants run in age categories and can register for the entire circuit. The races have an informal, sociable atmosphere, with an opportunity to chat and enjoy a drink afterwards. Information about the nine races, registration and standings is available; results are posted on uitslagen.nl

description: The JSC Crossloop Broekland is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit, a winter competition featuring ten unique cross-country races in different villages across Salland. The course in Broekland offers a challenging and atmospheric cross-country running experience in a natural setting. The races are suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. The competition encourages participation in multiple races, with points based on the best performances of the season.
course_highlights: Unique cross-country course in beautiful Salland
Varied terrain with rolling hills, forest trails, meadows and sandy stretches
Suitable for both competitive and recreational runners
additional: The JSC Crossloop Broekland is part of a competition with 10 cross-country races in Salland. The best 6 races count toward the standings (instead of 7). There is a 1 km kids’ run that does not count toward the standings. The organizers place great importance on safety and may decide to cancel a race in poor weather conditions, as happened recently because of slippery conditions and low feels-like temperatures. Race canceled due to bad weather and safety concerns.

name: WoolderEsloop
description: The Wooldereslopen is a running competition organized by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held throughout the first months of the year, with distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres. The course runs through the countryside around Hengelo, with the start and finish at the same location in Woolderes. The races are open to various categories and offer cash prizes and gift vouchers. The organizers provide electronic timing, and showers are available after the race.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Start and finish at the same location in Woolderes
Distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres
additional: Pre-registration closes on 3 January 2027; on-the-day registration is available from 9:00 a.m. until half an hour before the start at IKC De Wooldermarke. A race number with chip is issued once for all four races and can be collected on the Saturday beforehand or on race day. A running shirt and medal can be ordered as optional extras and collected. Showers are available at the Gymzaal Woolderesweg. Race numbers must be worn on the chest. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. Animals, strollers, etc. are not permitted. Start times: 11:00 a.m. for 10 and 15 km, 11:06 a.m. for 5.1 km, and 11:10 a.m. for 1.4 km. Registration on Sunday morning from 9:00 a.m.; start and finish in Woolderes. Weather conditions may affect the race. Prizes consist of cash and gift vouchers.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a regionally popular running event held annually at RCN Camping Zeewolde. The event offers several distances, including 1, 2, 5 and 10 kilometres, with the longer distances consisting of multiple laps. The run is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic routes. The Flevo Fun Run is part of TVZ Zeewolde’s activities and attracts runners from the region.
course_highlights: 1, 2, 5 and 10 km routes, with multiple laps for the longer distances
Start and finish at RCN Camping Zeewolde
Varied course suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The 2 km route consists of 2 laps. The 10 km route consists of 2 laps of 5 km. Photos and results from previous editions are available on the organiser’s Facebook page and photo page. Running event for all ages, registration via the website, seasonal events

name: Q-lite Enclavecross
distance_verbose: 10 km, 8 km, 7 km, 5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km
description: The Q-lite Enclavecross takes place in January in the forests of Baarle-Nassau and offers a varied cross-country running program with a maximum of 500 participants. The event is aimed at children, club runners, and adults, with 17 different distances ranging from short children’s races to 9 km. The route runs through the forests, and the event is organized by Gloria Atletiek, with local athletes competing for classification points. The program is tightly organized and runs on schedule even in winter conditions.
course_highlights: Run through the forests of Baarle-Nassau
17 different distances from 0.4 km to 9.5 km
Small fields with a maximum of 500 runners
additional: There is a special program for children and an adapted-sports race over 1.17 km. The event is local and aimed at club athletes. January weather is cold, around 1 °C, with a chance of precipitation, so warm clothing is recommended. Multiple distances, forest terrain, registration required, organized for children, young people, and adults

name: Busreis Egmond
location: Sportpark de Hondsheuvels, Eindhoven, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: On Sunday 10 January 2027, Eindhoven Atletiek is organising a sociable coach trip to the Egmond Quarter and Half Marathon. The coach trip is popular with runners from various athletics clubs and running groups. Participants will be provided with free food and drinks during the trip. The departure and return point is Sportpark de Hondsheuvels in Eindhoven. The coach leaves at 07:30 and returns at 16:30. To take part in the race itself, participants must register separately via the official Egmond Half Marathon website.
course_highlights: Egmond Quarter and Half Marathon
Departure and return at Sportpark de Hondsheuvels in Eindhoven
Coach trip with free food and drinks
additional: The coach has 76 seats, of which 12 are still available. It departs from Eindhoven at 07:30 and returns at 16:30. The coach trip includes free food and drinks. To take part in the quarter or half marathon, participants must register separately via the official race website. Transport to Egmond, race registration, departure at 07:30, return at 16:30, 12 seats still available

name: Winterlaufserie
description: Die Winterlaufserie Stadthagen ist eine entspannte Lauf- und Nordic-Walking-Veranstaltung, die aus 10 Einzelveranstaltungen besteht. Die Teilnehmer können zwischen vier ausgeschilderten Rundkursen mit unterschiedlichen Schwierigkeitsgraden in den landschaftlich reizvollen Bückebergen wählen. Es gibt keinen gemeinsamen Start und keine Zeitmessung, sodass der Lauf stressfrei zur eigenen Leistungsüberprüfung genutzt werden kann. Am Ziel erhalten alle Teilnehmer einen warmen Tee im Sporthaus.

name: Hulst by Lightrun
description: Hulst by Lightrun is a friendly running and walking event held in Hulst. It takes place on the third Friday evening of every month and offers a sociable atmosphere for participants of different levels. The route winds through Hulst’s charming streets, making it a unique experience for runners and walkers. It’s an accessible event that combines sport and conviviality.
course_highlights: Running and walking routes through Hulst’s charming streets
Friendly, relaxed atmosphere
Monthly event on the third Friday evening
additional: The event takes place on the third Friday evening of every month. It is an accessible running and walking event with a sociable atmosphere. A friendly running and walking event, held every third Friday evening.

name: 3 Meren Gieten Cross
description: The 3 Meren Gieten Cross is a cross-country race taking place on Saturday, 16 January 2027, in Gieten, near Eext. The race is part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos. The course follows unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos, with woodland trails, sandy paths and steep hills. Distances of 5 km and 9 km are available for different age categories, with timing provided without a chip. The race is limited to 300 participants, and no showers or changing rooms are available.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths past three forest lakes in the Gieterbos
Woodland trails, sandy paths and steep hills
Part of the UNESCO Geopark Hondsrug cross-country circuit
additional: Maximum 300 participants per race. Timing without a chip. No showers or changing rooms available. Juniors run approximately 5 km; seniors and masters run 9 km. Results and photos will be published after the race. Course on unpaved paths; no showers or changing rooms; maximum 300 participants.

description: The Stadtmüller-Udikloop is a forest race in Klijndijk, organised from the Udik village hall. The event offers two distances, 10 km and 4 English miles, and runs mostly along forest trails and quiet roads. The route passes several hunebeds, making for a unique and atmospheric running experience. A cash prize is offered for breaking the course record, providing an extra challenge for participants.
course_highlights: The course passes several hunebeds
Mostly along forest trails and quiet roads
A forest race in the Klijndijk area

Public transport is available via Belbus line 59 from Borger. The cross is part of the Hondsrug cross-country circuit and is the 5th race in the circuit. Course through a nature reserve, starts at 11:00 and 11:10, registration via inschrijven.nl, no changing or shower facilities.

name: Kruikenloop
description: The Kruikenloop in Tilburg is an energetic and convivial race that traditionally marks the start of carnival in Kruikenstad. The course runs partly through nearby Stadsbos 013 and offers distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres, with the 5-kilometre loop available to run multiple times. There is a special 1,111-metre race for children, with fun and sportsmanship at its heart. After the finish, a festive after-party takes place in the Sarto clubhouse, and prizes are awarded for the best carnival outfits.
course_highlights: The course runs partly through Stadsbos 013
A 5 km loop that can be run 1, 2 or 3 times (5, 10 or 15 km)
Children’s race of 1,111 metres
additional: Bib number changes are possible until 8 February at 18:00 via your personal dashboard. Bib transfers and resales are permitted via the official platform. After the finish, there is a convivial after-party in the Sarto clubhouse. Prizes are awarded to creatively dressed participants, and there is a costume prize for the children’s race. Timing is recorded via a chip in the bib, with results available online shortly afterwards. Registration is via the website; the course runs partly through Stadsbos 013; expect a festive atmosphere with music and costumes; organised during carnival in Tilburg.

description: Leeuwarden Marsum Leeuwarden is a classic running race starting on the Lionitas track in Leeuwarden. The 21.1 km half-marathon course runs through the cold fields northwest of the city, where the wind has free rein. Alongside the half marathon, there are also 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km distances, all measured exactly. After the race, all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate. Participation is at your own risk and responsibility.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course through cold fields northwest of Leeuwarden
Precisely measured distances of 1 km kids’ run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km
Start and finish on the Lionitas athletics track
additional: Start times by distance: 1 km kids’ run at 11:00, 21.1 km at 11:10, 10 km at 11:20, 5 km at 11:35, 2 km at 11:40. description: The Twentse Ven’n Loop is a small-scale running event held in Twente’s beautiful natural surroundings. It is known for its relaxed atmosphere and unique running experience. In 2027, the event will be held for the eleventh time, offering participants not only a sporting challenge but also the opportunity to support a good cause. The start and finish are at Camping de Meene in Buurse, and the event is known for Twentish hospitality.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful Twentse countryside
Start and finish at Camping de Meene in Buurse
Small-scale event with a maximum of 250 participants
additional: The maximum number of participants is 250. After costs are deducted, proceeds from entry fees go to a sponsored cause. Participants must follow the rules and the organizers’ instructions. Pets, strollers, and similar items are not allowed. The organizers reserve the right to change the route or cancel the event in extreme weather conditions. The Road Traffic Act remains in force during the run. Distances: 4.8 km, 10.3 km, 16.2 km; course through nature, wet terrain, facilities at the start/finish, charity initiative

name: AVT Valentijnscross
description: The AVT Valentine Cross in Wierden is a challenging cross-country race held at Het Lageveld. The course runs over a sandy beach, grass, hills and through the woods of Het Lageveld recreational park. The terrain is mostly unpaved and varied, making for a surprising and diverse running experience. The race is part of the MD Stoffering CrossCircuit van het Oosten and attracts both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Course over a sandy beach, grass, hills and through the woods
Mostly unpaved, varied terrain
Changing surfaces make for a challenging cross-country race
additional: Pre-registered participants can collect their race number with timing chip at the pickup desk. Circuit participants may keep their race number with timing chip for subsequent races. On-the-day registration is possible until half an hour before the start. Spikes are not permitted because of the timing mats. The race number must be worn visibly on the front. Dogs and unregistered companions may not take part. In extreme weather conditions, the organisers may decide to cancel the race without refunding the entry fee. Cross-country race held at Het Lageveld recreational park in Wierden, with distances of 10 km and youth distances of 1.5 km and 2.5 km, usually in February.

name: Krokusloop
description: The Duinloop Circuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, featuring varied courses that combine challenging dune trails with fast beach sections. The Krokusloop, part of this series, offers a great atmosphere for both dedicated runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. With distances for different ages and ability levels, the event is open to everyone who wants to enjoy running at its best.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune trails and beach sections
Unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all ages and ability levels
additional: Start times by distance: 500m Kids Run at 09:30, 1 km Kids Run at 09:35, 2 km Kids Run at 09:45, 5 km and 10 km at 10:00. Rankings are maintained for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men, based on the four best results in the circuit. Varied course with dune trails and beach sections, part of a series of running events along the coast.

name: Polderrun
description: The Polderrun is a sporting running event in the heart of Bleskensgraaf, bringing together participants from the region and beyond. The race offers several distances, including 3.5, 7, and 10 English miles, on a fast, fully paved course through the open polder. The Polderrun is known for its atmospheric start and finish in the middle of the village, and for the combination of nostalgia and renewal in the course. The event also supports a good cause, Stichting Moz Kids, making a meaningful contribution to vulnerable children in Mozambique.
course_highlights: Fast, fully paved course through the open polder
Long straight roads and sturdy drainage canal embankments
Start and finish in the middle of Bleskensgraaf
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 08:30 at the meeting area, De Spil. The meeting area also has a cloakroom, toilets, and limited shower facilities. Timing is provided by an Ipico chip in the race number, which measures net running time. There is a drink station at kilometer 8.1 of the 10 English Miles. Parking is available at three locations in Bleskensgraaf, with Melkwegplein and Weideweg preferred. Race-day registration is not possible. Registration for 2027 has not yet been announced, but the event is popular and sells out quickly. Facilities include parking, first aid, and Ipico timing. There is also an option to donate to a good cause.

name: Dinkelcross
price_range: Inschrijving via inschrijven.nl, geen expliciete prijs vermeld
description: The Dinkelcross is a beautiful cross-country race organized by Iphitos in the De Zandbergen woodland and nature area in Losser. The race is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie and offers challenging courses that are entirely off-road, with sandy stretches, tough short hills, and a route along a branch of the River Dinkel. There are several distances for both youth and adults, ranging from 1 km to 10 km. The Dinkelcross is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational participants and embraces the Olympic ideal that taking part is more important than winning. After the race, participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and homemade cake at the Zaandhoes, the start and finish location.
course_highlights: Entirely off-road course through the De Zandbergen woodland and nature area
Crossing a sandy stretch and tackling a few tough short hills
Running along a branch of the Dinkel River
additional: A maximum of 150 race-day entrants can take part; registration on the day is not possible. The start and finish are at the Zaandhoes, accessible from Grensweg. Changing rooms and showers are available. Start times for the various distances and age categories are scheduled between 10:30 and 12:45. The Dinkelcross is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie. Off-road course, various distances, start and finish at Zaandhoes, changing rooms and showers available, suitable for all levels.

description: The Noord-Aa Polder Run takes place on Sunday, 14 February 2027, at the Road Runners clubhouse in Zoetermeer. The course runs through the polder landscape around the Noord-Aa and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. There are several distances: a 1.5 km kids’ run and 5, 10 and 15 km races, so everyone can choose a suitable goal. Proceeds from the event go to IKC Het Zwanenbos to support the education and well-being of children in the region.
course_highlights: Course through the polder landscape around the Noord-Aa
Route past water, open polder landscape and paved paths
A range of distances from 1.5 km to 15 km
additional: Each distance starts at a different time to keep the course clear: 1.5 km at 12:30, 5 km at 13:00, 10 km at 13:10 and 15 km at 13:20. Registering in advance is recommended to guarantee a starting spot. The event is made possible in part by sponsors; prospective partners can get in touch via the email address provided. The course runs through the polder around Zoetermeerse Plas, not on an athletics track, and is suitable for different ability levels, with a focus on having fun and supporting good causes.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held annually at RCN camping Zeewolde. The event has grown in recent years and attracts runners from the region. It offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere for participants of different levels. Photos and results from previous editions are available via the official Facebook page and website.
course_highlights: Run in the area around RCN camping Zeewolde
Distances of 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
Start time of 11:00 for the 5 km and 10 km
additional: The 5 km and 10 km start at 11:00. Photos and results from previous editions are available on the Facebook page and photo page. In previous editions, the 5 km and 10 km filled up quickly, while registration for the 1 km and 2 km remained open until 12:00 on race day. Held on the second Sunday of each month in November, December, January and February at RCN camping Zeewolde. Four distances: 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km. Medals for kids and participants taking part in multiple races. Minimum ages vary by distance.

name: Danikerbosloop
description: The Danikerbosloop is an annual running race in Geleen, held for the 19th time in 2027. The race takes place in a wooded area around Daniken and offers distances of 5 km, 5 miles and 10 miles, suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners. There is also a kids’ run of approximately 1.2 km for children up to 13 years old. The start and finish are at Manege Ten Eysden, where refreshments are also available.
course_highlights: Wooded surroundings on the outskirts of Geleen
Course with a short approach loop followed by 1, 2 or 4 large laps
Start and finish at Manege Ten Eysden
additional: On-site registration is available from 09:00 at Manege Ten Eysden; cash payment only. When collecting their race bib, participants receive two vouchers: one for a drink and one for a piece of Limburg vlaai. Prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in all distances except the Kids’ Run, where every child receives a prize. Online pre-registration is available from 1 December until one week before the event; on-site payment is in cash. Participants receive a drink and Limburg vlaai when collecting their race bib. The Kids’ Run starts at 10:00.

name: De Knikker Zegerplasloop
location: Zegerplas, Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Knikker Zegerplasloop is a running series consisting of three races in November, January and February, held around the beautiful locations of Zegerplas in Alphen aan den Rijn. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, 15 and 20 km, with special youth distances of 400 and 1000 metres on the athletics track. The course is almost entirely traffic-free and runs through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas, making it suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. The start and finish are always on the AAV'36 athletics track, where changing rooms, showers and a cafeteria are also available. Official timing is provided by MyLaps. Refreshment stations are available on the longer distances, with water at the finish.
course_highlights: Almost entirely traffic-free course through the Zegersloot area and around Zegerplas
Start and finish on the AAV'36 athletics track, with changing rooms and showers
Official timing by MyLaps and refreshment stations on the longer distances
additional: There is a time limit of 2 hours for the 5 and 10 km walking distances. Walkers start at the same time as the 20 km running race. Youth runners have special distances of 400 m and 1000 m on the track, with a free commemorative item. A massage room offers free massages from Running & Walkingcenter Alphen aan den Rijn (bring your own towel). The cafeteria is open, and a limited number of lockers are available. Runners in the 15 and 20 km races pass a refreshment station on the track at the start of their second lap. On race day, registration is available in the cafeteria from 9:30 a.m. The races take place in winter conditions and offer options for walkers and young participants, with a maximum time limit of two hours for the walking distances.

description: The Wooldereslopen is a traditional running competition organised by MPM in Hengelo for more than 45 years. The competition consists of four races held during the first months of the year. Distances range from 1.4 to 15 kilometres, and the course runs through the countryside around Hengelo. The start and finish are at the same location in the Woolderes, creating a clear and friendly atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: Course through the countryside around Hengelo
Distances of 1.4, 5.1, 10 and 15 kilometres
Start and finish at the same location in the Woolderes
additional: Electronic timing. Race numbers can be collected from 9:00 a.m. on race day or on the preceding Saturday. T-shirts can be ordered as an optional extra. Shower facilities are available at Gymzaal Woolderesweg. Participation is at your own risk. Wearing earbuds/headphones is discouraged. The Wooldereslopen consists of four races held every three weeks during the first months of the year. Participants can enter the 1.4 km, 5.1 km, 10 km and 15 km distances. The organisers emphasise the friendly atmosphere and the course through the countryside around Hengelo.

Omloop van Noordwijkerhout

description: The HomeWizard Omloop van Noordwijkerhout is a welcoming running event held in the beautiful dune area and among the colourful bulb fields around Noordwijkerhout. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit and offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km, as well as a 1 km family run. The half marathon takes you through woodland and dunes and along paved roads, bringing nature and sport together. The venue is Sportpark De Boekhorst, which has facilities including changing rooms, showers and a bag drop. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes looking to enjoy a challenging and varied course.
course_highlights: Half marathon through dunes and flowering bulb fields
5 km and 10 km on fully paved roads alongside colourful bulb fields
Varied course through woodland, dunes and nature
additional: Start and finish at Sportpark De Boekhorst, Noordwijkerhout. Changing rooms, shower facilities and a bag drop are available. Parking is available at several nearby locations, but cycling is preferred. The race is part of the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit, with an attractive overall standings competition and prizes in every category. Course through dunes and bulb fields; registration via the website; start and finish at Sportpark De Boekhorst.

description: The Rondje Strand TIEN Cross is the final race of the AV Oss ’78 Cross Competition 2025-2026, held on Sunday, 28 February 2027. The race offers a challenging course, with a short cross of approximately 5 km, a long cross of approximately 10 km, and several youth cross distances. The venue is Strand TIEN at Gielekespad 10 in Oss, where runners can enjoy an off-road course. The short and long cross start at 10:00, and the youth cross starts at 11:10. The race is open to both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Off-road course at Strand TIEN in Oss
Short cross of approximately 5 km and long cross of approximately 10 km
Youth cross with several shorter distances
additional: Registration is open until 30 minutes before the race via the registration link. The youth cross starts at 11:10. The race is part of a cross-country competition featuring multiple races in Oss and the surrounding area. There is an overall ranking for participants who take part in at least four races. Venue: Gielekespad 10 in Oss; registration closes 30 minutes before the race; courses of approximately 5 km and 10 km.

name: Berden Voorjaarsloop
description: The Berden Voorjaarsloop in Venlo is a sporting event taking place on Sunday, 28 February 2027. The race offers a wide range of distances, from 500 metres for the youngest participants to 15 kilometres for experienced runners. A special feature is that participants in the 7.5 km and 15 km races run on Scopias’s professional 400-metre athletics track, adding a unique experience. The event is suitable for all ages and abilities and offers a fresh, energetic start to spring.
course_highlights: The 7.5 km and 15 km routes run on Scopias’s professional 400-metre athletics track
Safe and clearly laid-out courses past College Den Hulster and along Hagerhofweg
Routes through green surroundings, including the petting zoo and Vrijenbroek sports park
additional: Start times range from 10:40 to 14:05, depending on the distance. There is ample bicycle parking at College Den Hulster and parking at Fontys. Parents may run alongside the youngest participants. Refreshment stations are available, and all finishers receive a medal. Distances range from 500 metres to 15 km, including youth races and a race on a professional athletics track; registration via inschrijven.nl; event in Venlo.

name: Eifelsteig Cross / Lauf 2 der Crosslaufserie Vulkaneifel 2027 / Sparkassen-Cup
3bergenLOOP
description: The 3bergenLOOP is an atmospheric running race in Driebergen, with three challenging courses: 6 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The routes follow unpaved forest trails, cycle paths and bridleways through the beautiful Bornia, Heidestein and Hoog Moersbergen estates. The race is known for its scenic, demanding courses and its focus on sustainability, with participants encouraged to bring their own reusable cups. The start and finish are at RCN Het Grote Bos, with refreshments available along the way and at the finish. The organizers provide a well-run event with chip timing and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes along unpaved forest trails, cycle paths and bridleways
Half marathon through the Bornia, Heidestein and Hoog Moersbergen estates
Refreshment stations with water and sports drink along the route and at the finish
additional: Race numbers are sent to the home address provided. Start and finish at RCN Het Grote Bos. Refreshments at 9 km, 15 km and after the finish for the half marathon; at 4 km and after the finish for the 10 km; and after the finish for the 6 km. No medals are awarded. Racetimer chip timing is included. Race numbers can be transferred via the registration website. Participants are encouraged to use their own reusable cups to support sustainability. Routes have been adjusted due to area restrictions; registration opens in early December 2026; options are available to transfer race numbers and volunteer; the event takes an environmentally friendly approach with reusable cups and no medals; chip timing is included.

name: ACO van Elderen Crossloop
description: The ACO Van Elderen Crossloop is a challenging cross-country race organised by athletics club ACO Van Elderen in Ommen. The race is part of the Prins Sport-Vechtdalcrosscompetitie and takes place in the nature area around Ommen. The race starts on the athletics track, after which the course runs mostly off-road through the forest. There are three distances: 1.75 km, 5 km and 10 km, with participants running one or more laps through the forest. The cross-country race is known for its natural surroundings and varied course.
course_highlights: Start on the athletics track
Course runs mostly off-road through the forest
Three distances with different laps (blue and red)
additional: Registration is online only and open until 4 March 2027; no on-the-day registration is available. A lead cyclist will ride ahead of the runners during the race. For the 5 km and 10 km, day prizes are awarded to the first three women and men, provided by sponsors. For the youth distance (1.75 km), prizes are awarded to the first three in each category. Forest course, off-road terrain, online registration until 04-03-2027, prizes for the top three and course record

name: Halve Marathon van Haren
description: The RunX Haren Half Marathon is a spring classic, taking place for the 42nd time on Saturday, March 6, 2027, in Haren, Groningen. The event offers a sporty and enjoyable day, with distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km recreational runs. The half marathon starts at 11:00 a.m. and the recreational runs at 11:20 a.m. By taking part, you support Jeugdfonds Sport & Cultuur Groningen, which helps children from families with limited means join sports or cultural clubs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sporthal Scharlakenhof in Haren
Route through the Felland Zuid industrial estate, 1,000 meters from the finish
Strict time limit of 2.5 hours for the half marathon
additional: Race numbers will be sent by post at the end of February 2026. Changes to distance or participant can be submitted online until March 6, 2026, at 10:00 p.m., for a fee of €2.50. Medals are optional and cost an additional €2.50. The half marathon has a time limit of 150 minutes. The Road Traffic Act applies on the course. Registration opens on October 24, 2026; various routes are available for different levels; the event supports Jeugdfonds Sport & Cultuur Groningen.

name: Rondje Zwolle Marathon
description: Rondje Zwolle 2027 is the second edition of a small-scale marathon around the beautiful city of Zwolle, organised by Zwolselopers. The marathon is all about camaraderie, running together and enjoying the experience, without an emphasis on fast times or personal records. Participants can run the full marathon or sign up together and split the distance. Weekend long runs are organised to help participants train together. Fysiotherapie De Dobbe supports participants in getting fit for the start.
course_highlights: Marathon around the city of Zwolle
Small-scale event with a friendly atmosphere
Option to split the distance and take turns running together
additional: The marathon is intentionally small-scale, with a limited number of race entries. Friendly weekend long runs are organised in preparation. Fysiotherapie De Dobbe is a sponsor and provides support with injuries. The start is at Wijthmenerplas. The marathon is characterised by an informal atmosphere and training and running together with other participants.

name: 65 van Walcheren
description: The 65 van Walcheren is a challenging 65-kilometre ultrarun held in Westkapelle. Made possible in part by De Zeeuwse Verzekeringen, it is known as the most beautiful and toughest ultrarun in the region. The route takes participants past some of Walcheren’s most beautiful places and is open to both runners and walkers. The event is organised by dedicated volunteers and supports Stichting Roparun, which supports projects for people with cancer.
course_highlights: A 65-kilometre ultrarun through the best of Walcheren
Open to both runners and walkers
Organised with care for the region and participants
additional: The event is organised in support of the charity Stichting Roparun. De Zeeuwse Verzekeringen is the title sponsor. Registration is linked to a crowdfunding platform where participants can raise money. There is a special shirt design for 2027. The event is open to both runners and walkers. It takes place on 7 March 2027 and attracts participants from the region and beyond. Results from previous years are also available on the website.

description: The Fysio 0512 Run Drachten is a running event held in Drachten, starting and finishing on the athletics track at AV Impala. The 10 km race is the official Open Frisian Championship and takes place on a unique, certified course through the beautiful countryside around Drachten. There are also 5 km and 1.5 km kids’ run distances, making the event suitable for runners of all levels and ages. The race combines a sporting challenge with a friendly atmosphere and offers prizes for the top runners and club champions.
course_highlights: The 10 km is the official Open Frisian Championship
Certified, fast course through the countryside around Drachten
Start and finish on the athletics track at AV Impala
additional: Collect race bibs on 8 March from 9:30 at the AV Impala clubhouse. No on-the-day registration is possible; online registration is open until 1 hour before the start. Limited changing and shower facilities are available. Free parking in the immediate vicinity of Sportlaan. Prizes for the top men and women in the Open Frisian Championship 10 km and for club champions in the 10 km and 5 km (with an Impala race shirt). All participants in the 1.5 km kids’ run receive a reward. A running clinic for 5 km and 10 km runners takes place before the event, with five training sessions led by coaches. Certified course, open to recreational and competitive runners, advance registration required, no on-the-day registration.

name: Halve van Oostvoorne
location: Oostvoorne, Voorne aan Zee, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Halve van Oostvoorne is a welcoming running event taking place on Sunday, 7 March 2027, in the lively village centre and the scenic dunes of Oostvoorne. Participants can choose from a half marathon of 21.1 km, a fast 8 km, or youth races of 1 and 2 km. The paved course offers a lovely mix of nature and village scenery, with excellent facilities such as changing rooms, showers and parking close to the start. Organised by football club OVV and Voorne Atletiek, the event promises a safe, well-run day full of sporting fun.
course_highlights: Paved course through the scenic dunes and village centre
Music and activities for spectators create a festive atmosphere
Excellent facilities, including changing rooms, showers and parking close to the start
additional: The 1 km youth race starts at 11:00 (up to age 11); the 2 km race starts at 11:15 (up to age 14). The 8 km and half marathon start at 12:00. All participants receive a medal. Minimum age: 14 for the 8 km and 16 for the half marathon. Facilities: unguarded changing rooms and showers, parking, and a canteen serving drinks, sandwiches and snacks. Half-marathon course records: men 01:06.36; women 01:17.41. Parking is available close to the start, with several other parking options within walking distance. Paved course; facilities include changing rooms, showers and parking; registration is open.

name: Loopfestein Stein
description: Loopfestein Stein is an annual running race held in Stein, the Netherlands. On Sunday, March 7, 2027, the 32nd edition will take place, featuring various distances, including 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a youth run. The race is supported by local sponsors and offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere for runners of all ages. The routes pass through beautiful Stein and are suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Routes through the town of Stein with varied terrain
Youth runs with different distances and start times
Woodhenge Night Run with atmospheric lighting (separate event)
additional: The youth run starts at 10:00, with distances varying by year of birth. The Woodhenge Night Run is a separate event held in June. The event is supported by various local sponsors. The Mijnverleden monument in Stein receives attention during the event. Registration for the 32nd edition is open; the venue and exact registration information are not specifically stated.

The distances are measured exactly, and all participants receive a cup of hot chocolate afterwards. The start and finish are at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, where participants in every distance run one more lap of the track on their return.
course_highlights: Exactly measured distances from 1 km to 30 km
Start and finish at Atletiekbaan Nijlân, with a lap of the track
Aid stations and first aid available, including on the 10 km route

description: The Duinloopcircuit in Katwijk is a unique running series along the Dutch coast, featuring varied courses that combine challenging dune trails with fast beach sections. The races offer a great atmosphere for both dedicated runners and recreational runners who enjoy running outdoors. The Noordduinloop, part of this series, takes place on 13 March 2027 and is one of a series of events held throughout the year.
course_highlights: Varied courses with dune trails and beach sections
A unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all levels and ages
additional: Rankings are kept for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men. The rankings are based on the four best results in the series. Distances range from 500m to 10 km, including kids' runs, with rankings based on the four best results.
