description: The Luilakpolderloop is a friendly running race held annually in the beautiful polder landscape of the Wormer and Jisperveld. With distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 English miles), it offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. Children can take part in a special free 1.1 km youth race. The start and finish are at VV Jisp football club, with a welcoming atmosphere, medals for children, trophies for the winners and a raffle after the race.
course_highlights: Beautiful course through the Wormer and Jisperveld
Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 16.1 km (10 miles)
Free 1.1 km youth race for children
additional: Youth race bibs can be collected on 13 May 2027 from 14:00 to 14:30 at OBS De Harpoen, or on 14 May 2027 at 18:00 at Restaurant De Lepelaar. The youth race starts at 18:30 at Restaurant De Lepelaar and finishes at VV Jisp. Adult race bibs are available from 18:30 at VV Jisp; the adult fun runs start at 19:30. VV Jisp has 4 changing rooms with showers. Bag storage is at your own risk. Parking is limited, and a traffic marshal will be present. Live results are available during the race. The raffle and prize presentation take place after the race, at around 21:15. Registration for 2027 opens in early March, with 350 race bibs available. The event supports charities and offers digital timing with live results. Medals and trophies are available for participants, and registration is mandatory. No refunds are available in the event of cancellation.

description: The ZLM-Don Stadsloop is a friendly running race through Middelburg city centre, starting and finishing at the Markt. The race consists of 3 laps of 2.5 km, for a total of 7.5 km, and features both an individual ranking and a team ranking for teams of 4. There are separate age categories and prizes for the top runners. Before the race, children can take part in the Qui-Vive Spektakelrun, a fun participation run of approximately 2 km with obstacles. The organisers provide a lively, sporting evening with refreshments, first aid and a raffle afterwards.
course_highlights: Middelburg city centre, starting and finishing at the Markt
3 laps of 2.5 km, for a total of 7.5 km
Qui-Vive Spektakelrun for children, featuring 5 inflatable obstacle courses
additional: Race numbers can be collected on 19, 20 and 21 May at Koole Sport, and on race day, 22 May, between 18:30 and 19:30 at the stall on the Markt. Late registration is available only for the individual race, digitally from 18 May and on race day. Race numbers are entered into a raffle with prizes and a grand prize. After finishing, participants receive a bottle of water and a memento. First-aid staff are present, including on bicycles. Teams consist of 4 people; mixed teams are included in the men's team ranking. A €100 course-record bonus is awarded for setting a new record. Prizes for the top 3 and participants, a raffle using race numbers, first aid on site, and changing rooms in the Molenwater gymnasium.

name: Rundje um ut Hundje
description: Rundje um ut Hundje is an annual running event in Horst aan de Maas, celebrating its 11th edition in 2027. The event offers a wide range of distances for all ages, from the Parent/Child Run to the 10 km race. The routes pass through the centre of Horst, creating a sporty and sociable atmosphere, made possible in part by the local community and sponsors. The organisers aim to provide a well-organised and accessible event for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes ranging from 350 metres to 10 kilometres through the centre of Horst
Start and finish at Lambertusplein, near the statue of ’t Hundje van Hôrs
Various youth and adult races with age-specific distances
additional: Free parking around Lambertusplein. Public transport: the 'Horst Centrum' bus stop is a 2-minute walk away. Prize ceremonies take place at Wilhelminaplein after the youth and adult races. Shirts can be ordered optionally for an additional fee. Multiple race categories, including kids, urban, 5 km and 10 km; location at Lambertusplein; anniversary year with special festivities

name: Nobel Run
description: The Nobel Run is a friendly, accessible running event held in the beautiful Almere Hout. The various routes pass through the area’s green, sustainable natural surroundings, giving the event a unique feel. The event aims to make a sustainable and sporting contribution to Almere Hout and is intended as a festive occasion for participants, spectators, and residents of Nobelhorst. The Nobel Run promotes social cohesion and gives the city of Almere a sporting boost.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful natural surroundings of Almere Hout
The course has a green and sustainable character
Distances range from a Kids Run to a 15 km run
additional: Race number with a built-in MyLaps timing chip. First name printed on the race number for registrations made before 1 May 2027. Race numbers and shirts can be collected on Saturday 15 May 2027 between 10:00 and 14:00 at the Nobelhorst community hall. Participants may hand in one bag with a numbered label. Entertainment, post-run massage, refreshment stations along the route and at the finish, official results, and personal photos are included. The official Nobel Run shirt, limited-edition socks, and BibBits magnets can be ordered optionally during registration. The event offers merchandise and registration options and emphasizes an environmentally conscious, community-focused approach.

name: Lelieloop
location: Het Turfschip, Etten-Leur, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Lelieloop is organised annually by Road Runners Etten-Leur on Whit Monday as part of De Leurse Havenfeesten. The fast course runs through the streets of Etten-Leur Noord and passes through the ‘De Lelie’ windmill, among other places. There are several distances for different age groups, including a children’s run, a junior run, a 5 km and a 10 km. The start and finish are at Het Turfschip, which also has shower and changing facilities. The Lelieloop is an accessible event for all ages, with a friendly atmosphere and a scenic route through the neighbourhood and past local landmarks.
course_highlights: The course goes through the ‘De Lelie’ windmill
Routes run through the Schoenmakershoek neighbourhood and along the Leurse Dijk
The 10 km and 5 km courses are accurately measured and include a mix of paved and unpaved sections
additional: The start and finish are at Het Turfschip, with changing and shower facilities. Kangoo jumpers and race runners are welcome, but the course is not suitable for wheelchair racers. If temperatures exceed 30 degrees, the Lelieloop is cancelled in accordance with Atletiekunie rules. Every child receives a pancake from the De Lelie windmill after the children’s run. The course is not officially measured and may vary; advance registration is recommended; the run is cancelled if temperatures exceed 30°C.

name: Gerstewitzer Mühlentaglauf
description: Der Gerstewitzer Mühlentag-Lauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die verschiedene Streckenlängen von 400 m für Kinder bis zu 10 km für Erwachsene anbietet. Nach einer Corona-bedingten Pause erfreut sich der Lauf großer Beliebtheit und verbindet sportliche Ambitionen mit regionalen Pfingsttraditionen. Die Veranstaltung wird vom SFG Nellschütz e.V. organisiert und bietet Läufern aller Altersklassen eine attraktive Wettkampfmöglichkeit in der Region Lützen.

name: Dortmunder Friedenslauf
description: Der Dortmunder Friedenslauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf, der am Pfingstmontag, dem 25. Mai 2026, in Dortmund-Kirchlinde stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Laufdistanzen durch den malerischen Rahmer Wald und zeichnet sich durch eine familiäre und sportliche Atmosphäre aus. Begleitet wird das Event von musikalischer Unterhaltung und motivierenden Trommlern entlang der Strecke. Der Friedenslauf ist Teil einer Laufserie der Arbeitsgemeinschaft Straßenlauf und zieht Läufer aller Altersklassen an.

name: Pfingstkronenlauf
description: Der Pfingstkronenlauf in Kleinich ist ein traditioneller Laufwettbewerb, der im Rahmen des Pfingstsportfests des TuS Kleinich am Pfingstwochenende stattfindet. Angeboten werden Strecken über 5 km und 10 km sowie ein Bambinilauf von ca. 250 m für die jüngsten Teilnehmer ab Jahrgang 2020. Die Veranstaltung findet am Festzelt an der Hirtenfeldhalle statt und bietet neben dem sportlichen Erlebnis auch kulinarische Genüsse wie Backeshähnchen und Weizenbier vom Fass. Die Startzeit ist um 10:00 Uhr, und es gibt eine herzliche Atmosphäre für Läufer aller Altersklassen.

name: Potmarge Run
description: The Potmarge Run is an evening race over 5 and 10 kilometres that has been part of the series of runs organised by Lionitas in Leeuwarden since 2012. The routes are measured precisely and offer a unique running experience along the Van Harinxmakanaal and the River Potmarge, where you can enjoy nature in the city. The start is at the MICA/Mediahuis building at Sixmastraat 15. Participation is at your own risk and responsibility, and you can optionally order a medal.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the Van Harinxmakanaal
Run along the River Potmarge
Precisely measured 5 and 10 km routes
additional: Online registration is available until shortly before the start; no on-the-day registration. A medal can be ordered optionally for € 3,50. The start location is MICA/Mediahuis (Leeuwarder Courant building), Sixmastraat 15, Leeuwarden. Routes measured; online registration until shortly before the start; no on-the-day registration; free parking after 18:00.

name: Verkerkloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De inschrijving is geopend vanaf 1 februari 2027 tot en met 13 mei 2027. Restitutie is niet mogelijk.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname kost € 225,- per team van 4 personen inclusief de 5de loper. Bij meer dan twee teams korting mogelijk.

description: The Verkerkloop is an annual race through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet. The event includes a fast street course with 5 km and 10 km distances for individual runners, a school race for children in various age categories, and a business race for teams. The route passes through the Molenvliet industrial estate and surrounding streets, with a turnaround point halfway through. The Verkerkloop is a sporting event that contributes to a healthy, close-knit community and attracts thousands of participants each year.
course_highlights: Fast street course through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet
The 5 km distance consists of one lap; the 10 km distance consists of two laps
The route passes, among other places, along Molenvliet, Munnikensteeg, Klarinetsingel, Beethovenlaan and Develsingel
additional: Start and finish at Verkerk, Molenvliet 1, in the Molenvliet industrial estate in Zwijndrecht. The school race is for children aged 6 and up, with distances from 600 to 1,200 metres. Business race teams consist of 4 or 5 runners; the finish times of the first 4 runners are added together. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. Race numbers can be transferred through a resale platform. A maximum of 3,500 participants are allowed. Registration opens on 1 February 2027. The event is held at Verkerk on Molenvliet and also includes youth and business activities.

name: Liberation Trail

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De deelnamekosten zijn voor iedereen gelijk, ongeacht volledige of halve etappes

description: The Liberation Trail is a three-day trail-running adventure along Normandy’s historic D-Day beaches. This unique experience combines an athletic challenge with a tribute to freedom and history. Participants cover a total of 113 kilometres across key liberation sites, including Utah Beach, Omaha Beach and other landing sites. The event focuses on perseverance and respect, with an emphasis on the significance of the route rather than competition.
course_highlights: Route along the iconic D-Day beaches and historic monuments
Night-time sections by the cliffs of Pointe du Hoc
Start in Sainte-Mère-Église, known for the famous paratrooper John Steele
additional: The trail is flexible: participants can choose the full 115 km route or a selection of half stages totalling 70 km. Base camp is Camping Ferme Hay Day, where participants can relax and share experiences. There is no time pressure; the focus is on personal challenge and respect for history. The event includes several days of trail running, with options for full or half routes, historical tours and camping facilities. Bus transfers from the Netherlands and Belgium are also available. The race takes place from 21 to 23 May 2027.

name: Michelstädter Stadtlauf
description: The Michelstadt City Run, organized by TSV Weiten-Gesäß, will take place for the 41st time on May 29, 2026. In addition to the traditional individual 5 km and 10 km races, the event offers a new team race in which four team members each run a relaxed 2.5 km lap. The city run is open to all age groups, including school and youth races, and promotes community spirit and the visibility of local businesses. The event is ideal for companies as a group activity and for runners seeking personal bests or athletic challenges.
course_highlights: New team race with 4 × 2.5 km laps
Traditional individual races over 5 km and 10 km
School and youth races for families
additional: The new team race is a special highlight and is suitable for all fitness levels. The team members’ times are added together to calculate the overall time. The event promotes team spirit and offers a healthy change from the working day. Runners can choose from 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and team races; online registration is available. The race is approved by the DLV and is part of the Michelstadt Bee Market.

name: VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf
description: The VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf takes place on May 29, 2026, and offers runners a well-reviewed and attractive route through the town of Ahaus. The race is organized by VfL Ahaus 1892 e.V., one of the leading recreational sports clubs in the Münsterland region. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a friendly atmosphere with a focus on health and community. The route has been carefully explored and approved by the VfL Ahaus running group, so participants can look forward to a great running experience.
course_highlights: Route reviewed and approved by the VfL Ahaus running group
Attractive town route in Ahaus
Event focused on health and community
additional: Registration opens on March 15, 2026. Places are still available. The race takes place as part of the town festival. In cooperation with AOK, VfL Ahaus also offers functional training classes. The routes are not officially measured; registration opens on March 15, 2026; places are still available; the event is part of the town festival, which features a varied accompanying program.

description: The Volksbank Run “Around Offlumer Lake” is a long-standing running event in Neuenkirchen, Lower Saxony, taking place on May 29, 2026. The course runs around Offlumer Lake, with the start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg. A range of races is offered for all age groups, from the Bambini run and student races to the 10 km main race. The event is organized by the SuS 09 Neuenkirchen running group and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-the-day registration available.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg
Course around Offlumer Lake, measured by the DLV for the 10 km main race
Distances range from a 300 m Bambini run to a 10 km main race
additional: On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before each start. Race bibs can be picked up from 3:00 p.m. at the registration tent. Timing is provided by Teamsoft-Sportzeit. Races start at staggered times, from 4:00 p.m. (Bambini run) to 7:00 p.m. (main race). Course: around Offlumer Lake. On-the-day registration available. Parking at the outdoor swimming pool and Offlumer Lake.

name: Gerard Tebroke Memorialloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijven voor de GUV Businessrun : €125 per deelnemend team.

description: The Gerard Tebroke Memorial Run is an annual running event in Aalten offering various distances and categories, including kids’ runs, schoolchildren’s runs, business runs, and 5- and 10-kilometer races. The event takes place on Saturday, May 22, 2027, and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. Start times are spread throughout the afternoon and evening, allowing participants and spectators to enjoy a varied program.
course_highlights: Multiple race categories for all ages and ability levels
Location in the center of Aalten
Memorial run in honor of Gerard Tebroke
additional: Late registration for the 5- and 10-kilometer races is available at the registration desk at Markt 7, Aalten. Start times: 16:30 Het Noorden Kids’ Runs, 17:00 GUV Schoolchildren’s Run, 18:00 Sorba 5-Kilometer Run and GUV Business Run 5KM, 18:45 Ducona 10-Kilometer Run. The event is held every two years and has strong local and sporting significance.

name: Greifenstein Berglauf
organizer: Fussfit Petry GmbH, webconcept GbR, weitere lokale Sponsoren
description: The Greifenstein Mountain Run is a challenging 5.3 km road race from Ehringshausen-Katzenfurt to Greifenstein Castle, taking place for the 27th time on 30 May 2026. The route follows country roads and farm tracks, climbing a total of 260 metres to the finish at the castle, which offers a wonderful view of the region. The race is open to youth, men, women and seniors, with a combined ranking across all categories. Nordic walking is offered without age-category rankings, and a free children’s race for the youngest participants takes place separately in the afternoon. The event concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle.
course_highlights: 5.3 km road race with 260 metres of elevation gain
Start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle with panoramic views
Challenging section of the course above Edingen
additional: The entry fee includes a bus transfer to the start, transport of clothing to the finish, and drinks at the start and finish. Race numbers and finisher shirts will be distributed in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle from 14:00 on event day. Late registration is possible on event day until 30 minutes before the start. Parking is available at the outskirts of Greifenstein in the direction of Beilstein. A free children’s race will be held at around 16:50, accompanied by members of LG Dill. The awards ceremony and refreshments—including coffee, cake, cold drinks and bratwurst—will take place in the castle courtyard. In clear weather, the courtyard offers impressive views across the Dill Valley as far as the Feldberg in the Taunus. Register online by 28.05.2026; start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle; no relay or walking event; results available since 2008.

name: Internationaler Biesfelder Dorflauf
location: Kürten, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

description: The International Biesfeld Village Run is a long-standing running event in the municipality of Kürten, taking place on 30 May 2026. The race is known for its hilly course, which challenges runners and carries the slogan “Flat is somewhere else.” Various distances, including races for toddlers and schoolchildren, offer suitable competitions for all age groups. The event is organized by Biesfeld Triathlon e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the Biesfeld Community Primary School.
course_highlights: Hilly race in the municipality of Kürten, with challenging climbs
Distances from 0.6 km (toddler race) to 9.2 km (main race)
Start and finish in the schoolyard of Biesfeld Community Primary School
additional: Race packs will be handed out on race day in the schoolyard of Biesfeld Community Primary School. No separate timing chip is required, as the chip is integrated into the race bib (RaceResult). A late registration fee of €3.00 applies from 23.05.2026; late registrations are possible on site on race day. Distances: 0.6 km, 2.1 km, 9.2 km; online registration until 28.05.2026; race bib with chip; event in Kürten-Biesfeld

name: Wälster Lauf
description: The Wälster Lauf is a traditional fun run and road race in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde, organised annually by Fortuna Walstedde. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and offers runners and walkers of all ages an appealing opportunity to get active. The event traditionally opens the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract growing numbers of participants. Alongside competition, the focus is also on the enjoyment of exercise and community.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde
Fun run and road race with various distances
Traditional opening event of the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde
additional: The Wälster Lauf offers running and walking on a DLV-measured course. The event includes various age groups and distances, including a Bambini run, children’s races, a fun run, 5 km and 10 km road races, and walking. Start times are staggered from 15:30 to 17:15. The event opens the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract growing numbers of participants. It is a well-established regional running tradition, with courses known for their accuracy and fairness. It is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.

name: Enzenbüschlauf Neroth – Der Naturlauf am Eifelsteig
Freedom Run Wageningen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld bedraagt € 15 en is hetzelfde voor alle afstanden.

description: The Freedom Run Wageningen is a running event that celebrates freedom and connection in the city of liberation. Organised by Lions Club Wageningen, participants run in support of Stichting Kind en Kans, which supports children from families with limited means. The run offers four distances and takes participants through beautiful natural areas and the city, mainly along paved cycle paths. Everyone is welcome to take part and contribute to a future in which no child is left on the sidelines.
course_highlights: Routes start at Visum Mundi in the Vrijheidskwartier
The 15 km and half marathon routes pass through natural areas and include approximately 90 metres of elevation gain
Finish with a scenic descent towards the finish at Visum Mundi
additional: Timing with a Race Result bib tag at the start/finish; an additional live intermediate timing point at 6 km for the 15k and 21k. A medal is available for €5. T-shirts can be ordered when registering. The organisers encourage sustainable transport and use sustainable materials, such as medals made from potato starch or waste wood and rPET cups at drink stations. Setting: city run; timing via bib tag; start/finish at Visum Mundi; parking near the start/finish; registration by advance entry only.

name: Liemerse Landloop

description: The Liemerse Landloop is an annual running event held on the fourth Sunday in May in Oud-Zevenaar and Ooy. The course passes through picturesque villages and along the Liemerse dikes, with official certification for the 5 km and 10 km distances. Distances include 3 km, 5 km and 10 km, plus a free Kids’ Run for children up to 12 years old. The atmosphere is warm and festive, with strong volunteer involvement and a lovely keepsake for every participant.
course_highlights: Officially measured and certified 5 km and 10 km courses
Route through the countryside around Oud-Zevenaar and Ooy, along the Liemerse dikes
Start and finish at Koffiehuis Uniek, Kerkweg 10 in Oud-Zevenaar
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Saturday 30 May from 15:00 to 16:30 and on race day from 08:45 at Koffiehuis Uniek. Parking is available at Dijkweg and at the station, with shuttle buses running from 10:00. Prize-giving ceremonies take place after each distance on the terrace at the start/finish location. The Kids’ Run is divided into age groups, with distances of 500 and 1,000 metres. Teams of 3 to 5 people can take part in the 5 km. Registration is available online and on site; the event is run with the help of volunteers and offers various running categories.

name: Maastricht Marathon
description: The dsm-firmenich Maastricht Marathon is a unique running event that is part of the dsm-firmenich Long Course Weekend Netherlands. The race offers a flat, picturesque course through the historic and scenic landscape of Maastricht and the surrounding area. With distances of 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon and a full marathon, there is a suitable challenge for every runner, from recreational runners to serious athletes. Crossing the finish line over the red carpet makes for a festive and unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Flat, picturesque course through historic Maastricht
Start and finish in the bustling heart of the city, with cheering crowds
Past iconic landmarks and local street parties
additional: Pacers are available for the marathon and half marathon, with several target times from 1:30 to 5:00 hours. The pacers are identifiable by their T-shirts and flags and help runners achieve their desired finish time. The event is part of a three-day multisport festival featuring swimming, cycling and running. Part of a three-day multisport event including swimming and cycling; suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Brunnenfestlauf 2026
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinde 1861 e. V. Oberursel (TSGO)
description: The Brunnenfestlauf Oberursel is a long-standing race that starts and finishes at the historic market square in the heart of Oberursel. The course runs through pleasant residential areas, woodland and meadows, offering runners of all ages a varied running experience. In addition to the main races over 10 km, the half marathon and 5 km, there is also a 3 km schoolchildren’s and Sports Badge race, as well as a Bambini run for the youngest participants. The event is part of the Brunnenfest and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with categories for different age groups and youth divisions.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Oberursel’s historic market square
Course through residential areas, woodland and meadows
Varied race distances from 0.8 km to the half marathon
additional: Late entries are possible on race day until 09:30. The races start in staggered order: 10:00 — 10 km & half marathon; 10:10 — 5 km; 12:35 — 3 km schoolchildren’s and Sports Badge race; 13:05 — Bambini run. There is a €5 late-entry fee for all races except the 3 km race. The event supports the German Sports Badge and offers a 3 km Sports Badge race. Supported by local sports clubs, with a focus on youth races and the Sports Badge, at historic venues.

name: Freigerichter Benzinglauf
description: The Freigerichter Benzinglauf is a scenic fun run that follows varied trails over the first hills of the Spessart. The start and finish for all routes are at the DJK clubhouse in Freigericht-Neuses. The three different routes mainly follow woodland, forest and gravel paths, with a small proportion on asphalt. Plenty of refreshments are available along the course and at the finish. The event offers various distances for runners, walkers and children, with suitable options for all age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: 90% woodland, forest and gravel paths; 10% asphalt
Routes climb the first hills of the Spessart
Start and finish at the DJK clubhouse in Freigericht-Neuses
additional: Bib pickup and late registration at the DJK clubhouse in Neuses. Starts for the half marathon (21.2 km), 10 km and 5 km runs, as well as 10 km and 5 km walking/Nordic walking. Bambini and schoolchildren’s races for different age groups. Food and refreshments are provided. A running event with several distances, including races for children and young people, starting and finishing at the DJK clubhouse in Neuses. The event offers a challenge ranking for participants who take part in several races.

name: Pi Lauf 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bambini und Schülerlauf sind kostenlos, bitte hier die Teilnahme über pilaufanmeldung@web.de zusenden.

description: The Pi Run 2026 in Neunkirchen-Seelscheid offers a diverse range of races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes distances ranging from Bambini and children’s races to a 13.4-kilometer main race, as well as walking. The course is scenic, with refreshment stations and good on-site facilities. Every finisher receives a medal, and the top runners are honored. The Lions Club will provide cakes and drinks.
course_highlights: 13.431 km main race with two refreshment stations at km 6.5 and 11.5
Short Bambini and children’s races (approx. 600 m and 1,100 m)
Refreshment station on the recreational race course at approx. 3 km
additional: Race number pickup is available from 08:00 on race day in the start/finish area or in the nearby school building. Late registration is possible until 60 minutes before each start, with a €2 late registration fee. Changing facilities and toilets are available in school buildings and nearby halls. There is ample parking nearby. Every finisher receives a medal, and Bambini runners can get a scoop of ice cream from the sponsor. Registration is through the Race Result platform; participants receive running shirts and a multifunctional scarf. The event takes place in typical temperatures of around 20°C.

name: Ra(h)ser-Run
description: The Ra(h)ser-Run is a flat race through the Rahser district of Viersen, with distances from 1 km to 10 km. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists, and run mostly along paved paths beside the Niers floodplains. The event offers races for different age groups, including a Bambini run for the youngest participants and a schools’ city championship. Timing is electronic, using transponders in the race bibs. Registration is online only; late registration is available until 60 minutes before the start.
course_highlights: Flat, paved loops through Rahser and along the Niers floodplains
The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists
Kilometre markers and course marshals along the route
additional: Late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start for an additional fee of €5. Race bibs contain an integrated transponder for electronic timing, with both gun and net times. Sittarder Straße will be closed to through traffic between Kränkelsweg and Oberrahserstraße for the duration of the event. Participants can purchase an event T-shirt as part of online registration until 07.05. School and children’s races, free training sessions at Hoher Busch Stadium, race distances for different grade levels.

name: Spatzenberg-Lauf
description: The Spatzenberg Run is a traditional fun run in Löhne, following a hilly circular course around and over the Spatzenberg in the nature reserve. The route runs mostly on paved paths and roads and offers an attractive running opportunity for all age groups. In addition to the 9 km main race, there are shorter 6 km and 3 km races for schoolchildren. The event is organised by Turn- und Rasensportverein Löhne 1910 e.V., running group, and takes place at the Obernfeld sports field.
course_highlights: Hilly circular course around and over the Spatzenberg (nature reserve)
Route on paved paths and roads
Distances: 9 km, 6 km and 3 km schoolchildren’s race
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the back of the race bib. Race materials can be collected from 9:00 on the event day at the Obernfeld sports field. Late entries are possible on the event day until 10:15, while race bibs are available. Payment by SEPA direct debit for online registration or in cash when collecting race materials. Hilly course around the Spatzenberg, registration online or on the event day, timing with a disposable chip, water at the finish station

name: Sponsorenlauf Brustkrebshilfe Dorsten
location: Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, Dorsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Khadijeh Mohri, Andreas Schilasky, Ali Abdali
description: The Breast Cancer Aid Dorsten charity run is a charitable event in Dorsten focused on supporting breast cancer care and raising awareness. It takes place in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof and offers a range of running and walking routes accessible to all ages and fitness levels. Alongside the sporting aspect, supporting breast cancer aid is the main focus. A minimum participation fee applies, and participants can supplement it with additional donations. Participants can run or walk, or support the cause with a donation without taking part in the route.
course_highlights: Event in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, with wide paths and plenty of green space
Distances: 800 m for children, 2.5 km and 5 km for running or walking
Accessible changing rooms and shower facilities on site
additional: Race number distribution on site; parking nearby. You can also take part without running or walking by making a “Run with your heart” donation. The run takes place on May 31, 2026, with a focus on donations for breast cancer centers and community involvement. More than 2,000 participants are expected, with a fundraising target of over 50,000 euros.

name: Steinberger Wald-Volkslauf
description: The 49th Steinberger Wald-Volkslauf will take place on 31 May 2026 in Dietzenbach-Steinberg. The event is organized by SC Steinberg and offers runners a sporting challenge in a natural woodland setting. Participants can look forward to well-marked courses suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. A long-standing tradition, the event warmly welcomes all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Woodland courses in a natural setting
Well-marked 5 km and 10 km courses
Varied running routes with moderate terrain
additional: There are two main courses, measuring 5 km and 10 km. Designed as woodland runs, they offer a varied running environment. The event is organized by SC Steinberg, which also offers other sporting activities such as cross-country skiing, triathlon and running groups. Courses: 5 km and 10 km, online registration, sporting activities, club race

name: MAXiLauf 2026
organizer: Stadt Hamm, Amt für Konzernsteuerung und Sport
description: The MAXiLAUF in Hamm is an annual running event featuring flat, record-eligible courses that appeal to runners of all ability levels. Events include a half marathon, a 10 km run, a 5 km run, and children’s and toddlers’ races. The courses run through the city of Hamm and offer an attractive, approved circuit route passing many landmarks. All participants receive an exclusive medal, and trophies are awarded to the leading runners. The event is family-friendly and part of the Landesturnfest LTF26.
course_highlights: Flat, DLV-measured circuit courses through the city of Hamm
Courses eligible for inclusion in best lists
Attractive routes passing many landmarks
additional: Bib-number distribution from approx. 8:30 a.m. at the Stadtsportbund tent. Timing uses a race|result® chip attached to the bib. On-site registration is available. Cut-off times: half marathon 150 min, 10 km 90 min, 5 km 50 min. Personalised medal engraving can be booked for an additional fee. Certificates are available on-site and online. Official merchandise is available in the shop. The race features a DLV-measured circuit, medals for all finishers, online and on-site registration, and a festive atmosphere for runners and spectators.

name: Wachtelrun - Volkslauf mit Hauptlauf und Schülerläufen & Nordic Walking
01. Godelheimer See Marathon
description: Der 1. Godelheimer See Marathon/Ultra in Höxter findet am 25. Mai 2026 statt und ist eine Premiere mit DUV-Wertung. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern die Möglichkeit, eine neue Strecke rund um den Godelheimer See zu erleben. Der Lauf richtet sich an Marathon- und Ultramarathonläufer und verspricht eine abwechslungsreiche und anspruchsvolle Strecke in einer naturnahen Umgebung. Der Veranstalter ist der 100 Marathon Club Deutschland, ein Verein für erfahrene Marathonläufer.

name: Sternchenlauf
description: The Sternchenlauf in Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock is a traditional fun run held annually on the Wednesday before Corpus Christi. The event offers various races for all age groups, from races for toddlers and children to 5 km and 10 km races, as well as walking. The course follows a varied 2.5 km loop with forest trails, gravel and asphalt, lined with enthusiastic spectators. In addition to individual categories, there are team and relay categories, making the race especially appealing to groups.
course_highlights: A varied 2.5 km loop with forest trails, gravel and asphalt
Flat course with clear signage
Out-and-back courses for the toddler, children’s and schoolchildren’s races on Falkenstraße
additional: Start times: toddler race 17:00, children’s race 17:15, 1.0 km schoolchildren’s race 17:30, 2.5 km schoolchildren’s race 17:45, 5 km race 18:30, 10 km race and 5 km walk 19:30. The walk starts at the same time as the 10 km race, at the back of the field. Participant limit: approximately 2,000; relays are limited to 50. Event shirts can be purchased during registration or on site. Changing rooms and showers are available. Start and finish at the Waldstadion Schwarz-Weiß Sende e.V. Registration is available for individual and group races. The 5 km race is fully booked; remaining places will be available on site from 16:00 on the day of the event. The event is part of the region’s running events and offers a welcoming, family atmosphere.

name: B2Run Hannover
description: Der B2Run Hannover am 27. Mai 2026 ist ein Firmenlauf über eine rund 6,5 km lange, weitgehend flache Strecke entlang des Maschsees mit einem spektakulären Zieleinlauf in der Heinz von Heiden Arena. Der Lauf richtet sich an Unternehmen, Organisationen und Einzelstarter aus Hannover und Umgebung und fördert Teamgeist, Motivation und Gemeinschaftsgefühl. Die Veranstaltung bietet ein professionelles Rahmenprogramm mit Moderation und Musik und ist ideal für Einsteiger, Walker und erfahrene Läufer. Der Fokus liegt auf Spaß, Zusammenhalt und Teambuilding, nicht auf Bestzeiten.

name: Seligenstädter Marathonstaffel
description: Die 44. Seligenstädter Asklepios-Marathonstaffel ist ein einzigartiges Staffelrennen für Sechser-Teams aus Vereinen, Freizeitgruppen und Firmen, das am 27. Mai 2026 am Mainufer in Seligenstadt stattfindet. Die schnelle Wendepunktstrecke entlang des Mainufers bietet eine attraktive Laufstrecke mit Start und Ziel am neu gestalteten Festplatz. Die Veranstaltung wird von der LG Seligenstadt und dem Förderverein Freunde der LG Seligenstadt e.V. organisiert und bietet neben dem sportlichen Erlebnis auch eine kulinarische Versorgung mit Pasta-Gerichten von MAIN'E KÜCHE. Die Ausgabe der Startnummern und die Siegerehrung finden ebenfalls am Festplatz statt.

name: Steglitzer Volkslauf
description: Der Steglitzer Volkslauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung, die am 27. Mai 2026 im Stadion Lichterfelde in Berlin-Lichterfelde stattfindet. Veranstaltet vom TuS Lichterfelde von 1887 e.V., bietet der Volkslauf eine sportliche Gelegenheit für Läufer aller Altersklassen. Die Veranstaltung zeichnet sich durch eine familiäre Atmosphäre und eine gut organisierte Durchführung aus. Die Läufe starten und enden im Stadion Lichterfelde, was eine attraktive Kulisse für Teilnehmer und Zuschauer bietet.

name: Int. Oberweiser Straßen- und Volkslauf
description: The International Oberweis Fun Run takes place on June 4, 2026, in Oberweis and offers races for all age groups, from Bambinis to adults. The event includes various distances, including a Bambini run, children’s run, youth run, fitness run, walking, and the main 10 km run. The course passes through the picturesque surroundings of Oberweis and is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The event is family-friendly and promotes grassroots sport in the region.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400 m to 10 km
Races for all age groups from 1 to 99 years
Picturesque course in Oberweis
additional: Start times are staggered by discipline from 16:00 to 18:30. Registration opens on 10.03.2026. Event address: Neuerburger Str. 16, 54636 Oberweis. Contact via the online contact form. The event also includes children’s races, walking, and fitness runs, with registration opening in March 2026. It is generally held in June, weather permitting.

name: Int. Volkslauf, 38. Int. Halbmarathon, 22. Walkinglauf
description: TV Schwafheim is hosting the 52nd International Fun Run, the 38th International Half Marathon, and the 22nd Walking Event in Moers-Schwafheim. Races for children, adults, and walkers range in distance from 500 m to the half marathon. The course is closed to traffic, with several aid stations and timing by the Race Result system. The event is family-friendly and welcomes local club runners as well as half-marathon runners looking for a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Roads closed to traffic, with traffic rules to be observed
Several aid stations along the course
Timing with the Race Result system and two chips attached to the shoelaces
additional: Race number pickup in the morning at the clubhouse; late entries accepted until shortly before each start; showers at the clubhouse and in the Waldschule gym; certificates can be printed directly at the finish. Course maps, 2025 results, water stations, showers, registration from 08:00, late entries up to 30 minutes before the start, family-friendly

name: Klingenlauf
price_range: Erwachsene: 16,00 € bis 18,00 €, Jugendliche/Kinder: 8,00 €, Firmenstaffeln: 65,00 €, Staffeln: 10,00 €, Schul- und Gruppenstaffeln: 30,00 € bis 60,00 €
description: The Klingenlauf is a traditional running event in Solingen, taking place on June 4, 2026, in Südpark. With various races from 1 km to 10 km, relay races, and a company run, the Klingenlauf offers suitable running opportunities for all age groups and ability levels. The course runs through Solingen’s Südpark and along the Korkenziehertrasse. More than 1,500 runners take part each year, making the Klingenlauf a sporting highlight in the region.
course_highlights: Course through Solingen’s Südpark
Section along the Korkenziehertrasse
Various distances from 1 km to 10 km, as well as relay races
additional: Late registration is possible on the event day until 30 minutes before the respective start, provided the participant limit has not been reached. The late registration fee is €2.00. Race numbers can be collected on the event day and also on June 2, 2026, from 17:00 to 20:00 at the ice rink. The 5 km race is divided into two runs: Speed Run (max. 30 min.) at 18:15 and Fun Run (over 30 min.) at 18:45. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available on site. Various race categories, online registration, changing rooms, toilets and showers at the ice rink, limited baggage storage, certificates and honorary prizes, award ceremonies at the event venue

name: Leihgesterner Volkslauf
description: The Leihgestern Volkslauf takes place annually on Corpus Christi in the beautiful woodland landscape of Linden. Participants can choose from a 5 km walk, a 5 km run, or a 10 km run. The courses run mostly along comfortable forest paths with moderate elevation changes and are suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Timing is chip-based, and race bibs require a deposit that is refunded when the bib is returned.
course_highlights: 5 km loop with 95% forest paths and approximately 50 m of elevation gain
10 km loop with 95% forest paths and approximately 110 m of elevation gain
A nature-filled route through the woodland landscape of Linden
additional: Race bib deposit: EUR 2, refunded when the bib is returned. Online registration is available until 03.06.2026 at 18:00 (group registration) or 04.06.2026 at 08:30 (individual registration). On-site late registration is not possible. Gross and net times are recorded using a chip. The start venue is the TSG Leihgestern sports clubhouse, Waldstraße 32, 35440 Linden. Run through nature, starting at the sports clubhouse; online registration available until 04.06.2026

name: Volkslauf „Rund um Köchel“
description: The “Rund um Köchel” fun run is a traditional running competition held as part of the annual sports festival of SG Sportfreunde 69 Marmagen-Nettersheim. It gives runners of all ages and ability levels the opportunity to compete in four events (1,000 m, 2,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m). The event is part of a week of sport filled with action and team spirit at the grass sports field in Marmagen. A children’s obstacle race is also being offered for the first time, making the event family-friendly and varied.
course_highlights: Four events: 1,000 m, 2,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m
Event at the Marmagen grass sports field
Part of a major sports festival with a varied programme
additional: The fun run takes place on 04 June 2026 from 15:45 to 19:30. There are four running distances for different age and ability levels. A children’s obstacle race over 700 m and 1,400 m is also offered. The event is part of a multi-day sports festival featuring other sporting and family-friendly activities. Participation in four running events, including an obstacle race for children

name: Abendlauf Wilstedt bei Nacht
description: The Wilstedt Night Run takes place on 29 May 2026, transforming the village of Wilstedt into an atmospheric race course. The event is family-friendly and open to everyone, from beginners to experienced runners. The new course offers lovely views of the village at night. Cheering spectators and an evening fireworks display add to the atmosphere.
course_highlights: New course through Wilstedt with lovely views of the village
Atmospheric setting with cheering spectators along the course
Floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt after the run until 22:30
additional: The start and finish are at the Wilstedt sports grounds. The event begins with the mini run at 20:15, followed by the jogging and walking starts. Late entries are available on the event day from 18:30 to 20:00 and cost 9 euros. T-shirts or functional shirts are only available to participants who register in advance and will be handed out on the event day. After the run, floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt is free until 22:30. Fireworks bring the event to a close at around 22:45. Nordic walking poles are not allowed on the course. Child and running strollers are permitted only for the hiking/walking event. Shower and changing facilities are available on a limited basis. New course through Wilstedt, family-friendly, evening event, registration until 17 May, including a mini run, fireworks and musical entertainment.

name: Raesfelder Mai-Lauf
description: The Raesfeld May Run takes place annually on the last Friday in May and offers a varied running programme for all age groups. From the 400 m Bambini races for kindergarten children to the 5 km and 10 km races for adults, there is something for everyone. There is also a 5 km team run, encouraging the fun of running together. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and are therefore eligible for inclusion in rankings.
course_highlights: 400 m child-friendly course for Bambinis
1,000 m and 2.3 km courses for children and teenagers
5 km and 10 km courses for adults, measured by the DLV
additional: Start times: 16:00 Bambini races (400 m), 17:00 1,000 m schoolchildren’s race, 17:30 2.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 18:00 10 km Volksbank Run, 18:05 5 km walking race, 19:30 5 km company, family and team run. The 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km loop. Part of the Lippe-Issel Cup, registration required, family-friendly, various categories.

name: Rohrener Volkslauf
description: The 48th Rohrener Volkslauf takes place on Friday evening in Monschau, Germany. Various events are offered, including a 4.2 km and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a separate 10 km event for walkers and Nordic walkers. The races follow a rolling course and all finish at Im Johannesfeld in Monschau. Younger runners also take part, and registration is online through the organizer.
course_highlights: Rolling course through Monschau
Finish at Im Johannesfeld
Separate 10 km event for walkers and Nordic walkers
additional: The shorter races start first, followed by the walkers and Nordic walkers, with the 10 km runners starting last. Typical June weather is around 23 °C, with mostly sunny days. Event with a rolling course, online registration, children’s and youth races, and walking events.

name: Lauf Rund um Burg
description: Der 37. Lauf Rund um Burg ist Teil der Cross and Forest Run Series und findet rund um Burg bei Dithmarschen statt. Die Veranstaltung bietet Läufern die Möglichkeit, auf landschaftlich reizvollen Strecken von 4,8 km und 10 km zu laufen. Das Rennen zeichnet sich durch seine naturnahe Umgebung und die abwechslungsreiche Strecke aus. Teilnehmer können sich auf eine freundliche Atmosphäre und eine gut organisierte Veranstaltung freuen.

name: Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf
description: Der Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf ist ein Benefizlauf mit dem einzigartigen Konzept "Sport trifft Musik" zugunsten des Kinderhospizes Mitteldeutschland. Die Veranstaltung bietet verschiedene Laufwettbewerbe für Kinder, Jugendliche, Unternehmen und Einzelstarter sowie Walker. Neben dem sportlichen Event gibt es musikalische Begleitung und ein KinderGartenKonzert, was den Lauf zu einem besonderen Erlebnis für Teilnehmer und Zuschauer macht. Die Startunterlagen können bereits am Vortag abgeholt werden, und nach dem Lauf findet eine AfterRöblinglaufParty statt.

name: Nacht von Hasbergen
description: Die Nacht von Hasbergen ist ein traditionsreicher Straßenlauf, der am Freitag, den 29. Mai 2026, in Hasbergen stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet spannende Laufwettbewerbe für alle Altersklassen, vom Bambinilauf über Staffellauf bis hin zum Hauptlauf über 10 km. Die Läufe finden auf einer neuen Streckenführung statt, die aufgrund einer Baustelle angepasst wurde. Die Veranstaltung beginnt mit einer Eröffnung und einem Showact für die Bambinis und endet mit Siegerehrungen für die verschiedenen Wettbewerbe.

name: HIT-felder Volkslauf
description: The HIT-felder Volkslauf is a long-standing race in Seevetal, organised by TSV Eintracht Hittfeld. It offers courses for the whole family, from short runs at the Peperdieksberg sports grounds to longer routes along country and forest paths. The event takes place on 30 May 2026 from 13:30 and is known for its friendly atmosphere and extensive supporting programme. All participants receive a finisher’s medal. Team rankings and cash prizes are also awarded to the largest groups of runners who register in advance.
course_highlights: Routes along country and forest paths, as well as partly paved side roads
Races over 600 m, 1000 m, 2.5 km, 4.5 km and 10.6 km, with small and large loops
Electronic timing; spikes are not permitted
additional: Start and finish at Hittfeld School Centre, Peperdieksberg sports grounds. Changing rooms and showers are available at the school centre. Late registration is possible on the day of the event, up to 30 minutes before the start, with cash payment (except for the Roland-Witt family run). Supporting programme with coffee, cake, grilled sausages and drinks. Certificates are available online at www.stgk.de. Team rankings apply to certain races. The group with the most advance registrations receives a challenge trophy and cash prizes. The event takes place in May, with typical temperatures of around 20°C for the low and 10°C for the high, and offers children’s races, walking and Nordic walking alongside the running courses.

name: Johannes-Lauf Lette
location: Ernsting's family Sportpark, Lette, Coesfeld, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Johanneslauf in Lette is a long-standing running event that has been held annually at the Ernsting's family Sportpark since 1998. The race attracts participants from across the region and is a regular fixture on the regional sporting calendar. It is organised by DJK Vorwärts Lette e.V., a club with a long tradition and a strong commitment to grassroots sport. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly and inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Ernsting's family Sportpark
5-kilometre race
A tradition since 1998 with regional significance
additional: The race is part of the Streiflicher running series. Previous events have attracted around 400 participants and included a 5-kilometre walking route.

name: Leegebrucher Straßenlauf am 30.05.2026
price_range: Kinder frei; Jugendliche 3 Euro; Erwachsene 4 Euro
description: The Leegebruch Road Race takes place on May 30, 2026, and is a traditional running event in Leegebruch that welcomes runners of almost all ages. Participants run laps on the sports field and through the streets of Leegebruch. The event promises a lively atmosphere and is open to athletes of all ability levels. Registration is online via an external platform.
course_highlights: Laps on the sports field and through the streets of Leegebruch
Traditional running event with a family-friendly atmosphere
Suitable for runners of almost all ages
additional: Registration is online only; on-site registration is not possible. There are no age categories and no awards ceremony. Changing rooms and showers are not available. Cold and hot drinks and snacks are available at the kiosk. Parking is available at the fairground on Lindenstraße. Run on roads and at the stadium, online registration, no changing rooms or showers, parking on Lindenstraße

name: 08. Dünenfeld Marathon
description: Der Dünenfeld Marathon in Augustdorf ist ein besonderer Lauf, der nach den Regeln des 100 Marathonclub Deutschland veranstaltet wird. Die Strecke umfasst sieben große Runden à 6,1 km mit insgesamt 42,7 km und weist teilweise Trailcharakter auf. Der Start befindet sich auf Höhe der Aussichtsplattform, von wo aus die Läufer einen schönen Blick auf die großen Dünenfelder genießen können. Die Veranstaltung ist eine private Laufveranstaltung mit Selbstversorgung und Handzeitnahme, bei der ein Foto der Uhr als Nachweis per E-Mail eingereicht werden muss.

name: 34. Emder Matjeslauf
description: Der 34. Emder Matjeslauf findet am Samstag, den 30. Mai 2026, in der Emder Innenstadt statt. Die Veranstaltung ist ein traditionsreicher Citylauf, der seit 1991 von der Emder Laufgemeinschaft e.V. organisiert wird und weit über die Region hinaus bekannt ist. Neben dem Hauptlauf über 10 km gibt es auch Schulklassenwertungen und Teamwertungen, die den Lauf zu einem vielseitigen Event für alle Altersgruppen machen. Die Strecke wurde aufgrund von Baumaßnahmen in der Neutorstraße angepasst, bietet aber weiterhin einen attraktiven Rundkurs durch die Stadt. Die Emder Laufgemeinschaft freut sich auf zahlreiche Teilnehmer und wünscht viel Erfolg.

name: 6. Wehrheimer Backyard Ultra
description: Der Wehrheimer Backyard Ultra (WEHBU) findet am 30. Mai 2026 zum sechsten Mal statt. Dieses private Event im familiären Kreis ist nur auf persönliche Einladung zugänglich, da Start- und Zielbereich auf privatem Grundstück liegen. Die Strecke führt über geschotterte und asphaltierte Wege mit einigen anspruchsvollen Höhenmetern und bietet eine fantastische Aussicht auf Wehrheim und die Taunusberge inklusive des Feldbergs. Eine besondere Herausforderung ist die "Wiese des Grauens", die je nach Wetter matschig sein kann. Für den Sieger gibt es einen originalen Bembel als Wanderpokal, passend zum Zweitnamen Wehrheims als "Apfeldorf".

name: Aegidius-Lauf
description: Der Aegidius-Lauf ist ein seit über 20 Jahren etablierter Benefizlauf in Hannover, der am 30. Mai 2026 stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet mehrere Laufdistanzen, darunter Kinderläufe, einen Rolli-Lauf sowie 5 km und 10 km Läufe und Walking-Varianten. Start und Ziel sind am Aegidiushaus AUF DER BULT, und die Teilnahmegebühren kommen ausschließlich einem guten Zweck zugute. Die Laufstrecke ist attraktiv und wird ohne Chipzeitmessung mit Zeituhr durchgeführt. Alle Teilnehmer erhalten eine Urkunde, und die besten Läuferinnen und Läufer werden mit Sachpreisen geehrt.

name: Allbaulauf 2026
description: Der AllbauLauf 2026 findet am 30. Mai rund um den Niederfeldsee und den Krupp-Park in Altendorf, Essen, statt. Das Event bietet eine bunte Mischung aus Läufen für Schüler, Jugendliche, Firmenläufer, Volksläufer und Leistungssportler. Besonders beliebt sind auch die kurzen Strecken für Bambinis und Schüler, die direkt an der Uferpromenade und über eine Brücke führen. Die Veranstaltung ist ein sportliches Highlight mit vielfältigen Laufangeboten für alle Alters- und Leistungsklassen.

name: Bartenwetzer Volkslauf
description: Der Bartenwetzer Volkslauf ist der älteste Volkslauf in Nordhessen und findet am 30. Mai 2026 im Waldstadion Melsungen statt. Die Veranstaltung umfasst Kinder- und Schülerläufe über 400 m und 1000 m sowie Hauptläufe über 5 km, 10 km und 19 km, die auf festen Wegen durch den Melsunger Stadtwald führen. Als 10. Wertungslauf des Nordhessencups bietet der Lauf eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit Verpflegung, Siegerehrungen und einem Buffet. Die Start- und Zielbereiche liegen idyllisch am Rande des Stadtwalds, was den Lauf besonders reizvoll macht.

name: Charity Trail Mannebach 111
description: Der Charity Trail Mannebach 111 ist ein anspruchsvoller Trailrun, der am 30. Mai 2026 in Mannebach stattfindet. Die Veranstaltung bietet vier Distanzen von 12 km bis 48 km mit unterschiedlichen Höhenmetern, die durch die malerische Traumschleife führen. Die Strecke ist abwechslungsreich und bietet Verpflegungspunkte sowie eine Finishermedaille für alle Teilnehmer. Das Startgeld wird zu 100 % an wohltätige Organisationen gespendet, was den Lauf zu einem besonderen Event mit sozialem Engagement macht.

name: Illinger City-Lauf
description: Der Illinger City-Lauf ist eine traditionsreiche Laufveranstaltung in Illingen, die von der Langlaufgemeinschaft Wustweiler e.V. organisiert wird. Die Strecke führt durch die Stadt Illingen mit Start und Ziel am Hallenbad Illingen. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit Siegerehrung und gemütlichem Beisammensein auf dem Vorplatz der Halle. Duschen, Parkplätze und Sanitätsdienst sind vor Ort vorhanden, und die Läufe sind durch den Landessportverband für das Saarland versichert.

name: Lauf zwischen den Meeren
description: Der Lauf zwischen den Meeren ist ein einzigartiger Staffellauf, der die Teilnehmer als Teams von Husum an der Nordsee bis nach Damp an der Ostsee führt. Die 92,2 Kilometer lange Strecke ist in zehn Etappen unterteilt, die durch die abwechslungsreiche Landschaft Schleswig-Holsteins führen. Neben der individuellen Leistung steht die Gemeinschaftsleistung der Teams im Vordergrund. Der Lauf verbindet nicht nur die Küsten, sondern auch die Menschen der Region und bietet ein besonderes Lauferlebnis für Breiten- und Spitzensportler.

name: Limbacher Marktlauf
description: Der Limbacher Marktlauf findet am 30. Mai 2026 zum 30. Mal im Waldstadion Limbach-Oberfrohna statt. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine tolle Laufatmosphäre mit neuen Strecken, neuen Wettbewerben und einer Finishermedaille. Neben dem sportlichen Wettkampf erwartet die Teilnehmer ein umfangreiches Rahmenprogramm. Der Lauf wird vom LV Limbach 2000 e.V. ausgerichtet und ist eine beliebte Veranstaltung in der Region.

name: Nienburger Spargellauf
description: Der Nienburger Spargellauf ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf am 30. Mai 2026 in Nienburg, der verschiedene Distanzen für Kinder, Jugendliche und Erwachsene anbietet. Die Strecken sind offiziell vermessen und führen über flache, teilweise schattige Rundkurse mit Start und Ziel am Wesavi-Parkplatz. Neben Einzel- und Kinderläufen gibt es auch einen 10-km-Staffellauf sowie Firmen- und Vereinswertungen. Die Veranstaltung ist bekannt für ihre familiäre Atmosphäre und attraktive Prämien für die besten Läufer.

name: Turm zu Turm Lauf
description: Der 21. Turm zu Turm Lauf am 30. Mai 2026 in Georgsmarienhütte bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern ein abwechslungsreiches und landschaftlich reizvolles Erlebnis. Die Hauptstrecke über 24 Kilometer verbindet die markanten Aussichtspunkte Hermannsturm und Varusturm und führt durch Waldpassagen mit rund 520 Höhenmetern. Zusätzlich gibt es Läufe für Kinder, einen Jedermannslauf, einen Landschaftslauf über 10 Kilometer sowie eine Walker-Strecke. Die Veranstaltung ist ein sportliches Highlight der Region Osnabrück und Westfalen und bietet für alle Alters- und Leistungsklassen passende Strecken.

name: Amsterdam UMC Run
description: The Amsterdam UMC Run is a unique running event that takes participants through Amsterdam UMC hospital and the green surroundings of Amsterdam Zuidoost. Participants can choose from the 1.2 km Family Run, 5 km, 10 km, or the challenging hat trick, in which all distances are run separately. Alongside the sporting aspect, the event aims to raise money for research and improvements to patient care at Amsterdam UMC. It offers a fun day with music, food trucks, entertainment, and a kids’ corner, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels.
course_highlights: Routes go right through Amsterdam UMC hospital
Start corrals for the 5 km and 10 km provide plenty of space on the course
Aid stations with water and fruit along the route
additional: Start corrals for the 5 km (Green and Blue) and 10 km, with groups of around 300 participants starting every 10 minutes. Race numbers will be ready for collection at the event site and will not be mailed. Employees and visitors can collect their race numbers earlier at the AMC site. A unique running shirt can be ordered, with part of the proceeds going to research. Aid stations with water and fruit along the route. First aid will be available. The course is closed to traffic. Registration is online; the event supports various medical research projects, including cancer and dementia research. The event is car-free and suitable for all ages.

name: Halve Marathon Veghel
location: Prins Willem Alexander Sportpark, Veghel, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Half Marathon Veghel is an annual running event held on the last weekend of May in Veghel. The course is a 7.09-kilometre loop that participants run three times, with the start and finish at Fit Functional. The event is intended both for recreational runners looking to run their first half marathon and for experienced runners aiming for a fast time. Safety and runner support are central, with first-aid facilities and aid stations along the route. The organiser, Fit Functional, is committed to offering a professional, well-organised event and encouraging sport and health in the region.
course_highlights: A 7.09 km course run three times, for a total of 21.1 km
Start and finish at Fit Functional, with an aid station and split-time recording
Route along footpaths and cycle paths in the countryside around Veghel
additional: First-aid facilities are available at the start and finish. Participants must obey traffic rules and follow the organiser’s instructions. Drink stations are located at Fit Functional. The event is planned for Prins Willem Alexander Sports Park; registration opens on 1 February 2026; a permit application for 2027 has been submitted.

name: Meppel City Run
distance_verbose: 12.9 km, 6.4 km, 3000 meter, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.2 km
description: The Meppel City Run is a running event through Meppel’s historic city centre, with a choice of 4 or 8 English miles. The fully paved, traffic-free route passes beautiful places such as Wilhelminapark and several lively streets. Alongside the main distances, there are also a Kidsrun, G-Run and Frame-Run, making the event suitable for recreational runners, experienced athletes and athletes with disabilities. The start and finish are in the city centre, making for an atmospheric and sporty day for everyone.
course_highlights: Fully paved, traffic-free route over cobblestones
Start on Grote Oever and finish on Kromme Elleboog
Run through the historic city centre and past Wilhelminapark
additional: The 8-mile race consists of two laps of the 4-mile course, which is extra fun for spectators. All events start on Grote Oever, and the Kidsrun, Frame-Run and G-Run also finish there. There is a warm-up for the G-Run and Kidsrun. All children receive a medal after the event. There is a Business Run for teams of 3 to 5 participants. The course is certified by the Atletiek Unie. The event also includes activities such as warm-up sessions and an awards ceremony, and offers registration by email. The organisers cater to a broad audience, from young runners to experienced athletes.

name: Quintusloop
description: The Quintusloop is a running event in Hengelo where participants can choose between distances of 10 and 21 kilometres. The aim is to raise money for research into multiple sclerosis (MS), driven by a personal wish to offer hope to people living with the disease. The event is organised in support of the MS Research Foundation and highlights the importance of running together for a future with better treatments and more research.
course_highlights: Distances of 10 and 21 kilometres
Running for the cause of MS research
Held in Hengelo
additional: The Quintusloop is a fundraising event where participants run together to raise money for MS research, with a personal motivation to support a friend who has been diagnosed with MS. A newsletter is available to keep people up to date with activities. The website highlights the importance of research and hope for people with MS. The race supports MS research and awareness, with a route that includes both paved and unpaved roads.

name: Rotte Dam Loop
description: The Rotte Dam Loop is a social running and walking event in Rotterdam, where participants enjoy the beautiful surroundings along the Rotte river. There are four distances: a 1 km kids’ run, 5 km through Hoge Bergse Bos, and 10 km and 21 km along the Rotte from the dam to Outdoor Valley. The event is not timed, so everyone can enjoy the activity and atmosphere at their own pace. The race is known for its friendly, accessible character for runners and walkers of all levels.
course_highlights: 1 km kids’ run and 5 km through Hoge Bergse Bos
10 km and 21 km along the Rotte river
Start at the dam and finish at Outdoor Valley
additional: The race is not timed, and both running and walking are possible. There is a Rotte Dam Loop Festival at the finish. The 2026 event was sold out, and a waiting list was available. The event emphasizes enjoyment and togetherness, with a focus on accessibility for everyone. The anniversary edition in 2026 was a great success, and the organizers continue to focus on a friendly, social experience for all participants.

name: The Royal Ten

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: MUNT Hypotheken Business Run €270 per team (ex. btw)

description: The Royal Ten is The Hague’s most sociable running event, organised annually by The Hague Road Runners. The event offers various distances and races, including an officially measured 10-kilometre race that runs through Haagse Bos and past Huis ten Bosch Palace. The course is completely traffic-free and fast, with clear kilometre markers and a water station at 5 km. The organisers are committed to providing a safe and enjoyable running experience for all participants.
course_highlights: 10 km course officially measured and certified by the Atletiekunie
Course runs through Beatrixkwartier and Haagse Bos, and past Huis ten Bosch Palace
Completely traffic-free course with clear kilometre markers and a water station
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day or on Saturday 30 May. Bag drop is available at the NH Hotel, but there are no changing rooms. A free first-aid station is available in the start/finish area. There is a water station at 5 km, with additional stations in warm weather. Minimum age: 12 for the 5 km and 14 for the 10 km. The organisers accept no liability, and refunds are not available if you are unable to participate. The event takes place on 30 May 2027 and offers various categories for runners of all levels.

name: Elsterlauf
organizer: SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda e.V. und Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Elsterlauf in Bad Liebenwerda is a traditional running and walking event, taking place for the 46th time on May 31, 2026. The event offers a variety of distances, including a marathon, half marathon, several walking and hiking routes, and children’s races. The course runs through the spa town of Bad Liebenwerda, with a family-friendly atmosphere and classifications for individual participants, teams, and companies. All participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate, and awards are presented by age group. The event is organised by SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda and Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
course_highlights: A variety of distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km, 5.7 km, 2 km, walking, and hiking
Start and finish at Roßmarkt in Bad Liebenwerda, near the primary school centre with changing rooms and showers
Guided 11 km hike and family-friendly races such as the Bambini and taster runs
additional: Late registration is available on May 30, 2026, from 12:00 to 15:00, and on May 31, 2026, from 07:00 to 09:30. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Bad Liebenwerda primary school centre; baggage storage is available from 7:00 to 14:00. The finish closes for all distances at 13:15. There is a company and club classification, with teams of three participants. Cyclists and hikers start without timing or classification. All participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate. Results will be published online. Running event with online registration and various categories for runners, walkers, and families, including award ceremonies and finisher’s medals.

name: Urwaldlauf
description: The Urwaldlauf is a six-hour race in which participants can run as many laps as they like on a 1.85 km course through the forest near Saarbrücken within six hours. The start time is flexible from 10 a.m., and participants can enter individually or as part of a team. The course combines wide forest paths with idyllic singletrack trails and offers a challenging 46 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event places great emphasis on flexibility and fun, with an electronic lap counter and refreshments at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus.
course_highlights: 1.85 km lap through the forest near Saarbrücken
46 metres of elevation gain per lap; more than 1,000 metres over marathon distance
A mix of wide forest paths and idyllic singletrack trails
additional: Bib pickup is available on site from 9 a.m. Flexible start time from 10 a.m.; the finish closes at 4 p.m. Electronic lap counter and refreshment station at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus. The field is limited to 350 participants. Late registration is possible online or on site; the late-registration fee is payable on site. Team classification available; make sure the team name is spelled consistently. Six-hour race, 1.85 km lap, approximately 46 metres of elevation gain per lap, forest paths and singletrack trails, flexible start time from 10 a.m., finish at 4 p.m., online registration until the Friday before the event, participant limit of 350.

name: Lamer Woid-Reim
description: The Lamer “Woid-Reim” is a varied race starting in Lambach. With more than 70% of the route on trails, it guarantees plenty of fun and variety for runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is aimed at both competitive and recreational runners and is supported by numerous volunteers. Food and refreshments are available, and spectators are warmly welcome to cheer on participants along the course. Its special atmosphere makes the Lamer “Woid-Reim” a popular race in the Laufcup Cham.
course_highlights: Start in Lambach
More than 70% trail route
Varied course
additional: The event is part of the Laufcup Cham. There are classifications for different age groups and distances. Spectators are warmly welcome. Food and refreshments are available. The course is predominantly on trails. Several race categories, including children’s, youth, recreational and main races; start at 10:00 a.m.; registration open until 5 June 2026; Nordic skiing registration open until 5 June 2026, including refreshments, coffee and cake.

name: ADAC-Tine-Flugplatzlauf
description: The ADAC Tine Airfield Run in Husum is a unique running event held on an actual airfield. The event is for the whole family and offers a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. Experience sporting ambition and a sense of community in the beautiful surroundings of Husum on the North Sea.
course_highlights: Run on an actual airfield
Family-friendly event
Beautiful North Sea surroundings in Husum
additional: Run on the Husum airfield, distances from 500 m to 10 km, family and children’s races, charitable support

name: Freystädter Volksfestlauf
price_range: Erwachsene: 10,00 Euro, Schüler: 5,00 Euro, Bambini: 4,00 Euro
description: The Freystädter Volksfestlauf is a traditional running event in Freystadt, Bavaria, held annually as part of the Freystädter Volksfest. The races start and finish at the town hall on the market square and offer various distances for adults, schoolchildren, and Bambini. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with awards for the best runners and teams as well as special categories. Changing rooms and showers are available at the TSV sports clubhouse, and the awards ceremonies take place in the festival tent or outdoors.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the town hall on the market square in Freystadt
Course routes can be viewed online in advance
Race distances for different age and ability groups
additional: Late entries are possible at the town hall until 1 hour before the respective start; a late entry fee of 3.00 euros applies. The awards ceremony for schoolchildren takes place at around 11:00 at the town hall, and the ceremony for adults and youth takes place from around 13:00 in the festival tent or outdoors. Changing rooms and showers are available at the TSV sports clubhouse, Allersberger-Straße 23, Freystadt. There are honorary prizes for the top finishers, certificates for places 1–3, and additional certificates available online. Special and team categories are also included. Courses for different age groups, online registration, awards ceremonies at the town hall and in the festival tent, changing rooms at the TSV sports clubhouse

name: 16. Campuslauf Technische Universität Braunschweig
description: Der 16. Campuslauf der Technischen Universität Braunschweig findet am 31. Mai 2026 auf dem Campus der Universität statt. Der Lauf bietet Studierenden und Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, sich sportlich zu betätigen und gemeinsam eine aktive Zeit auf dem Universitätsgelände zu verbringen. Die Veranstaltung ist Teil des Hochschulsportprogramms und fördert den Gemeinschaftssinn sowie die Gesundheit der Teilnehmer.

name: 32. Tangerlauf
description: Der 32. Tangerlauf in Tangerhütte ist ein traditionsreicher Lauf durch die Tangerniederung, organisiert vom SV Germania Tangerhütte. Die Strecke führt entlang des Flusses Tanger durch die reizvolle altmärkische Natur, die im Frühjahr besonders schön ist. Der Lauf blickt auf eine lange Geschichte zurück, die bis in die DDR-Zeit reicht, und wurde nach der Wende wiederbelebt. Die Organisatoren wünschen allen Teilnehmerinnen und Teilnehmern gutes Wetter und viel Freude beim Lauf.

name: 40. Göttinger Frühjahrs-Volkslauf
description: Der 40. Göttinger Sparkassen-Volkslauf findet am 31. Mai 2026 im Jahnstadion Göttingen statt und bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern aller Leistungsstufen ein vielfältiges Laufangebot. Die Veranstaltung verbindet Tradition und Gemeinschaft und lädt sowohl erfahrene Läufer als auch Hobbyjogger zu einem aktiven Tag mit Spaß und Bewegung ein. Die Strecken umfassen 2 km, 5,4 km und 10,8 km, wobei der Halbmarathon in diesem Jahr leider entfällt. Die Veranstaltung legt Wert auf Gesundheit, Wohlbefinden und das Miteinander in der Region.

name: 5. Urwaldsteig-Ultratrail
description: Der Urwaldsteig-Ultratrail ist ein anspruchsvoller Ultratrail-Lauf über ca. 66 km mit etwa 2000 Höhenmetern rund um den Edersee. Die Strecke führt von Waldeck aus gegen den Uhrzeigersinn durch abwechslungsreiche Naturlandschaften, darunter dichte Wälder, schmale Pfade, das Naturschutzgebiet Kahle Haardt und den Nationalpark Kellerwald-Edersee. Die Läufer erwarten beeindruckende Ausblicke auf den See, historische Stätten wie die Hünselburg und abwechslungsreiche Trailabschnitte mit hohem Natur- und Erlebniswert. Start und Ziel sind am Parkplatz Schloss Waldeck, der Lauf beginnt um 8 Uhr.

name: 9. Hellmich Parkhauslauf
description: Der HELLMICH Parkhauslauf in Lehrte ist ein einzigartiges Laufevent, das im Parkhaus Lehrte stattfindet. Die Teilnehmer laufen auf einer etwa 1 km langen Runde durch das Parkhaus, was durch die Steigungen und den Ausblick auf die Stadt ein besonderes Lauferlebnis bietet. Es gibt drei verschiedene Läufe mit unterschiedlichen Rundenanzahlen, die sowohl für Kinder als auch für Erwachsene geeignet sind. Die Veranstaltung ist auf jeweils 50 Teilnehmer pro Lauf begrenzt, um die Sicherheit zu gewährleisten, und jeder Finisher erhält eine Medaille als Erinnerung.

name: Erfurtshäuser Lauf
description: Der Erfurtshäuser Lauf ist eine traditionelle Laufveranstaltung in Amöneburg-Erfurtshausen, die Läufer aller Altersklassen willkommen heißt. Es gibt verschiedene Wettbewerbe wie Bambini-, Schüler-, Jedermann- und Hauptlauf sowie Walking/Nordic Walking. Die Strecke ist markiert, jeder Kilometer wird angezeigt, und Verpflegungsstationen sind entlang der Strecke eingerichtet. Am Ziel sorgt der Veranstalter für das leibliche Wohl der Teilnehmer. Die Zeitmessung erfolgt computergestützt mit zusätzlicher Absicherung durch Stoppuhren, und Urkunden können auf Wunsch ausgestellt werden.

name: Göttinger Frühjahrs-Volkslauf
description: Der 40. Göttinger Sparkassen-Volkslauf findet am 31. Mai 2026 im Göttinger Jahnstadion statt und bietet Läuferinnen und Läufern aller Leistungsstufen ein vielfältiges Laufangebot. Die Veranstaltung verbindet Tradition und Gemeinschaft und lädt sowohl erfahrene Läufer als auch Hobby-Jogger zu einem aktiven Tag mit Spaß und Bewegung ein. Die Strecken sind fast eben, befestigt und teilweise asphaltiert, und führen auf einem Rundkurs durch die Region. Neben den Hauptläufen gibt es auch Schüler- und Bambini-Läufe sowie Walking-Strecken, die für alle Altersgruppen geeignet sind.

name: Wachtelrun Liederbach
description: Der Wachtel-Run der TSG Niederhofheim findet am 31. Mai 2026 in Liederbach statt und lädt Laufbegeisterte aller Altersklassen zu einem sportlichen Tag ein. Angeboten werden verschiedene Streckenlängen, darunter 10 km, 5 km, Schülerläufe sowie ein Bambini-Lauf. Zusätzlich gibt es einen 5 km Wachtel-Walk für Walking-Anfänger und Speedwalker ohne Wertung. Die Veranstaltung bietet eine familiäre Atmosphäre mit Start und Ziel am Sportplatz Liederbach.

name: Wandermarathon TSV Bollensen
description: Der Wandermarathon TSV Bollensen lädt alle Freunde des Volkssports herzlich ein, eine angenehme Wanderung durch das schöne Waldgebiet Solling Vogler zu erleben. Die Strecken sind Rundkurse mit Start und Ziel am Sportheim des TSV Bollensen und führen ausschließlich über Waldwege.
