name: Backyard Ultra de Langstraat
description: The Backyard Ultra de Langstraat takes place in Waalwijk on Saturday, October 31, 2026. The race consists of a distance of 7 kilometers and offers runners a challenging and unique running experience in the Brabant region. This ultramarathon is ideal for runners who want to test their endurance in a friendly and sporty atmosphere.
course_highlights: 7 kilometers per lap
Location in Waalwijk, Brabant
Unique Backyard Ultra format
additional: The race is held in a friendly and sporty atmosphere, with a focus on endurance and perseverance.

name: Dalli-run
description: Athletics club De Gemzen organizes the Dalli-Run every autumn, one of the most beautiful running events of the year, on October 31, 2026. The race takes place in Heerde on the Veluwe and offers a beautiful undulating course past some of the area’s loveliest spots. The Dalli-Run is popular in the region and offers several distances, from short youth races to 15 kilometers for adults. The routes follow paved roads and cycle paths, with starts between 10:00 and 11:00.
course_highlights: A beautiful undulating course past some of Heerde’s loveliest spots
Paved roads and cycle paths
Several distances: 700m, 1400m, 5km, 10km and 15km
additional: Start times between 10:00 and 11:00. Youth distances: 700 and 1400 meters; adult distances: 5, 10 and 15 kilometers. The course follows paved roads and cycle paths. Organized by Athletics club De Gemzen. The Dalli-Run is an event for runners of all levels, with activities for children and adults. It is organized by a local athletics club and attracts many participants from the region each year.

name: Haarlerbergtrail
description: The Haarlerbergtrail takes place on Saturday, 31 October 2026, and offers challenging trail runs over distances of 11, 16, 22 and 30 kilometres. The routes pass through a large part of Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park, where runners can enjoy beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The organisers aim to make the event climate-neutral and ask participants to bring their own drinking cup. There is no prize ceremony, but every participant receives a medal as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Routes through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park
Varied terrain, with some paths closed during the bird-breeding season
Beautiful scenery and challenging trail distances
additional: Maximum of 349 participants. Online registration only. Start times: 30 km and 22 km at 12:00, 16 km at 12:15, and 11 km at 12:30. Bringing your own drinking cup is compulsory; a reusable cup is available to buy for €4. No prize ceremony, but every participant receives a medal. Start and finish at Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel. No on-the-day registration. Registration closes on 31 October at 11:30, or earlier if the event is full. The organisers may cancel the event up to 30 October at 20:00. Cycling alongside participants on the course is not permitted. Trail through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park; organised as a climate-neutral event. Bringing your own drinking cup is compulsory. Maximum of 349 participants; online registration. Race numbers can be collected at De Veldkamp. Limited shower facilities.

name: Moerschanscross
description: The Moerschanscross is an individual cross-country race held in Hulst on 31 October 2026. This is the 40th edition of the event and it is part of the AERS Groep Zeeuwse Crosscompetitie. The race features various age groups and categories, from pupils to M/V 55+, and offers a challenging course for all participants. Registration is open until 29 October at 18:00, with limited late registration available at double the entry fee.
course_highlights: Individual cross-country race with various age groups
Participants range from pupils to M/V 55+
Part of the AERS Groep Zeeuwse Crosscompetitie
additional: Late registration is temporarily available until Friday at 12:00 at double the entry fee; after that, registration is no longer possible. The AERS Groep Crosscompetitie 2026-2027 regulations and the Atletiekunie competition regulations apply. Any images may be published publicly. Registration closes on 29 October at 18:00, with late registration available until Friday at 12:00. The event is supported by Zeeuwse Atletiek and is a fixture of the Zeeland cross-country season.

name: Pheidippidesloop
organizer: Utrecht Atletiek en Road Runners Zeist

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Inschrijven kost 70 euro en is mogelijk vanaf 1 mei tot woensdag 28 oktober 23:59 uur.

description: The Pheidippides Run is a unique relay marathon held annually at Maarschalkerweerd Athletics Track in Utrecht. Teams of seven runners cover the distance of a full marathon together, inspired by the legendary run of Pheidippides. The event is ideal for companies, groups of friends and running clubs looking to enjoy an active and sociable day together. The race starts on Saturday, 31 October 2026 at 11:00 and offers a great combination of competition and team spirit.
course_highlights: Relay marathon with 7 participants per team
Distances of 2 × 4.1 km and 5 × 6.8 km per team
Start, changeover point and finish at Maarschalkerweerd Athletics Track
additional: Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available free of charge at the athletics track. The pavilion is open, serving refreshments such as coffee, hot chocolate, bitterballen and beer. The athletics track is easy to reach by bike, public transport and car, but parking is limited and parking is prohibited on Mytylweg. The lineup and running order can be changed on race day. Relay marathon with multiple legs, starting at Maarschalkerweerd Athletics Track. Participants can register from 1 May to 28 October. The event highlights team spirit and social interaction.

name: Vechtdaltrail
distance_verbose: 60 km, Marathon, 30 km, Halve marathon, 15 km
description: The VechtdalTrail takes place on 31 October 2026 in Ommen and offers challenging trail-running routes of 15, 22, 30, 42 and 60 kilometres. The trails feature little asphalt, plenty of singletrack and varied terrain, including forest and sandy paths and rough grassland. The longer distances include several short climbs, especially in the ‘Beerze Bulten’ area, making the 60 km route a true ultra trail. The organisers aim to make the event sustainable, with no disposable cups, and provide individual timing via a chip in the bib number. Registration is only available in advance, and the longest distance has an 8-hour time limit.
course_highlights: Little asphalt, plenty of singletrack
Varied terrain: forest paths, sandy paths and rough grassland
Short climbs in the Beerze Bulten on the 30, 42 and 60 km routes
additional: The VechtdalTrail is a disposable-cup-free event; participants must bring their own collapsible cup or hydration bladder. The 60 km distance has an 8-hour time limit, with cut-off times at aid stations. Timing is provided via a chip in the bib number, which is personalised and may be kept after the event. There is no race-day registration; registration must be completed in advance. A unique event shirt can be ordered during registration. Disposable-cup-free event, advance registration required, no medals, time limits and cut-off times, participants must have their own insurance, safety measures at hazardous locations

name: Veldhoven 10 Miles
description: The Veldhoven 10 Miles is a popular running event in the Veldhoven area. The event is known as one of the most enjoyable runs in the region and attracts many participants every year. The race offers a challenging 10-mile course through the beautiful landscape around Veldhoven. The atmosphere is sporty and sociable, making it suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: A 10-mile course through the Veldhoven landscape
A varied route with beautiful scenery
A popular, sociable running event in the region

name: De AERS Groep Zeeuwse Crosscompetitie
organizer: VZA (Vlaamse Atletiekvereniging Zeeland) of regionale atletiekverenigingen
price_range: €3 tot €8 afhankelijk van leeftijd en lidmaatschap
description: The AERS Groep Zeeland Cross Competition is an autumn and winter cross-country series consisting of seven races, organised by regional athletics clubs in Zeeland. The competition is open to everyone, including non-members, and offers various distances for juniors and seniors/masters. Courses consist mainly of grass and forest trails, with potentially muddy sections depending on the weather, so shoes with good grip are recommended. Junior participants always receive a reward, and seniors and masters receive prizes in each category, both for individual races and for the overall competition.
course_highlights: Courses consist of grass and forest trails
Sections may be muddy depending on the weather
Short and long cross-country distances for different age categories
additional: The competition consists of 7 cross-country races during the season. A points table is updated and published after each race. Seniors and masters have a prize-giving ceremony for each category, with both race-day prizes and prizes for the overall competition. Spikes or shoes with good grip are recommended because of the terrain. Cross-country running on grass and forest trails, muddy in rainy weather, short and long distances for juniors and adults, prizes for race winners and overall standings

name: Snertcross

price_tiers.distance: Lange cross dames en Lange cross heren 55+

description: The Snertcross is an annual running race in the Warandebos in Tilburg, organized by T.S.A.V. Parcival. The race is part of the Regio 13 Cross Circuit and the Tilburg Triple. The Snertcross offers several categories and distances, including junior races, a short cross, a women’s long cross, a men’s 55+ long cross, and a men’s long cross. The race features a challenging course with multiple laps, depending on the distance.
course_highlights: Junior cross: 2 laps
Short cross: 1 lap
Women’s and men’s 55+ long cross: 3 laps; men’s long cross: 4 laps
additional: Race-day registration is available until one hour before the start of the respective race. Payment is accepted only in cash or via a payment request using a QR code. The Snertcross is part of the Tilburg Triple, where participants who take part in three or more events receive an exclusive medal. Registration is open until a few days before the race, with race-day registration also available. The race takes place in the Warandebos, with parking available on the university campus. There are no changing facilities at the start, but facilities are available at Tilburg University’s sports centre.

name: Lage Vuursche Ultra
description: The Lage Vuursche Ultra is a challenging 50 km trail run through historic forests around Baarn, with a varied course through deciduous and coniferous forests, heathland and open stretches. The route is followed using a GPX file and offers a great mix of singletrack, forest paths and avenues. There is good support along the way, with no more than 15 km between aid stations, and participants receive a UTMB Index at the finish. This event is part of the Dutch Ultra Series 2026 and is known for its natural beauty and challenging character.
course_highlights: 50 km through historic forests of deciduous and coniferous trees
Varied course with singletrack, forest paths and heathland
No more than 15 km between aid stations; no disposable cups
additional: Start and finish at Natuurcamping De Zeven Linden, with parking available. Pick up your race number and tracker from 08:30 at race headquarters. Time limit: 8 hours; finish by 17:00 at the latest. No disposable cups at aid stations; participants must bring their own race cup or buy one at race headquarters. Participants will receive detailed information by email two days before the event. Maximum 300 participants; no cups at aid stations; start and finish at Kampeerterrein de Zeven Linden.

name: Halloween Citywalk
description: The Halloween City Walk in Veghel is a spooky walk of approximately 3 kilometres through the centre of Veghel, organised on Halloween evening, 31 October 2026. It is not a running race, but a frightening experience for the whole family, with various scary characters along the route who will give participants a fright. The walk starts between 19:00 and 20:00 at the Markt, near Matteucci ice cream parlour. Participants must be at least 16 years old; younger participants may join only when accompanied by an adult.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 3 kilometres through the centre of Veghel
A spooky, eerie atmosphere, with ominous characters along the route
Start at the Markt, near Matteucci ice cream parlour
additional: Individuals may participate from age 16; younger participants may join only when accompanied by a parent or adult. Start time is between 19:00 and 20:00. The walk is not a race, but an event with a spooky atmosphere. Registration for the Krollenloop itself is sold out, but registration for the Halloween City Walk is still open. Start at 19:00; registration via the website. Participants aged 16 and over may take part independently; younger participants must be accompanied by an adult.

name: Boerenkoolloop
location: Atletiekbaan van AV NOVA, Warmenhuizen, Noord-Holland, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Schrijf je vòòr 1 oktober in tegen de prijzen van 2025: 10km wedstrijd/trim/bedrijvenloop: EUR 14.00

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ben je geen Vroege Vogel, dan is het inschrijfgeld vanaf 1 oktober: 10km wedstrijd/trim/bedrijvenloop: EUR 16.00

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Schrijf je vòòr 1 oktober in tegen de prijzen van 2025: 5 km wedstrijd/trim/bedrijvenloop: EUR 8.00

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ben je geen Vroege Vogel, dan is het inschrijfgeld vanaf 1 oktober: 5 km wedstrijd/trim/bedrijvenloop: EUR 9.00

description: The Boerenkoolloop in Warmenhuizen is a friendly race and fun run over 5 and 10 km, starting and finishing on the AV NOVA athletics track. The course passes through the villages of Tuitjenhorn, Eenigenburg and Warmenhuizen, partly along quiet polder roads and the historic Westfriese Omringdijk, where the wind can be a challenging factor. After the event, every participant receives a bag of ingredients for a delicious boerenkool mash, sponsored by Koninklijke VEZET. There is also a 1.2 km youth run and an approximately 11 km walk, which follows a partly reversed route. The venue offers spacious changing rooms, hot showers and additional amenities for comfort.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the AV NOVA athletics track
Route along quiet polder roads and the historic Westfriese Omringdijk
Views of the surrounding landscape, with the wind as a challenging factor
additional: Race numbers are mailed out and should arrive around 30 October. They can also be collected from the Harenkarspelhal next to AV NOVA up to 15 minutes before the start. Spacious changing rooms and hot showers are available. After the event, everyone receives a boerenkool package with sausage, potatoes and herbs. Parking is available at AV NOVA and at Bejo Zaden BV, approximately 800 metres away. The walking event starts between 8:30 and 9:30; participants must reach the finish by 12:30 to receive the boerenkool package. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl until 25 October; same-day registration is not available. Start times are 11:10, 11:25 and 11:35. Start and finish are on the AV NOVA athletics track.

name: Bosloop Malden
description: The Bosloop Malden is a running race with a rich history dating back to 1978, held on Sunday, November 1, 2026. It is a popular event among the smaller running races in the Netherlands, ideal for testing your form two weeks before the Zevenheuvelenloop. The race offers 5, 10 and 15 km routes through the woods, as well as special races for young runners, including the Bambinoloop for children aged 3 to 8 and a 2 km race for children aged 9 to 12. Participation is free for children up to 12 years old, made possible in part by sponsor Medical Training Malden. Registration is open from September 1 through October 30, 2026, and closes once the maximum number of participants per distance has been reached.
course_highlights: Run through the woods of Malden
Distances of 5, 10 and 15 km
Special youth distances: Bambinoloop and 2 km Kidsrun
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 9:00 a.m. at the event grounds. The Bambinoloop has two starts: first ages 3–5, then ages 6–8. There is no timekeeping for the Bambinoloop. The 2 km race is part of the Scholenbokaal of the MTM Kidsrun Bosloop Malden. Registration on race day is not possible. Places are limited for each distance. Distances include 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, with special races for children; participation is free for children under 12; registration runs from September 1 to October 30, 2026; registration on race day is not possible.

name: Haarlerbergloop
distance_verbose: 30 km, Halve marathon, 16 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, 1 km
price_range: € 2 voor herinneringsmedaille, overige kosten niet gespecificeerd
description: The Haarlerbergloop is a challenging running event in the beautiful surroundings of the Sallandse Heuvelrug, with almost entirely unpaved trails across fields, sandy tracks, woodland and heathland. The event takes place over two days: the Haarlerbergtrail, with distances of 11, 16, 22 and 30 km, is on Saturday 31 October 2026, while the shorter distances of 1, 2.5, 5 and 10 km take place on Sunday 1 November 2026. The event is small-scale and is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit and the CrossCircuit van het Oosten. The start and finish are on Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel, where facilities including toilets and a changing area are available.
course_highlights: Almost entirely unpaved trails across fields, sandy tracks, woodland and heathland
Beautiful routes through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park
Steep hills and wide-open views
additional: The start and finish are on Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel, with toilets and a changing area but no showers. Collecting your race number and leaving your bag are at your own risk. On-the-day registration is not available; advance registration is open until 30 minutes before the start. Participants in the 5 and 10 km races can buy a commemorative medal after the race (€ 2). The trail is limited to 349 participants, and registration closes no later than 31 October at 11:30, or earlier if full. Bringing your own drinking cup is mandatory for the trail; a reusable cup is available to buy (€ 4). There is no prize-giving for the trail, but every participant receives a medal. The 5 and 10 km races donate € 1 per participant to Stichting Support for Nature. Distances: 1 km, 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 11 km, 16 km, 22 km and 30 km; cross-country event; registration opens in September; contribution to Support for Nature; races include the trail and youth distances.

name: Loop Esch Door
description: Loop Esch Door is a running event in and around the centre of Tubbergen, featuring a challenging, fast course across the Tubbergse Esch. Since 2022, the event has grown into an established race with a welcoming atmosphere and a great mix of competition and recreation. It offers various distances for runners of all levels, including special runs for children and people with disabilities. The start and finish are at Raadhuisplein in Tubbergen, where a friendly, community spirit is also central.
course_highlights: Fast course through the countryside and across the Tubbergse Esch
Start and finish at Raadhuisplein in the centre of Tubbergen
Various distances from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, including walking routes
additional: Collect race numbers on 1 November from 08:00 at Tubbergen Town Hall, up to 30 minutes before the start. Walkers can collect their race numbers from 09:00. Parking at the swimming pool on Sportlaan is recommended. There is a water station on the course, and sports nutrition is available after the event. First aid is available along the course. KinderKroon KidsRuns start from 12:45, with different age categories. Prize-giving ceremonies take place shortly after each distance finishes. The event also offers an inclusive run for people with disabilities and has a friendly, community-focused atmosphere.

name: Maasduinenloop
location: Afferden, Nationaal Park De Maasduinen, Limburg, Netherlands

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld per deelnemer bij voorinschrijving is € 4,00

description: The Maasduinenloop is an atmospheric running event held in De Maasduinen National Park, starting and finishing at Golfbaan Bleijenbeek in Afferden. The run offers a unique experience amid beautiful natural surroundings and combines sport with a friendly atmosphere. All proceeds go to burn care at the Expertise Centre for Child Trauma and Burn Care at Radboudumc Amalia Children’s Hospital. The Maasduinenloop welcomes runners of all ages and abilities, with a special focus on young participants through the Kidsrun.
course_highlights: Run through De Maasduinen National Park
Start and finish at atmospheric Golfbaan Bleijenbeek
New routes, including a 10 km loop
additional: Kidsrun start times: 10:30 (up to and including age 7, 500 m) and 10:45 (ages 8 to 11, 1,000 m). All Kidsrun participants receive a medal and a healthy snack. The prize ceremony takes place immediately after the Kidsrun, at approximately 11:00. Teams may be all-male, all-female or mixed; the score is the combined time of the three fastest runners. Team members are automatically entered in the individual race at no extra cost. Start and finish at Golfbaan Bleijenbeek. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 km. The course is marked and supervised by traffic marshals and mountain bikers, and timing is provided. Start and finish at Landgoed Bleijenbeek.

name: Warnsborncross

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname aan de Warnsborncross kost 9 euro (alle afstanden)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Deelname aan de Kidsrun kost 3 euro

description: The Warnsborncross is a traditional cross-country race held on the beautiful Warnsborn estate near Arnhem. The race follows unpaved paths past streams and ponds, with challenging elevation changes. There are three distances: 5.5 km, 11 km and 16.5 km, covering 1, 2 or 3 laps of 5.5 km respectively. There is also a 1,200-metre Kidsrun for children up to and including 12 years old. The start and race-number pickup take place at Tennisvereniging Schaarsbergen.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths through the Warnsborn estate
Running alongside streams and ponds
Challenging elevation changes
additional: Race-number pickup is available from 9:30 until 10:45 at the latest at Tennisvereniging Schaarsbergen, Kemperbergerweg 671a, 6816 RT Arnhem. The Kidsrun starts at 10:30, and the other distances start at 11:00. Start and registration at Tennisvereniging Schaarsbergen; the course follows unpaved paths with elevation changes and is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit
description: The Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit starts on 1 November 2026 and consists of nine varied running events spread over six months in the Groene Hart. The circuit is suitable for both beginner and experienced runners and offers a platform where taking part matters more than winning. Participants can choose from different distances and benefit from a discounted circuit entry, including a free running shirt and a finisher’s gift for taking part in 8 or 9 events. The circuit encourages participation and promises a friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Nine varied runs in the Groene Hart
Distances of 5 km, 10 km, 10 English miles and half marathon
Route along the picturesque Kromme Mijdrecht river and through Wickelhofpark
additional: Circuit participants can switch between the short and middle distances as often as they like at the information desk. Switching to the long distance is not possible without a separate entry. There is a 10 km walk, a Family Run and a G-Run for children up to 12 years old. Lost race numbers can be replaced at the information desk. Changing rooms and showers are available, as is limited bag storage. Coffee, tea and soft drinks are available for collection in the sports hall. The prize-giving takes place in the sports hall. Nine varied runs between November 2026 and April 2027, including short, middle and long distances and a half marathon, with extra rewards for taking part in multiple events.

name: LPR - Last Pirate Running
description: LPR - Last Pirate Running is a running event taking place in Volendam on Sunday, November 1, 2026. The race offers a short distance of 1.6 kilometers, ideal for a fast and challenging running experience. Registration closes on October 20, 2026, and participants can sign up via the specified registration website. The event is organized by ProRun and is suitable for runners looking for a unique and accessible race.
course_highlights: Short distance of 1.6 km
Organized in picturesque Volendam
Fast and challenging course
additional: Registration for the 1.6 km distance closes on October 20, 2026. A training plan for 10 English miles (16.1 km) is available on the website and may help with preparation. Registration for the race was closed as of October 2026; the event is intended for runners who want to enjoy a short and fun race in North Holland.

name: Kievit Sport Twentsche Cross Competitie
organizer: AV Goor, AV Iphitos, ASV Eibergen, AAV Sisu, AC Tion, LAAC Twente
description: The Kievit Sport Twentse Cross Competition is a challenging cross-country series comprising six races in Twente’s beautiful natural areas. The competition offers a unique opportunity to test yourself against peers and enjoy the region’s winter conditions. The races vary in distance and are open to different age categories, from youth to masters. With strong local involvement and sponsors such as Kievit Sport and Wiggers Vleeswaren, this competition is a much-loved event among runners in Twente.
course_highlights: Natural cross-country courses in various natural areas of Twente
Distances range from 1 km for youth to 10 km for seniors and masters
A unique collaboration between six athletics clubs in the region
additional: Race numbers can be collected at locations such as Zwembad de Vijf Heuvels (Markelo). Changing rooms and toilets are available. For age categories, the reference date is the participant’s age at the final race for youth and at the first race for masters. The competition is made possible in part by local sponsors and six athletics clubs. A 2.5/5 km Canicross distance is also held during the Hulsbeekcross. The competition includes races such as Hessenheemcross, Wintercross, Oudejaarscross, Rutbeekcross, Hulsbeekcross and Dinkelcross, with results and standings available on the official website.

name: Maple Leaf Wintercup
organizer: GAC Hilversum en de Baarnse Atletiek Vereniging

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: prijzen stijgen vanaf 15 augustus, doe nu nog mee met de early-bird prijzen!

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: prijzen stijgen vanaf 15 augustus, doe nu nog mee met de early-bird prijzen!

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pupillen van GAC Hilversum en BAV Baarn kunnen gratis deelnemen

description: The Maple Leaf Wintercup 2026, held on Sunday, November 1 at Bosbad De Vuursche in Baarn, is an atmospheric running and walking event set against a beautiful autumn backdrop. The race is organized by Gooise Atletiek Club Hilversum and Baarnse Atletiek Vereniging and offers challenging unpaved courses surrounded by autumn colors. There are various distances for both walkers and runners, including youth distances and recreational runs with and without a competition licence. The start and finish are on the atmospheric grounds around Bosbad De Vuursche, creating a fun and sporty atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Challenging unpaved course amid autumn colors
Long Cross of 9.5 km with 4 laps
Short Cross of 3.1 km with 2 laps
additional: Race numbers can be collected from October 25 through 31 at Run2Day Hilversum or on race day at race headquarters. There is no separate gender categorization for the Short and Long Cross. Pupils of the organizing athletics clubs can participate free of charge after registering via the contact form. There is a recreational run and a competition-licence run for the short and long cross. The courses consist of multiple laps depending on the distance. The course includes unpaved paths, with events such as Nordic walking, cross-country running and youth races; start and finish at Bosbad De Vuursche.

name: Spaarnwoudecross
description: The Mokums Cross Circuit is a series of four woodland cross-country races in the Amsterdam area, including the Spaarnwoude Cross, organized by Haarlem Atletiek in Spaarndam. Participants register for at least three of these races and have a chance to receive a fun memento. There is a standings competition for the main events, with each runner’s best three results from the four races counting. The circuit is made possible through a partnership between five Amsterdam athletics clubs and their sponsor.
course_highlights: Woodland cross-country races in the Amsterdam area
Four different locations: Spaarndam, Amsterdamse Bos, De Eenhoorn, Gaasperplas
A memento for participants in at least three races
additional: Participants in at least three races receive a memento. The 20 fastest men and women in the main events score points toward the overall standings. The prize-giving takes place at the first race of the season. A muddy cross-country race and family and youth event, held on 2 November 2025 in Haarlem at Wheelerplanet in Spaarndam, with participants such as Tessa Weening and Sophie Kwak.

name: Hermans Assurantiën Duatlon
description: The Hermans Assurantiën Duathlon, organised by AVR'69, is a well-known off-road run-mountain bike-run event held in the beautiful forests of Reusel. The 25th edition takes place on Sunday, 1 November 2026, and offers both competitive distances (14 km running, 60 km mountain biking, 7 km running) for athletes aged 18 and over, and recreational distances (7 km running, 30 km mountain biking, 3.5 km running) for participants aged 16 and over. The start and finish are at sports park D'n Hoek, which also has ample changing and shower facilities. Participants can register individually or as a team, and a hot meal is provided after the race.
course_highlights: Run-mountain bike-run event in the forests of Reusel
Off-road course; mountain bikes are required
Start and finish at sports park D'n Hoek, with good facilities
additional: All events start together at 10:00. Participants must use a mountain bike. A hot meal is provided after the race for competitive athletes. Parking is available at the sports park D'n Hoek car park, but cars are not allowed inside the sports park. There are ample shower and changing facilities in the AVR'69 clubhouse. Cash prizes and medals are awarded in the competitive and recreational categories. You can register individually or as a team (a running and cycling duo). The race takes place on 1 November 2026, and registration is open from 10 April 2026 to 31 October 2026. The race starts at 10:00 and requires a mountain bike. Participants must be at least 18 years old for the main race and 16 for the recreational event.

name: Van de Meerendonk Heidetrail
location: Gilde Sint Sebastiaan, Oirschot, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Van de Meerendonk Heath Trail is a beautiful recreational event across the expansive Oirschot heathland, suitable for runners and walkers. The routes are clearly marked with arrows, making it impossible to get lost. Water and fruit stations are available on all distances, and afterwards you can enjoy a friendly atmosphere with free coffee or tea and a treat. The event starts at Gilde Sint Sebastiaan in Oirschot, with several distances available for both running and walking.
course_highlights: Expansive woodland and heathland
Routes clearly marked with arrows
Water and fruit stations on all distances
additional: Start location: Gilde Sint Sebastiaan, Wintelresedijk 1, 5688GW Oirschot. Runners start between 8:30 and 9:30, walkers between 9:00 and 9:30. Toilet and changing facilities are limited; there are no showers. Free coffee or tea and a treat are available after the event until 13:00. name: Leesten Cross
description: The Leestencross is a recreational cross-country race held in the beautiful woodland around Ugchelen. The race offers a challenging course along forest, sand and heathland paths, with no muddy sections, and rewards you with a magnificent view over the heath. It’s an ideal opportunity to test your fitness and race performance in a welcoming and accessible setting. The start and finish are at Bospaviljoen ’t Leesten, a top destination for runners in the Netherlands.
course_highlights: Course along forest, sand and heathland paths
Magnificent view over the heath
Start and finish at Bospaviljoen ’t Leesten in Ugchelen
additional: After handing in your race number, you will receive a voucher for a refreshment. No changing facilities are available. First aid is available. The 10 km race counts toward AV Veluwe’s cross-country club championship. Trail run on sand paths in Kroondomein, approximately 60 metres of elevation gain, registration closed, start/finish location: Wildrooster Wenum-Wiesel, no showers or changing facilities, first aid available.

name: Twentse Smokkel Trail
description: The Twentse Smokkel Trail is a unique trail run in the border region of Losser, taking place on 1 November 2026. The routes are 90% unpaved and cross varied terrain with many singletracks, taking participants to places where running is normally not allowed. There are several distances, from challenging 27 km and 22 km runs to a 10 km Drop Off Trail, where participants are taken to the start by horse and covered wagon. In addition to the trail runs, there is a walking trail and a kids’ trail. Participants symbolically smuggle a packet of butter across the border and receive a Twentse krentenwegge after the finish as a reward.
course_highlights: 90% unpaved paths with many singletracks
The route passes through unspoilt forests and nature ponds, and along the Dinkel
A unique border crossing with symbolic butter smuggling and musical support along the way
additional: Refreshment stations are located at approximately 11 km and 4 km before the finish, plus a water station 2 km before the finish. The start and finish are at the Multifunctionele Accommodatie, Nilantspad 3 in Losser, where changing rooms, showers and toilets are available. The 10 km Drop Off Trail starts at the German monastery in Bardel; participants are taken to the start by horse and covered wagon. Timing is provided for the 27, 22 and 14 km trails, but not for the 10 km Drop Off Trail. Dogs are not allowed. After the finish, participants receive a wooden medal and a Twentse krentenwegge. The three fastest men and women in each distance are presented with a handmade smuggling trophy. Trail and walking routes on unpaved paths, including a kids’ trail and a drop-off trail, with a theme of smuggling history and experiencing nature. Registration opens on 1 July 2026 via inschrijven.nl, with participant limits for each distance and refreshment stations at 11 and 23 km.

name: 34. Mündener Altstadtlauf
description: The 34th Mündener Altstadtlauf takes place on October 31, 2026, in Hann. Münden and offers suitable distances for runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, as well as 5 km and 10 km races for recreational and competitive runners. The course is measured by the Lower Saxony Athletics Association and is therefore eligible for record times. In addition to individual rankings, there are group and team rankings, making the race particularly appealing to teams. The organizing team places great importance on professional delivery and continually improving the event.

name: 6. Halloween Run
description: The Halloween Run Bremen 2026 takes place on October 31 at Werdersee in Bremen and offers runners a spooky running experience with various distances from 1 km to the marathon. The courses are measured in accordance with German Athletics Association rules and are eligible for record lists, underscoring the competitive nature of the event. Alongside the sporting event, participants can look forward to a spooky atmosphere with costumes, lights and fog, as well as a spectacular fireworks display to close the event. The event is open to all age groups and ability levels, and includes relay races and a children’s run.

Distances from 1 km to the marathon (42.195 km) in a spooky atmosphere

The start and finish area is between the Finnbahn at Werdersee and the Grillwiese/DLRG lifeguard station. Several running distances, including the marathon, take place on measured loops; costumes are encouraged; the event concludes with fireworks.

name: Bredstedt-Cross
description: The 39th Bredstedt Cross takes place on 31 October 2026 at Sportpark Bredstedt and is hosted by Bredstedter TSV. The event offers cross-country races for a wide range of ages, from children and young people to senior competitors and numerous masters categories. There are short and long cross-country races for men and women, as well as separate age categories from M6/W6 to M75/W75, including youth and U18/U20. The event is listed as category 6.5.1, an event held away from a stadium, and offers a varied competition format for all age groups.

Short and long cross-country races for men and women
Age categories from M6/W6 to M75/W75, as well as youth and U18/U20

location: Sportpark Osterberg, Munster, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The District Championships and 3rd Halloween Cross-Country Run in the Örtzetal in Munster is a cross-country event taking place on October 31, 2026, at Sportpark Osterberg in Munster. The event combines the District Cross-Country Championships with the third Halloween Cross-Country Run and is open to children, young people, open categories and masters. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, offering a local, club-oriented atmosphere rather than the feel of a major city race. The race takes place in the autumnal Örtzetal region and is a popular seasonal event organised by Eintracht Munster.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in the Örtzetal on varied terrain
Distances from 500 m to 10 km for different age and ability categories
Event at Sportpark Osterberg in Munster
additional: The event was postponed due to bad weather and incorporates the District Championships into the Halloween Cross-Country Run. location: Köstritzer Park, Bad Köstritz, Thuringia, Germany
description: The Köstritzer Parklauf is a cross-country race held in late October in Bad Köstritz, Germany. The course runs through and around Köstritzer Park, away from the usual running tracks. The event offers short races for children and young people, as well as longer distances for adults and masters, from 500 m to the 12 km main race. It attracts numerous local and regional clubs, mainly from Thuringia, but also from Saxony and Bavaria. The 27th edition of the race is known for its strong regional turnout.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through and around Köstritzer Park
Start in the park with views of dahlias in bloom in autumn
A range of distances from 500 m to 12 km
additional: Typical October weather: around 14 °C maximum and 6 °C minimum, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event includes races for children and young people, as well as main races for adults and masters. It takes place in late October, with various race distances and categories for children, young people, active runners, and masters. Registration is possible until shortly before the event.

name: Nordhessische Crosslaufmeisterschaften
description: The North Hesse Cross-Country Championships are a regional club and regional cross-country championship held in various locations across North Hesse. The event is aimed primarily at club runners from the region competing for regional and district titles. Course distances range from short youth races of 1.2 km to longer senior races of 8 km. The races take place on cross-country terrain, not on closed roads, and are organized by various athletics districts and clubs.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain rather than a road race
Distances from 1.2 km to 8 km
Held at sports facilities in various locations across North Hesse
additional: The event is geared strongly toward club runners. Depending on the course, runners are advised to choose suitable shoes carefully, such as spikes. Results are published as web and PDF listings. Typical October weather is cool and mostly cloudy, with a daytime high of about 14°C and a low of 6°C. October weather: about 14°C, low of 6°C, 40 mm of precipitation, cloudy; races take place at sports facilities in the region, online registration is possible, and results are published as web and PDF listings.

description: The TEAG - LEGEND OF CROSS is Thuringia’s toughest and warmest-hearted cross-country race, taking place on 31 October and 1 November 2026 in Mühlberg at the Drei Gleichen. The event features challenging trails, more than 30 natural and man-made obstacles, and a unique setting with three castles. Whether running solo or as part of a team, recreational runners can become legends in a strong community. The event offers various distances and levels of difficulty suitable for all age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: Three courses of different lengths, each with its own obstacles and difficulty level
More than 30 natural and man-made obstacles, including water obstacles at the Wechmar Reservoir
Start and finish at the Mühlberg sports ground, set against the historic backdrop of the Drei Gleichen
additional: The Fun and junior races start on Saturday, and the main races take place on Sunday. There are individual and team rankings. The 4 km SPECIAL CROSS is available for Special Olympics athletes with intellectual disabilities. Changes and late registrations are free until mid-October; after that, a €5 fee applies. Double-start offer for both LEGEND OF CROSS events in 2026 for €99. Several course distances, obstacles, junior races, team rankings, start and finish at the Mühlberg sports ground, water obstacle on the 30 km course.

location: Bezirkssportplatz Bothfeld, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Bothfelder Waldlauf is a DLV-approved public race organized by TuS Bothfeld 04 in Hanover. The races start and finish at the Bothfeld district sports ground and follow a loop through the beautiful Bothfelder Wald on forest trails and well-maintained forest roads. The race is part of the Hannover Region Running Pass and offers changing and shower facilities in the finish area. Affordable food, drinks, and free hot tea are available. The event is open to runners of all age groups, including Bambinis, with short-distance races.
course_highlights: Loop through the Bothfelder Wald
Forest trails and well-maintained forest roads
Start and finish at the Bothfeld district sports ground
additional: Late entries on race day can be made online up to 60 minutes before the respective race, subject to availability. The late-entry fee is €2 in addition to the entry fee. The children’s race award ceremonies take place approximately 60 minutes after the races; ceremonies for the longer races follow immediately after the finish. On-site certificate printing is available. The 5 km walk starts at the same time as the 10 km main race. Changing and shower facilities are available. Public transport is available via tram line 13, and parking is available nearby. The registration deadline is October 30, 2026; the event takes place in typical November weather in Hanover; the event is outside the official stadium calendar.

name: 28. Tangerpokallauf
description: The 28th Tanger Cup Run in Demker is the oldest running event organized by SC Demker '95 and is part of the Elbe-Ohre Cup. The course runs through the autumnal Tanger lowlands between Demker and Weißewarte, past Deutsches Eck, under the Stendal–Magdeburg railway line, and through the Süppling woodland. Distances offered are 1.2 km for children and young people, and 5.4 km and 12.0 km for older young people and adults. The terrain is mostly flat, with gentle rises formed by the dikes surrounding Demker.

Passes through the Süppling woodland
additional: Distances: 1.2 km (children/young people), 5.4 km and 12.0 km (older young people/adults). The terrain is flat throughout, with the dikes as the only rises. The course covers 8.7 kilometers with around 245 meters of elevation gain on gravel forest paths, climbing to the Käppele parking area. The race is part of the TSV Beuren Tälescup race series and also offers a separate Nordic walking category. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a traditional buffet, making the event a social occasion.

Route on gravel forest paths

The race takes place away from city streets in the Rantzauer Forst area and also offers walking and hiking events. With a modest field of usually 101 to 300 runners, the event has more of a club-run feel than that of a major race.

name: Guldfeber Aarhus — Golden Fever #1
description:
Gold Fever — Denmark’s first SplitRace tournament. A free running game in the streets of Aarhus: 12 segments (0.4–1.9 km) are mapped around the city, and 7 of them form a hidden “golden chain” — nobody knows which ones, or in what order. Find them. Run them. Chase the times.

No mass start and no entry fee: run whenever you want, as often as you want, throughout 17 October – 1 November. The app measures your times via GPS. You earn points for each golden segment based on how close you are to the fastest time — women are scored against the fastest woman, men against the fastest man. Extra points go to the first runners to unlock a golden segment — and the tournament’s biggest bonus goes to the first to complete the whole chain in the correct order.

This is the first edition — a pilot for a maximum of 30 runners. Your feedback will shape the game.

(EN: A free city-wide running game in Aarhus. 12 segments, 7 of them secretly form a golden chain — find them and beat the clock. No mass start: run anytime 17 Oct – 1 Nov. Free entry, GPS timing in the SplitRace app. First edition, 30 pilot spots.)
additional: No start line and no start groups — all segments are on public, lit routes around Aarhus, and you can run them whenever you want during the event window. Participation requires the free SplitRace app (iOS / Android) — download it via splitrace.app, join the “Guldfeber Aarhus” tournament, and all 12 segments will appear on your map. Limited to the first 30 runners. Open streets: follow normal traffic rules. Questions? Write to support@splitrace.app or Instagram https://www.instagram.com/split_race/
